Components\Account\Pages\Manage\TwoFactorAuthentication.razor
====================================================================
@page "/Account/Manage/TwoFactorAuthentication"

@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.Features
@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity
@using MITANZ360Edu.Web.Data

@inject UserManager<ApplicationUser> UserManager
@inject SignInManager<ApplicationUser> SignInManager
@inject IdentityRedirectManager RedirectManager

<PageTitle>Two-factor authentication (2FA)</PageTitle>

<StatusMessage />
<h3>Two-factor authentication (2FA)</h3>
@if (canTrack)
{
    if (is2faEnabled)
    {
        if (recoveryCodesLeft == 0)
        {
            <div class="alert alert-danger">
                <strong>You have no recovery codes left.</strong>
                <p>You must <a href="Account/Manage/GenerateRecoveryCodes">generate a new set of recovery codes</a> before you can log in with a recovery code.</p>
            </div>
        }
        else if (recoveryCodesLeft == 1)
        {
            <div class="alert alert-danger">
                <strong>You have 1 recovery code left.</strong>
                <p>You can <a href="Account/Manage/GenerateRecoveryCodes">generate a new set of recovery codes</a>.</p>
            </div>
        }
        else if (recoveryCodesLeft <= 3)
        {
            <div class="alert alert-warning">
                <strong>You have @recoveryCodesLeft recovery codes left.</strong>
                <p>You should <a href="Account/Manage/GenerateRecoveryCodes">generate a new set of recovery codes</a>.</p>
            </div>
        }

        if (isMachineRemembered)
        {
            <form style="display: inline-block" @formname="forget-browser" @onsubmit="OnSubmitForgetBrowserAsync" method="post">
                <AntiforgeryToken />
                <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Forget this browser</button>
            </form>
        }

        <a href="Account/Manage/Disable2fa" class="btn btn-primary">Disable 2FA</a>
        <a href="Account/Manage/GenerateRecoveryCodes" class="btn btn-primary">Reset recovery codes</a>
    }

    <h4>Authenticator app</h4>
    @if (!hasAuthenticator)
    {
        <a href="Account/Manage/EnableAuthenticator" class="btn btn-primary">Add authenticator app</a>
    }
    else
    {
        <a href="Account/Manage/EnableAuthenticator" class="btn btn-primary">Set up authenticator app</a>
        <a href="Account/Manage/ResetAuthenticator" class="btn btn-primary">Reset authenticator app</a>
    }
}
else
{
    <div class="alert alert-danger">
        <strong>Privacy and cookie policy have not been accepted.</strong>
        <p>You must accept the policy before you can enable two factor authentication.</p>
    </div>
}

@code {
    private bool canTrack;
    private bool hasAuthenticator;
    private int recoveryCodesLeft;
    private bool is2faEnabled;
    private bool isMachineRemembered;

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        var user = await UserManager.GetUserAsync(HttpContext.User);
        if (user is null)
        {
            RedirectManager.RedirectToInvalidUser(UserManager, HttpContext);
            return;
        }

        canTrack = HttpContext.Features.Get<ITrackingConsentFeature>()?.CanTrack ?? true;
        hasAuthenticator = await UserManager.GetAuthenticatorKeyAsync(user) is not null;
        is2faEnabled = await UserManager.GetTwoFactorEnabledAsync(user);
        isMachineRemembered = await SignInManager.IsTwoFactorClientRememberedAsync(user);
        recoveryCodesLeft = await UserManager.CountRecoveryCodesAsync(user);
    }

    private async Task OnSubmitForgetBrowserAsync()
    {
        await SignInManager.ForgetTwoFactorClientAsync();

        RedirectManager.RedirectToCurrentPageWithStatus(
            "The current browser has been forgotten. When you login again from this browser you will be prompted for your 2fa code.",
            HttpContext);
    }
}

@if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(DisplayMessage))
{
    var statusMessageClass = DisplayMessage.StartsWith("Error") ? "danger" : "success";
    <div class="alert alert-@statusMessageClass" role="alert">
        @DisplayMessage
    </div>
}

@code {
    private string? messageFromCookie;

    [Parameter]
    public string? Message { get; set; }

    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext HttpContext { get; set; } = default!;

    private string? DisplayMessage => Message ?? messageFromCookie;

    protected override void OnInitialized()
    {
        messageFromCookie = HttpContext.Request.Cookies[IdentityRedirectManager.StatusCookieName];

        if (messageFromCookie is not null)
        {
            HttpContext.Response.Cookies.Delete(IdentityRedirectManager.StatusCookieName);
        }
    }
}

@code {
    [Inject] NavigationManager Nav { get; set; } = default!;

    int PendingModerationCount = 120;

    string statusText = "";
    string iconColor = "";
    string badgeStyle = "";

    protected override void OnParametersSet()
    {
        // 0–10 OK
        if (PendingModerationCount <= 10)
        {
            statusText = "OK";
            iconColor = "green";
            badgeStyle = "background:rgba(34,197,94,0.22);border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,0.45);color:green;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;";
        }
        // 11–25 Waiting
        else if (PendingModerationCount <= 25)
        {
            statusText = "Waiting";
            iconColor = "dodgerblue";
            badgeStyle = "background:rgba(59,130,246,0.22);border:1px solid rgba(59,130,246,0.45);color:dodgerblue;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;";
        }
        // 26–100 Critical
        else if (PendingModerationCount <= 100)
        {
            statusText = "Critical";
            iconColor = "orange";
            badgeStyle = "background:rgba(245,158,11,0.22);border:1px solid rgba(245,158,11,0.45);color:orange;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;";
        }
        // >100 Danger
        else
        {
            statusText = "Danger";
            iconColor = "red";
            badgeStyle = "background:rgba(255,0,0,0.18);border:1px solid rgba(255,0,0,0.45);color:red;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;";
        }
    }

    void OpenByStatus()
    {
        // ✅ Different navigation by condition (your rule)
        if (PendingModerationCount <= 10)
        {
            Nav.NavigateTo("/moderation/overview");
        }
        else if (PendingModerationCount <= 25)
        {
            Nav.NavigateTo("/moderation/waiting");
        }
        else if (PendingModerationCount <= 100)
        {
            Nav.NavigateTo("/moderation/critical");
        }
        else
        {
            Nav.NavigateTo("/moderation/danger");
        }
    }
}

====================================================================
END FILE

    int StorageUsage;

    bool MaintenanceMode;

    // Filters
    string AlertFilter = "All";
    List<string> AlertFilterOptions = new() { "All", "Critical", "Warning", "Info" };
    string? SearchText;

    // ---- Sample data ----
    List<MetricPoint> CpuSeries = new();
    List<MetricPoint> RamSeries = new();
    List<MetricPoint> DbLatencySeries = new();

    void SeedDemo()
    {
        var rnd = new Random();

        LastRefreshed = DateTime.Now;

        // KPI
        HealthScore = rnd.Next(92, 100);
        UptimeText = $"{rnd.Next(12, 42)}d {rnd.Next(0, 23)}h";

        CriticalAlerts = rnd.Next(0, 6);
        WarningAlerts = rnd.Next(2, 14);
        Alerts24h = CriticalAlerts + WarningAlerts + rnd.Next(6, 20);
        TopAlertSource = new[] { "Identity", "Firewall", "Audit", "API Gateway", "DB" }[rnd.Next(0, 5)];

        TotalUsers = rnd.Next(120, 560);
        Admins = rnd.Next(2, 10);
        LockedOut = rnd.Next(0, 4);
        TwoFactorCoverage = rnd.Next(65, 98);

        JobsRunning = rnd.Next(1, 6);
        JobsQueued = rnd.Next(0, 12);
        JobsFailed = rnd.Next(0, 3);
        NextBackup = DateTime.Now.AddHours(rnd.Next(1, 12)).ToString("HH:mm");

        CpuNow = rnd.Next(10, 85);
        RamNow = rnd.Next(20, 90);
        DbLatencyMs = rnd.Next(20, 280);
        ReqPerMin = rnd.Next(240, 1800);

        // Timeseries (12 points)
        CpuSeries = BuildSeries(rnd, 12, 10, 95);
        RamSeries = BuildSeries(rnd, 12, 15, 95);
        DbLatencySeries = BuildSeries(rnd, 12, 10, 320);
        TrafficSeries = BuildSeries(rnd, 12, 120, 2200);

        PeakRpm = TrafficSeries.Max(x => x.Value);
        ErrorRate24h = Math.Round(rnd.NextDouble() * 0.35, 2);

        ErrorMix = new List<PieSlice>
        {
            new("4xx", rnd.Next(8, 28)),
            new("5xx", rnd.Next(1, 8)),
            new("Timeout", rnd.Next(1, 10)),
            new("Auth", rnd.Next(1, 6))
        };

        DbHealth = DbLatencyMs < 150 ? "OK" : DbLatencyMs < 250 ? "Degraded" : "Critical";
        DbPoolHealth = rnd.Next(70, 100);
        IndexFragmentation = rnd.Next(2, 35);
        StorageUsage = rnd.Next(30, 88);

        // Alerts stream
        Alerts = BuildAlerts(rnd);
        FilteredAlerts = Alerts.ToList();

        // Services
        Services = new List<ServiceStatus>
        {
            new("Identity", "admin_panel_settings", "Healthy", "Token + cookie auth OK", "Healthy", "#22C55E"),
            new("Database", "database", DbHealth, $"Latency {DbLatencyMs}ms", DbHealth, DbHealth == "OK" ? "#22C55E" : DbHealth == "Degraded" ? "#F59E0B" : "#EF4444"),
            new("Notifications", "notifications", "Healthy", "Email + in-app OK", "Healthy", "#22C55E"),
            new("Jobs Runner", "sync", JobsFailed > 0 ? "Degraded" : "Healthy", $"{JobsRunning} running / {JobsQueued} queued", JobsFailed > 0 ? "Degraded" : "Healthy", JobsFailed > 0 ? "#F59E0B" : "#22C55E"),
            new("Audit", "policy", "Healthy", "Events streaming", "Healthy", "#22C55E"),
        };

        // Jobs
        Jobs = new List<JobItem>
        {
            new("DB Backup", JobsFailed > 0 ? "Failed" : "Running", $"{rnd.Next(0,12)}m"),
            new("Cleanup Temp", "Queued", "—"),
            new("Reindex", DbHealth == "OK" ? "Running" : "Queued", $"{rnd.Next(1,30)}m"),
            new("Email Digest", "Queued", "—"),
            new("Audit Export", "Running", $"{rnd.Next(0,8)}m"),
            new("Cache Warmup", "Completed", $"{rnd.Next(1,5)}m"),
        };
    }

    List<MetricPoint> BuildSeries(Random rnd, int count, int min, int max)
    {
        var now = DateTime.Now;
        var points = new List<MetricPoint>();
        for (int i = count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
        {
            var t = now.AddMinutes(-i * 5);
            points.Add(new MetricPoint(t.ToString("HH:mm"), rnd.Next(min, max)));
        }
        return points;
    }

    List<SecurityAlert> BuildAlerts(Random rnd)
    {
        var now = DateTime.Now;
        var severities = new[] { "Info", "Warning", "Critical" };
        var cats = new[] { "Identity", "RBAC", "Firewall", "Data", "Audit", "API" };
        var msgs = new[]
        {
            "Failed sign-in attempts exceeded threshold",
            "New admin role assignment",
            "Suspicious IP detected",
            "Audit export requested",
            "Policy updated",
            "Rate limit triggered",
            "Password reset initiated"
        };

        var list = new List<SecurityAlert>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 18; i++)
        {
            var sev = severities[rnd.Next(0, severities.Length)];
            list.Add(new SecurityAlert
            {
                Time = now.AddMinutes(-rnd.Next(5, 720)),
                Severity = sev,
                Category = cats[rnd.Next(0, cats.Length)],
                User = rnd.NextDouble() > 0.2 ? $"user{rnd.Next(1,120)}@mitanz.local" : "sysadmin@mitanz.local",
                Message = msgs[rnd.Next(0, msgs.Length)],
                SourceIp = $"{rnd.Next(10, 223)}.{rnd.Next(0, 255)}.{rnd.Next(0, 255)}.{rnd.Next(1, 254)}"
            });
        }
        return list.OrderByDescending(x => x.Time).ToList();
    }

    void ApplyFilter()
    {
        IEnumerable<SecurityAlert> q = Alerts;

        if (AlertFilter != "All")
            q = q.Where(a => a.Severity.Equals(AlertFilter, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(SearchText))
        {
            var s = SearchText.Trim();
            q = q.Where(a =>
                (a.User?.Contains(s, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false) ||
                (a.Message?.Contains(s, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false) ||
                (a.SourceIp?.Contains(s, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false) ||
                (a.Category?.Contains(s, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false));
        }

        FilteredAlerts = q.ToList();
    }

    void Refresh()
    {
        SeedDemo();
        ApplyFilter();
        Notifications.Notify(NotificationSeverity.Info, "Dashboard refreshed", "Sample data regenerated.");
    }

    string BadgeStyle(int score)
    {
        if (score >= 97) return "background: rgba(34,197,94,.12); color: var(--green); border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,.25);";
        if (score >= 93) return "background: rgba(245,158,11,.12); color: var(--amber); border:1px solid rgba(245,158,11,.25);";
        return "background: rgba(239,68,68,.12); color: var(--red); border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.25);";
    }

    string SeverityBadge(string s) => s switch
    {
        "Critical" => "background: rgba(239,68,68,.12); color: var(--red); border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.30);",
        "Warning"  => "background: rgba(245,158,11,.12); color: var(--amber); border:1px solid rgba(245,158,11,.30);",
        _          => "background: rgba(34,211,238,.12); color: var(--cyan); border:1px solid rgba(34,211,238,.30);",
    };

    string ServiceBadge(string state) => state switch
    {
        "Healthy"  => "background: rgba(34,197,94,.12); color: var(--green); border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,.25);",
        "Degraded" => "background: rgba(245,158,11,.12); color: var(--amber); border:1px solid rgba(245,158,11,.25);",
        _          => "background: rgba(239,68,68,.12); color: var(--red); border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.25);",
    };

    string DbHealthBadge(string state) => state switch
    {
        "OK"       => "background: rgba(34,197,94,.12); color: var(--green); border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,.25);",
        "Degraded" => "background: rgba(245,158,11,.12); color: var(--amber); border:1px solid rgba(245,158,11,.25);",
        _          => "background: rgba(239,68,68,.12); color: var(--red); border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.25);",
    };

    string JobBadge(string status) => status switch
    {
        "Running"   => "background: rgba(37,99,235,.14); color: var(--blue); border:1px solid rgba(37,99,235,.35);",
        "Queued"    => "background: rgba(139,92,246,.14); color: var(--violet); border:1px solid rgba(139,92,246,.35);",
        "Completed" => "background: rgba(34,197,94,.12); color: var(--green); border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,.25);",
        "Failed"    => "background: rgba(239,68,68,.12); color: var(--red); border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.25);",
        _           => "background: rgba(148,163,184,.10); color: var(--muted); border:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.25);",
    };

    string SmallBadge(int val, int warn, int crit, bool isMs = false)
    {
        // warn/crit thresholds
        if (val >= crit) return "background: rgba(239,68,68,.12); color: var(--red); border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.25);";
        if (val >= warn) return "background: rgba(245,158,11,.12); color: var(--amber); border:1px solid rgba(245,158,11,.25);";
        return "background: rgba(34,197,94,.12); color: var(--green); border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,.25);";
    }

{
    [CascadingParameter] private Task<AuthenticationState>? AuthenticationStateTask { get; set; }

    private bool autoRefresh = true;
    private int refreshSeconds = 3;

    private bool isBusy;
    private string? error;

    private SystemDoctorSnapshot? lastSnapshot;
    private SystemDoctorReport? lastReport;

    private string lastUpdateLocal = "-";
    private string lastReportMsText = "-";

    // Real CPU% computed between snapshots (no fake)
    private double lastCpuPercent;
    private string cpuPercentText => lastSnapshot is null ? "-" : $"{lastCpuPercent:0.0}%";
    private string uptimeText => lastSnapshot is null ? "-" : TimeSpan.FromSeconds(lastSnapshot.UptimeSeconds).ToString("g");

    // Historical series for charts (real-time)
    private readonly List<HistoryPoint> history = new();
    private PeriodicTimer? timer;
    private CancellationTokenSource? loopCts;

    private sealed class HistoryPoint
    {
        public DateTimeOffset AtUtc { get; set; }
        public double CpuPercent { get; set; }
        public double WorkingSetMb { get; set; }
        public double GcHeapMb { get; set; }
        public double TotalProcessorSeconds { get; set; }
        public double UptimeSeconds { get; set; }
    }

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await RefreshSnapshotOnly(); // immediate real snapshot
        StartOrRestartLoop();
    }

    private void StartOrRestartLoop()
    {
        loopCts?.Cancel();
        loopCts?.Dispose();
        loopCts = new CancellationTokenSource();

        timer?.Dispose();
        timer = new PeriodicTimer(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(refreshSeconds));

        _ = LoopAsync(loopCts.Token);
    }

    private async Task LoopAsync(CancellationToken ct)
    {
        try
        {
            while (!ct.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                if (autoRefresh)
                    await RefreshSnapshotOnly();

                await timer!.WaitForNextTickAsync(ct);
            }
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) { }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            error = ex.Message;
            await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
        }
    }

    private async Task RefreshSnapshotOnly()
    {
        try
        {
            error = null;

            var user = await GetUserAsync();
            var snap = await SharePointService.GetSystemDoctorSnapshotAsync(user);

            ComputeCpuPercentAndUpdateHistory(snap);
            lastSnapshot = snap;

            lastUpdateLocal = DateTimeOffset.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss");
            await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            error = ex.Message;
            await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
        }
    }

    private void ComputeCpuPercentAndUpdateHistory(SystemDoctorSnapshot snap)
    {
        // CPU% is computed from real TotalProcessorTime deltas between samples
        var now = snap.CapturedAtUtc;
        var tp = snap.TotalProcessorSeconds;

        if (history.Count > 0)
        {
            var prev = history[^1];
            var dt = (now - prev.AtUtc).TotalSeconds;
            var dCpu = tp - prev.TotalProcessorSeconds;

            if (dt > 0 && snap.ProcessorCount > 0)
            {
                var raw = (dCpu / (dt * snap.ProcessorCount)) * 100.0;
                lastCpuPercent = Math.Clamp(raw, 0, 100);
            }
        }

        history.Add(new HistoryPoint
        {
            AtUtc = now,
            CpuPercent = lastCpuPercent,
            WorkingSetMb = snap.WorkingSetMb,
            GcHeapMb = snap.GcHeapMb,
            TotalProcessorSeconds = tp,
            UptimeSeconds = snap.UptimeSeconds
        });

        // keep last 60 points
        if (history.Count > 60)
            history.RemoveRange(0, history.Count - 60);
    }

    private async Task RunFullReport()
    {
        isBusy = true;
        try
        {
            error = null;
            var user = await GetUserAsync();

            var report = await SharePointService.GetSystemDoctorReportAsync(
                user,
                deepGraphChecks: false);

            lastReport = report;
            lastReportMsText = $"{report.ElapsedMs} ms";
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            error = ex.Message;
        }
        finally
        {
            isBusy = false;
        }
    }

    private async Task RunDeepChecks()
    {
        isBusy = true;
        try
        {
            error = null;
            var user = await GetUserAsync();

            var report = await SharePointService.GetSystemDoctorReportAsync(
                user,
                deepGraphChecks: true);

            lastReport = report;
            lastReportMsText = $"{report.ElapsedMs} ms";
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            error = ex.Message;
        }
        finally
        {
            isBusy = false;
        }
    }

    private async Task<System.Security.Claims.ClaimsPrincipal> GetUserAsync()
    {
        if (AuthenticationStateTask is null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("AuthenticationState is not available.");

        var state = await AuthenticationStateTask;
        return state.User;
    }

    protected override void OnParametersSet()
    {
        // If refresh interval changed, restart timer
        StartOrRestartLoop();
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        loopCts?.Cancel();
        loopCts?.Dispose();
        timer?.Dispose();
    }

    // ---------- UI helpers ----------

    private RenderFragment Metric(string title, string value, string key, string iconSvg) => builder =>
    {
        var seq = 0;
        builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", "sd-metric glass2");
        builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", "sd-metric-icon");
        builder.AddMarkupContent(seq++, iconSvg);
        builder.CloseElement();
        builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", "sd-metric-body");
        builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", "sd-metric-title");
        builder.AddContent(seq++, title);
        builder.CloseElement();
        builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", "sd-metric-value");
        builder.AddContent(seq++, value);
        builder.CloseElement();
        builder.CloseElement();
        builder.CloseElement();
    };

    private RenderFragment KV(string k, string v) => builder =>
    {
        var seq = 0;
        builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", "sd-kv-row");
        builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", "sd-kv-k");
        builder.AddContent(seq++, k);
        builder.CloseElement();
        builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", "sd-kv-v");
        builder.AddContent(seq++, v);
        builder.CloseElement();
        builder.CloseElement();
    };

    private string BadgeClass(HealthStatus status) => status switch
    {
        HealthStatus.Critical => "sd-badge-critical",
        HealthStatus.Warning => "sd-badge-warning",
        _ => "sd-badge-healthy"
    };

    private static string GetCategoryIcon(string category) => category switch
    {
        "Graph" => Icons.Cloud,
        "Security" => Icons.Shield,
        "Runtime" => Icons.Activity,
        _ => Icons.Info
    };

    private static double AutoMax(IEnumerable<double> values)
    {
        var max = values.DefaultIfEmpty(1).Max();
        if (max <= 0) return 1;
        return max * 1.15;
    }

    private RenderFragment Sparkline(List<double> values, double min, double max, string stroke) => builder =>
    {
        var seq = 0;
        builder.OpenElement(seq++, "svg");
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", "sd-spark");
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "viewBox", "0 0 200 60");
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "preserveAspectRatio", "none");

        // grid
        builder.OpenElement(seq++, "path");
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "d", "M0 50 H200");
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", "sd-spark-grid");
        builder.CloseElement();

        var pts = BuildPoints(values, min, max, 200, 60, 6);
        builder.OpenElement(seq++, "polyline");
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "fill", "none");
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "stroke", stroke);
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "stroke-width", "2.5");
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "points", pts);
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", "sd-spark-line");
        builder.CloseElement();

        builder.CloseElement();
    };

    private static string BuildPoints(List<double> values, double min, double max, int width, int height, int pad)
    {
        if (values is null || values.Count == 0)
            return string.Empty;

        var w = width - pad * 2;
        var h = height - pad * 2;

        var denom = (max - min);
        if (denom <= 0) denom = 1;

        var step = values.Count == 1 ? 0 : (double)w / (values.Count - 1);

        return string.Join(" ",
            values.Select((v, i) =>
            {
                var x = pad + (step * i);
                var norm = (v - min) / denom;
                norm = Math.Clamp(norm, 0, 1);
                var y = pad + (h * (1 - norm));
                return $"{x:0.##},{y:0.##}";
            }));
    }

@code {
    private bool sidebarCollapsed = true;

    private string? _displayName;
    private string _rolesText = "";

    private void ToggleSidebar()
    {
        sidebarCollapsed = !sidebarCollapsed;
    }

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        var authState = await AuthenticationStateProvider.GetAuthenticationStateAsync();
        var user = authState.User;

        if (user.Identity?.IsAuthenticated == true)
        {
            _displayName = user.Identity.Name;

            var roles = user.Claims
                .Where(c => c.Type == System.Security.Claims.ClaimTypes.Role)
                .Select(c => c.Value)
                .ToList();

            _rolesText = roles.Count > 0 ? string.Join(", ", roles) : "";
        }
        else
        {
            _displayName = "Guest";
            _rolesText = "";
        }
    }

    private async Task Logout()
    {
        Navigation.NavigateTo("xlogin", true);
    }
}

    private bool sidebarCollapsed = true;

    private string? _displayName;
    private string _rolesText = "";

    private void ToggleSidebar()
    {
        sidebarCollapsed = !sidebarCollapsed;
    }

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        var authState = await AuthenticationStateProvider.GetAuthenticationStateAsync();
        var user = authState.User;

        if (user.Identity?.IsAuthenticated == true)
        {
            _displayName = user.Identity.Name;

            var roles = user.Claims
                .Where(c => c.Type == System.Security.Claims.ClaimTypes.Role)
                .Select(c => c.Value)
                .ToList();

            _rolesText = roles.Count > 0 ? string.Join(", ", roles) : "";
        }
        else
        {
            _displayName = "Guest";
            _rolesText = "";
        }
    }

    private async Task Logout()
    {
        Navigation.NavigateTo("xlogin", true);
    }

@code {

    private readonly List<string> UserRoles = new();
    private string RoleCssClass = "role-guest";

    private Dictionary<string, bool> groupState = new();

    private bool IsSysAdmin => UserRoles.Contains("SysAdmin");
    private bool IsAdmin => UserRoles.Contains("Admin");
    private bool IsUser => UserRoles.Contains("User");
    private bool IsStudent => UserRoles.Contains("Student");
    private bool IsTrainer => UserRoles.Contains("Trainer");
    private bool IsMarketing => UserRoles.Contains("Marketing");

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        var authState = await AuthenticationStateProvider.GetAuthenticationStateAsync();
        var user = authState.User;

        if (user.Identity?.IsAuthenticated == true)
        {
            UserRoles.AddRange(
                user.Claims
                    .Where(c => c.Type == ClaimTypes.Role)
                    .Select(c => c.Value)
            );

            if (IsSysAdmin) RoleCssClass = "role-sysadmin";
            else if (IsAdmin) RoleCssClass = "role-admin";
            else if (IsUser) RoleCssClass = "role-user";
            else if (IsMarketing) RoleCssClass = "role-marketing";
            else if (IsStudent) RoleCssClass = "role-student";
            else if (IsTrainer) RoleCssClass = "role-trainer";
        }
    }

    private void ToggleGroup(string key)
    {
        if (!groupState.ContainsKey(key))
            groupState[key] = true;

        groupState[key] = !groupState[key];
    }

    private bool IsGroupOpen(string key)
    {
        return !groupState.ContainsKey(key) || groupState[key];
    }

    private void Logout() => Navigation.NavigateTo("xlogin", true);

    private RenderFragment MenuGroup(string title, string key, IEnumerable<(string href, string icon, string text)> items) => builder =>
    {
        int seq = 0;

        builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", "menu-group");

        // HEADER
        builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", "menu-title clickable");
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "onclick", EventCallback.Factory.Create(this, () => ToggleGroup(key)));
        builder.AddContent(seq++, $"{title} {(IsGroupOpen(key) ? "▾" : "▸")}");
        builder.CloseElement();

        if (IsGroupOpen(key))
        {
            foreach (var item in items)
            {
                builder.OpenComponent<NavLink>(seq++);
                builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "href", item.href);
                builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", "nav-link");

                builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "ChildContent", (RenderFragment)(b =>
                {
                    b.OpenElement(0, "i");
                    b.AddAttribute(1, "class", $"bi {item.icon}");
                    b.CloseElement();

                    b.OpenElement(2, "span");
                    b.AddAttribute(3, "class", "menu-text");
                    b.AddContent(4, item.text);
                    b.CloseElement();
                }));

                builder.CloseComponent();
            }
        }

        builder.CloseElement();
    };

    private (string, string, string) NavItem(string href, string icon, string text)
        => (href, icon, text);
}

@using MITANZ360Edu.Web.Models
@using MITANZ360Edu.Web.Services
@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Authorization
@using System.Security.Claims
@using Radzen
@using Radzen.Blazor
@using Microsoft.JSInterop

@inject SharePointService SharePointService
@inject NavigationManager Navigation
@inject AuthenticationStateProvider AuthenticationStateProvider
@inject IJSRuntime JS

<!-- =====================================================
     RIGHT PANEL
===================================================== -->

<div class="right-panel">

    <div class="rp-grid">

        @if (NavigationCards.Any())
        {
            @foreach (var card in NavigationCards)
            {
                <RadzenCard class=@($@"
                                                rp-card
                                                {card.CardColor}
                                                {(SelectedUrl == card.Url
                                                                        ? "rp-active"
                                                                        : "")}
                                            ")>

                    <div class="rp-content"
                         @onclick="() => OpenCard(card)">

                        <!-- =====================================================
                             IMAGE / ICON
                        ====================================================== -->
                        @if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(card.ImageUrl))
                        {
                            <img src="@card.ImageUrl"
                                 class="rp-image"
                                 alt="@card.Title" />
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            <RadzenIcon Icon="@card.Icon"
                                        class="rp-icon" />
                        }

                        <!-- =====================================================
                             TITLE
                        ====================================================== -->

                        <div class="rp-title">

                            @card.Title

                        </div>

                        <!-- =====================================================
                             SUBTITLE
                        ====================================================== -->

                        <div class="rp-sub">

                            @card.Subtitle
                        </div>

                    </div>

                </RadzenCard>
            }
        }
        else
        {
            <div class="rp-empty">

                No navigation cards available
                for your assigned roles.

            </div>
        }

    </div>

</div>

@code {

    // =====================================================
    // DATA
    // =====================================================

    private List<NavigationCardModel>
        NavigationCards = [];

    // =====================================================
    // CURRENT USER ROLES
    // =====================================================

    private List<string>
        CurrentUserRoles = [];

    // =====================================================
    // ACTIVE CARD
    // =====================================================

    private string SelectedUrl = "";

    // =====================================================
    // INIT
    // =====================================================

    protected override async Task
        OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        SelectedUrl =
            Navigation.Uri;

        await LoadNavigationCardsAsync();
    }

    // =====================================================
    // LOAD NAVIGATION CARDS
    // =====================================================

    private async Task
        LoadNavigationCardsAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            // =====================================================
            // AUTH STATE
            // =====================================================

            var authState =
                await AuthenticationStateProvider
                    .GetAuthenticationStateAsync();

            var user =
                authState.User;

            // =====================================================
            // CURRENT USER ROLES
            // =====================================================

            CurrentUserRoles =
                user.Claims

                    .Where(x =>
                        x.Type ==
                        ClaimTypes.Role)

                    .Select(x =>
                        x.Value
                            .Trim()
                            .ToLower())

                    .Distinct()

                    .ToList();

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"USER ROLES: {string.Join(",", CurrentUserRoles)}");

            // =====================================================
            // LOAD ALL CARDS
            // =====================================================

            var allCards =
                await SharePointService
                    .GetNavigationCardsAsync();

            // =====================================================
            // FILTER CARDS
            // =====================================================

            NavigationCards =
                allCards
                    .Where(card =>
                    {
                        // =====================================================
                        // ENABLED ONLY
                        // =====================================================

                        if (!card.IsEnabled)
                        {
                            return false;
                        }

                        // =====================================================
                        // PUBLIC CARD
                        // =====================================================

                        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                            card.Role))
                        {
                            return true;
                        }

                        // =====================================================
                        // CARD ROLES
                        // =====================================================

                        var cardRoles =
                            (card.Role ?? "")

                                .Replace("\n", "")
                                .Replace("\r", "")

                                .Split(
                                    new[] { ',', ';' },
                                    StringSplitOptions
                                        .RemoveEmptyEntries)

                                .Select(x =>
                                    x.Trim().ToLower())

                                .Distinct()

                                .ToList();

                        Console.WriteLine(
                            $"CARD: {card.Title} | ROLES: {string.Join(",", cardRoles)}");

                        // =====================================================
                        // GUEST
                        // GUEST = ANY AUTHENTICATED USER
                        // =====================================================

                        if (cardRoles.Contains("guest"))
                        {
                            return true;
                        }

                        // =====================================================
                        // MATCH ANY ROLE
                        // =====================================================

                        return CurrentUserRoles
                            .Intersect(cardRoles)
                            .Any();
                    })

                    .OrderBy(x =>
                        x.SortOrder)

                    .ToList();

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"VISIBLE CARDS: {NavigationCards.Count}");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(
                $"Navigation card error: {ex.Message}");

            Console.WriteLine(ex);
        }
    }

    // =====================================================
    // OPEN CARD
    // =====================================================

    private async Task
        OpenCard(
            NavigationCardModel card)
    {
        // =====================================================
        // ACTIVE CARD
        // =====================================================

        SelectedUrl =
            card.Url ?? "";

        StateHasChanged();

        // =====================================================
        // URL CHECK
        // =====================================================

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
            card.Url))
        {
            return;
        }

        // =====================================================
        // EXTERNAL URL
        // OPEN NEW TAB
        // =====================================================

        if ((card.OpenType ?? "")
            .Equals(
                "External",
                StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync(
                "open",
                card.Url,
                "_blank");

            return;
        }

        // =====================================================
        // INTERNAL URL
        // =====================================================

        Navigation.NavigateTo(
            card.Url);
    }
}

@using System.Text.Json
@using MITANZ360Edu.Web.Services
@using Radzen
@using Radzen.Blazor

<RadzenCard Style="border-radius:24px;padding:24px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.62);">

    <RadzenStack Gap="10px">

        <RadzenText TextStyle="TextStyle.H5" Style="font-weight:700;color:#004578;">
            Activity
        </RadzenText>

        <RadzenDropDown Data="@Types"
                        @bind-Value="Model.Type"
                        Style="width:100%;" title="Activity Type"/>

        <RadzenTextBox @bind-Value="Model.Title"
                       Placeholder="Activity Title"
                       Style="width:100%;" title="Activity Title" />

        <RadzenTextArea @bind-Value="Model.Description"
                        Rows="3"
                        Style="width:100%;" title="Description" />

        <RadzenTextBox @bind-Value="Model.Url"
                       Placeholder="URL"
                       Style="width:100%;" title="Activity URL (Int/Ex)" />

        <RadzenNumeric @bind-Value="Model.DurationMinutes"
                       Style="width:100%;" title="Duration in Minutes" />

        <RadzenNumeric @bind-Value="Model.PassingScore"
                       Style="width:100%;" title="Passing Score" />

        <RadzenSwitch @bind-Value="Model.IsMandatory" title="On - Mandatory" />

        <!-- ✅ ONLY SAVE BUTTON -->
        <RadzenButton Text="Apply Activity"
                      Icon="save"
                      ButtonStyle="ButtonStyle.Primary"
                      Click="@Apply" title="Save changes" />

    </RadzenStack>

</RadzenCard>

@code {

    [Parameter] public string Value { get; set; } = "";
    [Parameter] public EventCallback<string> ValueChanged { get; set; }

    private ActMetadata Model = new();

    private List<string> Types = new()
    {
        "reading","video","quiz","group","lab","assignment"
    };

    protected override void OnParametersSet()
    {
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Value))
        {
            try
            {
                Model = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ActMetadata>(Value) ?? new();
            }
            catch
            {
                Model = new();
            }
        }
    }

    private async Task Apply()
    {
        var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(Model, new JsonSerializerOptions
        {
            WriteIndented = true
        });

        await ValueChanged.InvokeAsync(json);
    }
}

@code {
    private bool sidebarCollapsed = true;

    private string? _displayName;
    private string _rolesText = "";

    private void ToggleSidebar()
    {
        sidebarCollapsed = !sidebarCollapsed;
    }

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        var authState = await AuthenticationStateProvider.GetAuthenticationStateAsync();
        var user = authState.User;

        if (user.Identity?.IsAuthenticated == true)
        {
            _displayName = user.Identity.Name;

            var roles = user.Claims
                .Where(c => c.Type == System.Security.Claims.ClaimTypes.Role)
                .Select(c => c.Value)
                .ToList();

            _rolesText = roles.Count > 0 ? string.Join(", ", roles) : "";
        }
        else
        {
            _displayName = "Guest";
            _rolesText = "";
        }
    }

    private async Task Logout()
    {
        Navigation.NavigateTo("xlogin", true);
    }
}

@code {

    [Parameter] public string ItemId { get; set; } = "";

    private string FileUrl = "";

    protected override void OnInitialized()
    {
        // ✅ Always use streaming endpoint
        FileUrl = $"/api/files/{ItemId}";
    }

    private void GoBack()
    {
        Nav.NavigateTo("/lms-library-introduction");
    }

    private void Reload()
    {
        FileUrl = $"/api/files/{ItemId}?t={DateTime.Now.Ticks}";
    }

    private void OpenInNewTab()
    {
        Nav.NavigateTo($"/api/files/{ItemId}", true);
    }

    private void Download()
    {
        Nav.NavigateTo($"/api/files/{ItemId}?download=true", true);
    }
}

            Home / @CurrentFolder?.Name
        </div>

        <div class="sp-actions">
            <button class="sp-btn primary" @onclick="OpenNewFolderDialog">New</button>

        </div>

    </div>

    <!-- ================= WORKSPACE ================= -->
    <div class="sp-layout">

        <!-- ================= LEFT: FOLDER TREE ================= -->
        <div class="sp-left">

            @foreach (var item in RootItems)
            {
                @RenderTreeItem(item, 0)
            }

        </div>

        <!-- ================= RIGHT: FILE CONTENT ================= -->
        <div class="sp-right-content">

            @if (CurrentFolder == null)
            {
                <div class="sp-empty">Select a folder</div>
            }
            else if (!FolderChildren.ContainsKey(CurrentFolder.Id))
            {
                <div class="sp-empty">Loading...</div>
            }
            else
            {
                var items = FolderChildren[CurrentFolder.Id];

                <div class="sp-file-grid">

                    @foreach (var file in items.Where(x => !x.IsFolder))
                    {
                        <div class="sp-tile"
                             tabindex="0"
                             @onclick="() => SelectItemAsync(file)">

                            <div class="sp-tile-icon">
                                @((MarkupString)GetFileIconSvg(file.Name))
                            </div>

                            <div class="sp-tile-name">
                                @file.Name
                            </div>

                        </div>
                    }

                </div>
            }

        </div>

    </div>

</div>

@code {

    // ================= STATE =================

    private LibraryItem? CurrentFolder;

    private List<LibraryItem> RootItems = new();

    private Dictionary<string, List<LibraryItem>> FolderChildren = new();

    protected override void OnInitialized()
    {
        LoadSampleData();
    }

    // ================= DATA =================

    private void LoadSampleData()
    {
        var module = new LibraryItem { Name = "Module 1", IsFolder = true };
        var course = new LibraryItem { Name = "AZ900-104", IsFolder = true };
        var root = new LibraryItem { Name = "Courses", IsFolder = true };

        RootItems.Add(root);

        FolderChildren[root.Id] = new() { course };
        FolderChildren[course.Id] = new() { module };

        FolderChildren[module.Id] = new()
        {
            new LibraryItem { Name = "File.pdf" },
            new LibraryItem { Name = "Notes.docx" },
            new LibraryItem { Name = "Excel.xlsx" }
        };

        CurrentFolder = root;
    }

    // ================= ACTIONS =================

    private async Task RefreshAsync()
    {
        await Task.Delay(50);
    }

    private async Task SelectItemAsync(LibraryItem item)
    {
        if (item.IsFolder)
        {
            CurrentFolder = item;
        }

        await Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private void OpenNewFolderDialog() { }
    private void OpenUploadDialog() { }

    // ================= TREE (FOLDERS ONLY) =================

    private RenderFragment RenderTreeItem(LibraryItem item, int depth)
        => builder =>
        {
            if (!item.IsFolder) return;

            var seq = 0;

            builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
            builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "style", $"padding-left:{depth * 16}px");

            builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
            builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", "sp-tree-item");
            builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "onclick",
                EventCallback.Factory.Create(this, () => SelectItemAsync(item)));

            builder.AddContent(seq++, item.Name);
            builder.CloseElement();

            if (FolderChildren.ContainsKey(item.Id))
            {
                foreach (var child in FolderChildren[item.Id]
                         .Where(x => x.IsFolder)) // ✅ CRITICAL FIX
                {
                    builder.AddContent(seq++, RenderTreeItem(child, depth + 1));
                }
            }

            builder.CloseElement();
        };

    // ================= FILE ICON =================

    private string GetFileIconSvg(string? name)
    {
        var ext = Path.GetExtension(name ?? "").ToLower();

        return ext switch
        {
            ".pdf" => Icon.File("PDF", "#C4314B"),
            ".docx" => Icon.File("W", "#185ABD"),
            ".xlsx" => Icon.File("X", "#107C41"),
            ".pptx" => Icon.File("P", "#C43E1C"),
            _ => Icon.File("DOC", "#605E5C")
        };
    }

    // ================= MODEL =================

    public class LibraryItem
    {
        public string Id { get; set; } = Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
        public string Name { get; set; } = "";
        public bool IsFolder { get; set; }
    }

    // ================= ICON =================

    private static class Icon
    {
        public static string File(string text, string color)
            => $"<div style='width:32px;height:32px;background:{color};color:white;font-size:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-radius:6px'>{text}</div>";
    }

}

    .sp-layout {
        display: flex;
        height: calc(100vh - 110px);
        background: #FFFFFF;
    }

    /* ================= LEFT ================= */

    .sp-left {
        width: 260px;
        border-right: 1px solid #E1E1E1;
        background: #FFFFFF;
        padding: 8px;
    }

    /* ================= RIGHT ================= */

    .sp-right-content {
        flex: 1;
        padding: 16px;
    }

    /* ================= TREE ================= */
</style>

                                @GetFileTypeIcon() @GetFileTypeLabel()
                            </span>

                    <div class="quick-info-row">
                        <span class="qi-label">Size</span>
                        <span class="qi-value">@FormatFileSize(Item.Size)</span>

                        <span class="qi-label">Modified</span>
                        <span class="qi-value">@Item.LastModified?.ToString("dd MMM yyyy")</span>

@code {

    [Parameter] public string ItemId { get; set; } = "";

    // ✅ Inject Configuration directly (clean solution)
    [Inject] IConfiguration Config { get; set; } = default!;

    private string DriveId = "";

    private LibraryItem? Item;
    private ActMetadata ActMeta = new();

    private bool isLoading = true;
    private bool isSaving = false;
    private bool isDeleting = false;
    private bool showDeleteConfirm = false;

    private string StatusMessage = "";
    private string StatusClass = "info";
    private string StatusIcon = "ℹ️";

    private DateTime? LastSavedAt;

    private int MetaTab = 0;

    private string JsonValidationMsg = "";
    private string JsonValidationClass = "info";

    List<CourseModel> courses = new();
    List<CourseDropdownDto> courseDropdownList = new();

    // ✅ INIT
    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            isLoading = true;

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ItemId))
            {
                SetStatus("❌ Invalid item URL.", "error");
                return;
            }

            DriveId = Config["SharePoint:Libraries:LMS:DriveId"];

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(DriveId))
            {
                SetStatus("❌ DriveId missing in config.", "error");
                return;
            }

            // ✅ Load item
            Item = await _spService.GetItemAsync(DriveId, ItemId);

            if (Item == null)
            {
                SetStatus("❌ Item not found.", "error");
                return;
            }

            // ✅ EXISTING LOGIC
            ParseActMeta();

            // ✅ ✅ ✅ ADD THIS BLOCK (Course Dropdown)

            courses = (await _spService.GetCoursesAsync()).ToList();

            courses = (await _spService.GetCoursesAsync())
                .Where(c => !c.Archived && c.CourseStatus == "Active")
                .ToList();


            courseDropdownList = courses.Select(c => new CourseDropdownDto
            {
                Id = c.Id,
                Code = c.CourseCode,
                Display = $"{c.CourseCode} - {c.Title}"
            }).ToList();

        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            SetStatus($"❌ Load error: {ex.Message}", "error");
        }
        finally
        {
            isLoading = false;
        }
    }
    // ✅ SAVE
    private async Task SaveChangesAsync()
    {
        if (Item == null) return;

        try
        {
            isSaving = true;
            StatusMessage = "";

            SyncActMetaToJson();

            // ✅ ✅ ADD HERE (THIS IS THE FIX)
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Item.ContentId))
            {
                Item.ContentId = GenerateCONTref();
            }

            // ✅ Save AFTER assigning ID
            await _spService.UpdateLibraryItemFullAsync(DriveId, ItemId, Item);

            LastSavedAt = DateTime.Now;
            SetStatus("✅ Saved successfully.", "success");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            SetStatus($"❌ Save failed: {ex.Message}", "error");
        }
        finally
        {
            isSaving = false;
        }
    }
    // ✅ DELETE
    private async Task DeleteItemAsync()
    {
        if (Item == null) return;

        try
        {
            isDeleting = true;
            showDeleteConfirm = false;

            await _spService.DeleteItemAsync(DriveId, ItemId);

            Nav.NavigateTo("/lms-library?deleted=1");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            SetStatus($"❌ Delete failed: {ex.Message}", "error");
        }
        finally
        {
            isDeleting = false;
        }
    }

    // ✅ QUICK ACTIONS
    private async Task TogglePublishAsync()
    {
        if (Item == null) return;
        Item.IsPublished = !Item.IsPublished;
        await SaveChangesAsync();
    }

    private async Task ToggleArchiveAsync()
    {
        if (Item == null) return;
        Item.IsArchived = !Item.IsArchived;
        await SaveChangesAsync();
    }

    private void CancelEdit() => Nav.NavigateTo("/lms-library");

    private async Task OpenOnlineAsync()
    {
        if (Item == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(Item.WebUrl)) return;
        await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("open", Item.WebUrl, "_blank");
    }

    private async Task CopyItemIdToClipboard()
    {
        if (Item == null) return;
        await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("navigator.clipboard.writeText", Item.Id);
        SetStatus("✅ Copied.", "success");
    }

    // ✅ ACT META
    private void ParseActMeta()
    {
        if (Item == null || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Item.ACTMetaJson))
        {
            ActMeta = new();
            return;
        }

        try
        {
            ActMeta = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ActMetadata>(
                Item.ACTMetaJson,
                new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true }
            ) ?? new();
        }
        catch { ActMeta = new(); }
    }

    private void SyncActMetaToJson()
    {
        if (Item == null) return;

        try
        {
            Item.ACTMetaJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(ActMeta);
        }
        catch { }
    }

    // ✅ JSON
    private void FormatMetadataJson()
    {
        if (Item == null) return;

        try
        {
            var parsed = JsonDocument.Parse(Item.MetadataJson ?? "{}");
            Item.MetadataJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(parsed, new JsonSerializerOptions { WriteIndented = true });

            JsonValidationMsg = "✅ JSON formatted.";
            JsonValidationClass = "success";
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            JsonValidationMsg = $"❌ Invalid JSON: {ex.Message}";
            JsonValidationClass = "error";
        }
    }

    private void ValidateMetadataJson()
    {
        if (Item == null) return;

        try
        {
            JsonDocument.Parse(Item.MetadataJson ?? "{}");

            JsonValidationMsg = "✅ Valid JSON.";
            JsonValidationClass = "success";
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            JsonValidationMsg = $"❌ Invalid JSON: {ex.Message}";
            JsonValidationClass = "error";
        }
    }

    // ✅ UI HELPERS
    private void SetStatus(string message, string type)
    {
        StatusMessage = message;
        StatusClass = type;
        StatusIcon = type switch
        {
            "success" => "✅",
            "error" => "⛔",
            _ => "ℹ️"
        };
    }

    private string GetPublishStatusClass() =>
        Item?.IsArchived == true ? "archived" :
        Item?.IsPublished == true ? "published" : "unpublished";

    private string GetPublishStatusLabel() =>
        Item?.IsArchived == true ? "Archived" :
        Item?.IsPublished == true ? "Published" : "Draft";

    private string GetPublishBannerClass() =>
        Item?.IsArchived == true ? "archived" :
        Item?.IsPublished == true ? "" : "unpublished";

    private string GetPublishBannerIcon() =>
        Item?.IsArchived == true ? "🗄" :
        Item?.IsPublished == true ? "✅" : "⏳";

    private string GetPublishBannerSub() =>
        Item?.IsArchived == true ? "Archived" :
        Item?.IsPublished == true ? "Visible" :
        "Draft";

    // ✅ FILE TYPE
    private string GetFileTypeCss()
    {
        var mime = Item?.ContentType?.ToLower() ?? "";
        if (Item?.IsFolder == true) return "ft-folder";
        if (mime.Contains("pdf")) return "ft-pdf";
        if (mime.Contains("word")) return "ft-word";
        if (mime.Contains("excel")) return "ft-excel";
        if (mime.Contains("powerpoint")) return "ft-ppt";
        if (mime.Contains("video")) return "ft-video";
        if (mime.Contains("image")) return "ft-image";
        return "ft-other";
    }

    private string GetFileTypeIcon()
    {
        if (Item?.IsFolder == true) return "📁";
        var mime = Item?.ContentType?.ToLower() ?? "";
        if (mime.Contains("pdf")) return "📕";
        if (mime.Contains("word")) return "📘";
        if (mime.Contains("excel")) return "📗";
        if (mime.Contains("powerpoint")) return "📙";
        if (mime.Contains("video")) return "🎬";
        if (mime.Contains("image")) return "🖼️";
        return "📄";
    }

    private string GetFileTypeLabel()
    {
        if (Item?.IsFolder == true) return "Folder";
        var mime = Item?.ContentType?.ToLower() ?? "";
        if (mime.Contains("pdf")) return "PDF";
        if (mime.Contains("word")) return "Word";
        if (mime.Contains("excel")) return "Excel";
        if (mime.Contains("powerpoint")) return "PowerPoint";
        if (mime.Contains("video")) return "Video";
        if (mime.Contains("image")) return "Image";
        return "File";
    }

    private string GetActTypeIcon(string? type) => type?.ToLower() switch
    {
        "reading" => "📖",
        "video" => "🎬",
        "quiz" => "✅",
        "group" => "👥",
        "lab" => "🧪",
        "assignment" => "📝",
        _ => "📄"
    };

    private string FormatFileSize(long bytes)
    {
        if (bytes <= 0) return "—";
        if (bytes < 1024) return $"{bytes} B";
        if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return $"{bytes / 1024.0:F1} KB";
        return $"{bytes / (1024.0 * 1024):F2} MB";
    }

    private async Task ViewDocument()
    {
        await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("open", $"/api/files/{ItemId}", "_blank");
    }
    
    public class CourseDropdownDto
    {
        public int Id { get; set; }
        public string Code { get; set; }
        public string Display { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }

    public string GenerateCONTref()
    {
        var now = DateTime.UtcNow;

        return $"CONT-{now:yyyy-ddHHmmssfff}";
    }

    private void OnCourseChanged(object value)
    {
        if (Item == null) return;

        var selectedCode = value?.ToString();

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(selectedCode)) return;

        var course = courses.FirstOrDefault(c => c.CourseCode == selectedCode);

        if (course == null) return;

        // ✅ Create metadata JSON object
        var meta = new
        {
            courseDescription = StripHtml(course.Description),
            courseTitle = course.Title,
            courseCode = course.CourseCode
        };

        // ✅ Save to EXT_Metadata
        Item.MetadataJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(meta, new JsonSerializerOptions
        {
            WriteIndented = true
        });
    }

    private string StripHtml(string? html)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(html)) return "";

        // ✅ Remove HTML tags
        var text = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(html, "<.*?>", string.Empty);

        // ✅ Decode HTML entities (&nbsp;, &#128216;, etc.)
        text = System.Net.WebUtility.HtmlDecode(text);

        // ✅ Optional: normalize spaces
        text = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(text, @"\s+", " ").Trim();

        return text;
    }
}

    [Parameter] public string MetadataJson { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    private string FormattedJson = "{}";

    protected override void OnParametersSet()
    {
        try
        {
            var parsed = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<object>(MetadataJson ?? "{}");

            FormattedJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(parsed, new JsonSerializerOptions
            {
                WriteIndented = true
            });
        }
        catch
        {
            // fallback if invalid JSON
            FormattedJson = MetadataJson ?? "";
        }
    }

    // ✅ STYLES (match your screenshot)

@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components

<div style="position:fixed;bottom:10px;right:10px;
            background:#111;color:#fff;padding:12px;
            border-radius:8px;font-size:12px;z-index:9999;
            width:220px">

    <b>Blazor Debug</b>

    <div>Clicks: @clickCount</div>
    <div>Status: @(isInteractive ? "✅ Interactive" : "❌ NOT Interactive")</div>

    <button style="margin-top:8px;width:100%"
            @onclick="TestClick">
        Test Click
    </button>

</div>

@code {
    private int clickCount = 0;
    private bool isInteractive = false;

    protected override void OnAfterRender(bool firstRender)
    {
        if (firstRender)
        {
            // If this runs → Blazor circuit is alive
            isInteractive = true;
            StateHasChanged();
        }
    }

    private void TestClick()
    {
        clickCount++;
        Console.WriteLine("DEBUG CLICK WORKING");
    }
}
====================================================================
END FILE

Components\Pages\ConfirmDeleteDialog.razor

@using Radzen

<div>
    <p>
        You are about to permanently delete
        <strong>@Title</strong>.
    </p>

    <p style="color:#b91c1c; font-weight:600;">
        Type <code>DELETE</code> to confirm.
    </p>

    <RadzenTextBox @bind-Value="Input"
                   Placeholder="Type DELETE"
                   Style="width:100%; margin-top:10px" />

    <div style="display:flex; justify-content:flex-end; gap:10px; margin-top:20px;">
        <RadzenButton Text="Cancel"
                      ButtonStyle="ButtonStyle.Light"
                      Click="@(() => DialogService.Close(false))" />

        <RadzenButton Text="Delete"
                      ButtonStyle="ButtonStyle.Danger"
                      Disabled="@IsDisabled"
                      Click="@(() => DialogService.Close(true))" />
    </div>
</div>

@code {
    [Parameter] public string Title { get; set; } = "this item";

    private string Input = string.Empty;

    private bool IsDisabled =>
        !string.Equals(
            Input?.Trim(),
            "DELETE",
            StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase
        );

    [Inject] DialogService DialogService { get; set; } = default!;
}

                                @successMessage
                            </div>
                        }

                        @if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(errorMessage))
                        {
                            <div class="alert alert-danger py-2 px-3 rounded-3 mb-3">
                                @errorMessage
                            </div>
                        }

                        <EditForm Model="@model" OnValidSubmit="@SubmitAsync">
                            <DataAnnotationsValidator />
                            <ValidationSummary />

                            <div class="mb-3">
                                <label class="form-label">Full Name</label>
                                <InputText class="form-control"
                                           @bind-Value="model.FullName" />
                            </div>

                            <div class="mb-3">
                                <label class="form-label">Email Address</label>
                                <InputText class="form-control"
                                           @bind-Value="model.Email" />
                            </div>

                            <div class="mb-3">
                                <label class="form-label">Problem Category</label>
                                <InputSelect class="form-select"
                                             @bind-Value="model.Category">
                                    @foreach (var c in Categories)
                                    {
                                        <option value="@c">@c</option>
                                    }
                                </InputSelect>
                            </div>

                            <div class="mb-3">
                                <label class="form-label">Subject</label>
                                <InputText class="form-control"
                                           @bind-Value="model.Subject" />
                            </div>

                            <div class="mb-3">
                                <label class="form-label">Message</label>
                                <InputTextArea class="form-control"
                                               rows="4"
                                               @bind-Value="model.Message" />
                            </div>

                            <div class="mb-3 form-check">
                                <InputCheckbox class="form-check-input"
                                               @bind-Value="model.SendCopyToUser" />
                                <label class="form-check-label">
                                    Send me a copy
                                </label>
                            </div>

                            <button class="btn btn-success w-100 py-2 rounded-3"
                                    disabled="@isSubmitting">
                                @(isSubmitting ? "Sending…" : "Send Message")
                            </button>
                        </EditForm>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- RIGHT PANEL -->
                <div class="col-lg-5 bg-black text-white right-pane">
                    <div class="p-4 h-100">

                        <h5 class="fw-bold mb-1">@App.Name</h5>
                        <p class="text-secondary mb-3">@Client.ClientName</p>

                        <hr class="border-secondary mb-3" />

                        <div class="mb-2">
                            <small>ENVIRONMENT</small>
                            <div class="value">@App.Environment</div>
                        </div>

                        <div class="mb-2">
                            <small>VERSION</small>
                            <div class="value">@App.Version</div>
                        </div>

                        <div class="mb-2">
                            <small>COMPANY</small>
                            <div class="value">@App.Company</div>
                        </div>

                        <div class="mb-2">
                            <small>SUPPORT EMAIL</small>
                            <div class="value">@App.SupportEmail</div>
                        </div>

                        <div class="mb-2">
                            <small>SUPPORT PHONE</small>
                            <div class="value">@App.SupportPhone</div>
                        </div>

                        <div>
                            <small>CLIENT REGION</small>
                            <div class="value">@Client.Region</div>
                        </div>

                    </div>
                </div>

            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

@code {
    private readonly List<string> Categories =
    [
        "General Inquiry",
        "Login / Account Access",
        "Technical Issue",
        "Billing",
        "Feedback",
        "Other"
    ];

    private ContactModel model = new();
    private bool isSubmitting;
    private string? successMessage;
    private string? errorMessage;

    private ApplicationInfo App => Configuration.GetSection("Application").Get<ApplicationInfo>()!;
    private ClientInfo Client => Configuration.GetSection("Client").Get<ClientInfo>()!;

    private async Task SubmitAsync()
    {
        isSubmitting = true;
        successMessage = errorMessage = null;

        try
        {
            await GraphMailService.SendMailAsync(new GraphMailRequest
            {
                Subject = $"[{model.Category}] {model.Subject}",
                Body = model.Message,
                To = [Configuration["EmailSettings:AdminEmail"]!],
                Cc = model.SendCopyToUser ? [model.Email] : [],
                ReplyTo = model.Email
            });

            successMessage = "Your message has been sent successfully.";
            model = new();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Logger.LogError(ex, "CONTACT FAILED");
            errorMessage = "Unable to send message.";
        }
        finally
        {
            isSubmitting = false;
        }
    }

    public class ContactModel
    {
        [Required] public string FullName { get; set; } = "";
        [Required, EmailAddress] public string Email { get; set; } = "";
        public string Category { get; set; } = "General Inquiry";
        [Required] public string Subject { get; set; } = "";
        [Required] public string Message { get; set; } = "";
        public bool SendCopyToUser { get; set; } = true;
    }

    public record ApplicationInfo(
        string Name,
        string ShortName,
        string Version,
        string Environment,
        string Company,
        string Website,
        string SupportEmail,
        string SupportPhone);

    public record ClientInfo(
        string ClientName,
        string ClientCode,
        string Region);
}
====================================================================
END FILE

<PageTitle>Error</PageTitle>

@if (ShowRequestId)
{
    <p>
        <strong>Request ID:</strong> <code>@RequestId</code>
    </p>
}

<h3>Development Mode</h3>
<p>
    Swapping to <strong>Development</strong> environment will display more detailed information about the error that occurred.
</p>
<p>
    <strong>The Development environment shouldn't be enabled for deployed applications.</strong>
    It can result in displaying sensitive information from exceptions to end users.
    For local debugging, enable the <strong>Development</strong> environment by setting the <strong>ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT</strong> environment variable to <strong>Development</strong>
    and restarting the app.
</p>

@code{
    [CascadingParameter]
    private HttpContext? HttpContext { get; set; }

    private string? RequestId { get; set; }
    private bool ShowRequestId => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(RequestId);

    protected override void OnInitialized() =>
        RequestId = Activity.Current?.Id ?? HttpContext?.TraceIdentifier;
}

@page "/App-Info-viewer-admin"
@layout MainLayout_NoRightPan
@attribute [Authorize(Roles = "Admin,SysAdmin")]

@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components
@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Forms

@inject IWebHostEnvironment Environment
@inject NavigationManager Navigation

<PageTitle>Enterprise Document Viewer</PageTitle>

<div class="doc-layout">

    <!-- SIDEBAR -->

    <aside class="sidebar-panel">

        <!-- HEADER -->

        <div class="sidebar-header">

            <div class="sidebar-logo">
                🏢
            </div>

            <div class="sidebar-info">
                <h2>Information Hub</h2>

            </div>

        </div>

        <!-- DOCUMENTS -->

        <div class="nav-section">

            <div class="nav-section-title">
                🧠 Knowledge, intelligence.
            </div>

            @if (Files.Any())
            {
                @foreach (var file in Files)
                {
                    <div class="document-item">

                        <button class="nav-item"
                                title="@file"
                                @onclick='async () => await LoadDocument(file)'>
                                <span class="file-text">
                                    @GetFileIcon(file)
                                    @Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(file)
                                </span>
                        </button>

                        <a class="download-mini-button"
                               href="@($"/Files/{file}")"
                               download
                               title="Download">
                            📥
                        </a>

                        @if (!ProtectedFiles.Contains(
                                 file,
                                 StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        {
                            <button class="delete-button"
                                    title="Delete"
                                    @onclick='() => ConfirmDelete(file)'>
                                ❌
                            </button>
                        }

                    </div>
                }
            }
            else
            {
                <div class="empty-message">
