@code {

    private string HtmlContent = "";

    private string CurrentFile = "";

    private List<string> Files = new();

    private string? PendingDeleteFile;

    private readonly List<string> ProtectedFiles =
    [
        "about.html",
        "home.html",
        "index.html",
        "admin-guide.html"
    ];

    private readonly List<string> SupportedExtensions =
    [
        ".html",
        ".htm",
        ".pdf",
        ".png",
        ".jpg",
        ".jpeg",
        ".webp",
        ".gif",
        ".mp4",
        ".webm",
        ".txt",
        ".docx",
        ".xlsx",
        ".json",
        ".pptx"
    ];

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await LoadFiles();
    }

    private async Task LoadFiles()
    {
        try
        {
            var filesPath = Path.Combine(
                Environment.WebRootPath,
                "Files");

            if (!Directory.Exists(filesPath))
            {
                Directory.CreateDirectory(filesPath);
            }

            Files = Directory
                .GetFiles(filesPath)
                .Where(file =>
                    SupportedExtensions.Contains(
                        Path.GetExtension(file),
                        StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                .Select(Path.GetFileName)
                .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x))
                .OrderBy(x => x)
                .ToList()!;

            if (Files.Any())
            {
                await LoadDocument(Files.First()!);
            }
            else
            {
                HtmlContent =
                    "<div class='system-message'>No documents available.</div>";
            }
        }
        catch
        {
            HtmlContent =
                "<div class='system-message'>Failed to initialize document center.</div>";
        }
    }

    private async Task LoadDocument(string file)
    {
        try
        {
            CurrentFile = file;

            var extension =
                Path.GetExtension(file)
                    .ToLowerInvariant();

            var fileUrl =
                $"/Files/{file}";

            var filePath = Path.Combine(
                Environment.WebRootPath,
                "Files",
                file);

            switch (extension)
            {
                case ".html":
                case ".htm":

                    HtmlContent =
                        await File.ReadAllTextAsync(filePath);

                    break;

                case ".pdf":

                    HtmlContent = $@"
                    <iframe
                        src='{fileUrl}'
                        style='width:100%;
                               height:100%;
                               border:none;'>
                    </iframe>";

                    break;

                case ".png":
                case ".jpg":
                case ".jpeg":
                case ".webp":
                case ".gif":

                    HtmlContent = $@"
                    <div style='padding:20px;text-align:center;'>

                        <img src='{fileUrl}'
                             style='max-width:100%;
                                    border-radius:18px;' />

                    </div>";

                    break;

                case ".mp4":
                case ".webm":

                    HtmlContent = $@"
                    <div style='padding:20px;'>

                        <video controls style='width:100%;border-radius:18px;'>

                            <source src='{fileUrl}'>

                        </video>

                    </div>";

                    break;

                case ".txt":
                case ".json":

                    HtmlContent =
                        "<pre style='padding:20px;'>" +
                        await File.ReadAllTextAsync(filePath) +
                        "</pre>";

                    break;

                case ".docx":
                case ".xlsx":
                case ".csv":
                case ".pptx":

                    HtmlContent = $@"
                    <div style='padding:40px;'>

                        <h2>📥 Download Document</h2>

                        <a href='{fileUrl}' target='_blank' style='font-size:18px;'>
                            Open File
                        </a>

                    </div>";

                    break;

                default:

                    HtmlContent =
                        "<div class='system-message'>Unsupported file type.</div>";
                    break;
            }
        }
        catch
        {
            HtmlContent =
                "<div class='system-message'>Failed to load document.</div>";
        }
    }

    private async Task UploadFile(InputFileChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        try
        {
            var file = e.File;

            if (file is null)
            {
                return;
            }

            var extension =
                Path.GetExtension(file.Name);

            if (!SupportedExtensions.Contains(
                    extension,
                    StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                HtmlContent =
                    "<div class='system-message'>Unsupported file type.</div>";

                return;
            }

            var fileName =
                Path.GetFileName(file.Name);

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(fileName))
            {
                return;
            }

            var filesPath = Path.Combine(
                Environment.WebRootPath,
                "Files");

            var savePath = Path.Combine(
                filesPath,
                fileName);

            await using var stream =
                File.Create(savePath);

            await file.OpenReadStream(
                50 * 1024 * 1024)
                .CopyToAsync(stream);

            await LoadFiles();

            await LoadDocument(fileName);
        }
        catch
        {
            HtmlContent =
                "<div class='system-message'>File upload failed.</div>";
        }
    }

    private void ConfirmDelete(string file)
    {
        PendingDeleteFile = file;
    }

    private void CancelDelete()
    {
        PendingDeleteFile = null;
    }

    private async Task DeleteFile()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(PendingDeleteFile))
        {
            return;
        }

        try
        {
            var filePath = Path.Combine(Environment.WebRootPath,"Files",PendingDeleteFile);

            if (File.Exists(filePath))
            {
                File.Delete(filePath);
            }

            PendingDeleteFile = null;

            await LoadFiles();
        }
        catch
        {
            HtmlContent ="<div class='system-message'>Failed to delete file.</div>";
        }
    }

    private string GetFileIcon(string file)
    {
        var extension =
            Path.GetExtension(file)
                .ToLowerInvariant();

        return extension switch
        {
            ".html" or ".htm" => "🌐 ",
            ".pdf" => "📕 ",
            ".png" or ".jpg" or ".jpeg" or ".webp" or ".gif" => "🖼️ ",
            ".mp4" or ".webm" => "🎥 ",
            ".txt" or ".json" => "📄 ",
            ".docx" => "📝 ",
            ".xlsx" or ".csv" => "📊 ",
            ".pptx" => "📽️ ",
            _ => "📁 "
        };
    }

    private void GoHome()
    {
        Navigation.NavigateTo("/");
    }

}

    private string HtmlContent = "";

    private string CurrentFile = "";

    private List<string> Files = new();

    private string? PendingDeleteFile;

    private readonly List<string> ProtectedFiles =
    [
        "about.html",
        "home.html",
        "index.html",
        "admin-guide.html"
    ];

    private readonly List<string> SupportedExtensions =
    [
        ".html",
        ".htm",
        ".pdf",
        ".png",
        ".jpg",
        ".jpeg",
        ".webp",
        ".gif",
        ".mp4",
        ".webm",
        ".txt",
        ".docx",
        ".xlsx",
        ".json",
        ".pptx"
    ];

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await LoadFiles();
    }

    private async Task LoadFiles()
    {
        try
        {
            var filesPath = Path.Combine(
                Environment.WebRootPath,
                "Files");

            if (!Directory.Exists(filesPath))
            {
                Directory.CreateDirectory(filesPath);
            }

            Files = Directory
                .GetFiles(filesPath)
                .Where(file =>
                    SupportedExtensions.Contains(
                        Path.GetExtension(file),
                        StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                .Select(Path.GetFileName)
                .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x))
                .OrderBy(x => x)
                .ToList()!;

            if (Files.Any())
            {
                await LoadDocument(Files.First()!);
            }
            else
            {
                HtmlContent =
                    "<div class='system-message'>No documents available.</div>";
            }
        }
        catch
        {
            HtmlContent =
                "<div class='system-message'>Failed to initialize document center.</div>";
        }
    }

    private async Task LoadDocument(string file)
    {
        try
        {
            CurrentFile = file;

            var extension =
                Path.GetExtension(file)
                    .ToLowerInvariant();

            var fileUrl =
                $"/Files/{file}";

            var filePath = Path.Combine(
                Environment.WebRootPath,
                "Files",
                file);

            switch (extension)
            {
                case ".html":
                case ".htm":

                    HtmlContent =
                        await File.ReadAllTextAsync(filePath);

                    break;

                case ".pdf":

                    HtmlContent = $@"
                    <iframe
                        src='{fileUrl}'
                        style='width:100%;
                               height:100%;
                               border:none;'>
                    </iframe>";

                    break;

                case ".png":
                case ".jpg":
                case ".jpeg":
                case ".webp":
                case ".gif":

                    HtmlContent = $@"
                    <div style='padding:20px;text-align:center;'>

                        <img src='{fileUrl}'
                             style='max-width:100%;
                                    border-radius:18px;' />

                    </div>";

                    break;

                case ".mp4":
                case ".webm":

                    HtmlContent = $@"
                    <div style='padding:20px;'>

                        <video controls style='width:100%;border-radius:18px;'>

                            <source src='{fileUrl}'>

                        </video>

                    </div>";

                    break;

                case ".txt":
                case ".json":

                    HtmlContent =
                        "<pre style='padding:20px;'>" +
                        await File.ReadAllTextAsync(filePath) +
                        "</pre>";

                    break;

                case ".docx":
                case ".xlsx":
                case ".csv":
                case ".pptx":

                    HtmlContent = $@"
                    <div style='padding:40px;'>

                        <h2>📥 Download Document</h2>

                        <a href='{fileUrl}' target='_blank' style='font-size:18px;'>
                            Open File
                        </a>

                    </div>";

                    break;

                default:

                    HtmlContent =
                        "<div class='system-message'>Unsupported file type.</div>";
                    break;
            }
        }
        catch
        {
            HtmlContent =
                "<div class='system-message'>Failed to load document.</div>";
        }
    }

    private async Task UploadFile(InputFileChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        try
        {
            var file = e.File;

            if (file is null)
            {
                return;
            }

            var extension =
                Path.GetExtension(file.Name);

            if (!SupportedExtensions.Contains(
                    extension,
                    StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                HtmlContent =
                    "<div class='system-message'>Unsupported file type.</div>";

                return;
            }

            var fileName =
                Path.GetFileName(file.Name);

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(fileName))
            {
                return;
            }

            var filesPath = Path.Combine(
                Environment.WebRootPath,
                "Files");

            var savePath = Path.Combine(
                filesPath,
                fileName);

            await using var stream =
                File.Create(savePath);

            await file.OpenReadStream(
                50 * 1024 * 1024)
                .CopyToAsync(stream);

            await LoadFiles();

            await LoadDocument(fileName);
        }
        catch
        {
            HtmlContent =
                "<div class='system-message'>File upload failed.</div>";
        }
    }

    private void ConfirmDelete(string file)
    {
        PendingDeleteFile = file;
    }

    private void CancelDelete()
    {
        PendingDeleteFile = null;
    }

    private async Task DeleteFile()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(PendingDeleteFile))
        {
            return;
        }

        try
        {
            var filePath = Path.Combine(Environment.WebRootPath,"Files",PendingDeleteFile);

            if (File.Exists(filePath))
            {
                File.Delete(filePath);
            }

            PendingDeleteFile = null;

            await LoadFiles();
        }
        catch
        {
            HtmlContent ="<div class='system-message'>Failed to delete file.</div>";
        }
    }

    private string GetFileIcon(string file)
    {
        var extension =
            Path.GetExtension(file)
                .ToLowerInvariant();

        return extension switch
        {
            ".html" or ".htm" => "🌐 ",
            ".pdf" => "📕 ",
            ".png" or ".jpg" or ".jpeg" or ".webp" or ".gif" => "🖼️ ",
            ".mp4" or ".webm" => "🎥 ",
            ".txt" or ".json" => "📄 ",
            ".docx" => "📝 ",
            ".xlsx" or ".csv" => "📊 ",
            ".pptx" => "📽️ ",
            _ => "📁 "
        };
    }

    private void GoHome()
    {
        Navigation.NavigateTo("/");
    }

}

    [SupplyParameterFromQuery]
    public string File { get; set; } = "";

    private string HtmlContent = "";

    private bool IsHtml =>
        File.EndsWith(".html",
            StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        if (IsHtml)
        {
            var filePath = Path.Combine(
                Environment.WebRootPath,
                "Files",
                File);

            if (System.IO.File.Exists(filePath))
            {
                HtmlContent =
                    await System.IO.File.ReadAllTextAsync(filePath);
            }
            else
            {
                HtmlContent =
                    "<h2>File not found.</h2>";
            }
        }
    }

}

@page "/help-documents"
@layout MainLayout_No_Left_RightPan

@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components
@using System.Text.Encodings.Web

@inject IWebHostEnvironment Environment
@inject NavigationManager Navigation

<PageTitle>Help Documents</PageTitle>

<div class="doc-layout">

    <!-- SIDEBAR -->
    <aside class="sidebar-panel">

        <!-- HEADER + HOME -->
        <div class="top-header">
            <div class="sidebar-header">
                <div class="sidebar-info">
                    <h2>Help Documents</h2>
                    <p>Application Help Center</p>
                </div>
            </div>

            <button class="home-button" @onclick="GoHome">
                🏠 Home
            </button>
        </div>

        <!-- NAV TREE -->
        <div class="nav-section">
            <div class="nav-section-title">🧠 Help (Knowledge)</div>

            @if (RootNode is null)
            {
                <div class="empty-message">Loading…</div>
            }
            else if (RootNode.Children.Count == 0)
            {
                <div class="empty-message">No help documents found.</div>
            }
            else
            {
                <div class="tree-root">
                    @RenderNode(RootNode, 0)
                </div>
            }
        </div>

    </aside>

    <!-- CONTENT -->
    <main class="content-panel">
        <div class="document-container">
            <div style="background:#ffffff; color:#1f1f1f; padding:20px; border-radius:10px;">
                @((MarkupString)HtmlContent)
            </div>
        </div>
    </main>

</div>

@code {

    private string HtmlContent = "";
    private DocNode? RootNode;

    private string HelpRootPath = "";
    private string HelpRootName = "HelpDoc";

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await InitializeAsync();
    }

    private async Task InitializeAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            HelpRootPath = Path.Combine(Environment.WebRootPath, "HelpDoc");

            if (!Directory.Exists(HelpRootPath))
                Directory.CreateDirectory(HelpRootPath);

            RootNode = BuildTree(HelpRootPath, HelpRootName, isRoot: true);

            // Auto-load first file found
            var firstFile = FindFirstPreviewableFile(RootNode);

            if (firstFile is not null)
            {
                firstFile.IsOpen = true;
                await LoadDocument(firstFile.RelativePath);
            }
            else
            {
                HtmlContent = "<div class='system-message'>No help documents available.</div>";
            }
        }
        catch
        {
            HtmlContent = "<div class='system-message'>Failed to initialize help center.</div>";

            RootNode = new DocNode
            {
                Name = HelpRootName,
                IsFolder = true,
                IsExpanded = true
            };
        }
    }

    // =========================================
    // BUILD TREE
    // =========================================
    private DocNode BuildTree(string physicalPath, string displayName, bool isRoot = false)
    {
        var node = new DocNode
        {
            Name = displayName,
            PhysicalPath = physicalPath,
            RelativePath = isRoot ? "" : GetRelativePathSafe(physicalPath),
            IsFolder = true,
            IsExpanded = isRoot
        };

        // Folders first
        foreach (var dir in Directory.EnumerateDirectories(physicalPath).OrderBy(d => d))
        {
            var folderName = Path.GetFileName(dir);

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(folderName))
                continue;

            node.Children.Add(BuildTree(dir, folderName));
        }

        // Then files
        foreach (var file in Directory.EnumerateFiles(physicalPath).OrderBy(f => f))
        {
            var fileName = Path.GetFileName(file);

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(fileName))
                continue;

            node.Children.Add(new DocNode
            {
                Name = fileName,
                PhysicalPath = file,
                RelativePath = GetRelativePathSafe(file),
                IsFolder = false,
                IsExpanded = false,
                IsOpen = false
            });
        }

        return node;
    }

    // =========================================
    // FIND FIRST FILE
    // =========================================
    private DocNode? FindFirstPreviewableFile(DocNode node)
    {
        foreach (var child in node.Children)
        {
            if (!child.IsFolder)
            {
                if (IsPreviewable(child.Name))
                    return child;
            }
            else
            {
                var found = FindFirstPreviewableFile(child);

                if (found is not null)
                    return found;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static bool IsPreviewable(string fileName)
    {
        var ext = Path.GetExtension(fileName).ToLowerInvariant();

        return ext is ".html" or ".htm" or ".txt" or ".md";
    }

    // =========================================
    // TREE RENDER
    // =========================================
    private RenderFragment RenderNode(DocNode node, int depth) => builder =>
    {
        // Skip virtual root
        if (depth == 0)
        {
            foreach (var child in node.Children)
                builder.AddContent(0, RenderNode(child, depth + 1));

            return;
        }

        var indentPx = (depth - 1) * 14;

        builder.OpenElement(0, "div");
        builder.AddAttribute(1, "class", "tree-row");
        builder.AddAttribute(2, "style", $"padding-left:{indentPx}px;");

        // =====================================
        // FOLDER
        // =====================================
        if (node.IsFolder)
        {
            builder.OpenElement(3, "button");

            builder.AddAttribute(4, "class", "folder-button");
            builder.AddAttribute(5, "title", node.Name);

            builder.AddAttribute(
                6,
                "onclick",
                EventCallback.Factory.Create(this, () =>
                {
                    ToggleFolder(node);
                    StateHasChanged();
                }));

            builder.AddContent(7, node.IsExpanded ? "📂 " : "📁 ");
            builder.AddContent(8, node.Name);

            builder.CloseElement();

            if (node.IsExpanded)
            {
                builder.OpenElement(9, "div");
                builder.AddAttribute(10, "class", "tree-children");

                foreach (var child in node.Children)
                    builder.AddContent(11, RenderNode(child, depth + 1));

                builder.CloseElement();
            }
        }

        // =====================================
        // FILE
        // =====================================
        else
        {
            builder.OpenElement(12, "button");

            builder.AddAttribute(
                13,
                "class",
                node.IsSelected
                    ? "file-button selected"
                    : "file-button");

            builder.AddAttribute(14, "title", node.RelativePath);

            builder.AddAttribute(
                15,
                "onclick",
                EventCallback.Factory.Create(this, async () =>
                {
                    // Reset all book icons
                    ResetOpenState(RootNode);

                    // Open selected
                    node.IsOpen = true;

                    await LoadDocument(node.RelativePath);

                    StateHasChanged();
                }));

            // Dynamic icon
            builder.AddContent(16, node.IsOpen ? "📖 " : "📙 ");

            // Display name
            builder.AddContent(17, GetDisplayName(node.Name));

            builder.CloseElement();
        }

        builder.CloseElement();
    };

    // =========================================
    // TOGGLE FOLDER
    // =========================================
    private void ToggleFolder(DocNode node)
    {
        node.IsExpanded = !node.IsExpanded;
    }

    // =========================================
    // LOAD DOCUMENT
    // =========================================
    private async Task LoadDocument(string relativePath)
    {
        try
        {
            ClearSelection(RootNode);
            MarkSelected(RootNode, relativePath);

            var fullPath = GetFullPathSafe(relativePath);

            if (!File.Exists(fullPath))
            {
                HtmlContent = "<div class='system-message'>Document not found.</div>";
                return;
            }

            var ext = Path.GetExtension(fullPath).ToLowerInvariant();

            // HTML
            if (ext is ".html" or ".htm")
            {
                HtmlContent = await File.ReadAllTextAsync(fullPath);
                return;
            }

            // TEXT / MD
            if (ext is ".txt" or ".md")
            {
                var text = await File.ReadAllTextAsync(fullPath);

                var encoded = HtmlEncoder.Default.Encode(text);

                HtmlContent =
                    $"<div class='text-viewer'><pre>{encoded}</pre></div>";

                return;
            }

            HtmlContent =
                "<div class='system-message'>Preview not supported for this file type.</div>";
        }
        catch
        {
            HtmlContent = "<div class='system-message'>Failed to load document.</div>";
        }
    }

    // =========================================
    // RESET OPEN STATE
    // =========================================
    private void ResetOpenState(DocNode? node)
    {
        if (node is null)
            return;

        node.IsOpen = false;

        foreach (var child in node.Children)
            ResetOpenState(child);
    }

    // =========================================
    // CLEAR SELECTION
    // =========================================
    private void ClearSelection(DocNode? node)
    {
        if (node is null)
            return;

        node.IsSelected = false;

        foreach (var child in node.Children)
            ClearSelection(child);
    }

    // =========================================
    // MARK SELECTED
    // =========================================
    private bool MarkSelected(DocNode? node, string relativePath)
    {
        if (node is null)
            return false;

        if (!node.IsFolder &&
            string.Equals(
                node.RelativePath,
                relativePath,
                StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            node.IsSelected = true;
            return true;
        }

        foreach (var child in node.Children)
        {
            if (MarkSelected(child, relativePath))
            {
                node.IsExpanded = true;
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    private string GetDisplayName(string file)
        => Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(file);

    // =========================================
    // SAFE RELATIVE PATH
    // =========================================
    private string GetRelativePathSafe(string fullPath)
    {
        var rel = Path.GetRelativePath(HelpRootPath, fullPath);

        rel = rel.Replace('\\', '/');

        return rel;
    }

    // =========================================
    // SAFE FULL PATH
    // =========================================
    private string GetFullPathSafe(string relativePath)
    {
        relativePath =
            (relativePath ?? "")
            .Replace('\\', '/')
            .TrimStart('/');

        var combined = Path.Combine(HelpRootPath, relativePath);

        var full = Path.GetFullPath(combined);

        var rootFull = Path.GetFullPath(HelpRootPath);

        if (!full.StartsWith(rootFull, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid path.");

        return full;
    }

    // =========================================
    // HOME
    // =========================================
    private void GoHome(){Navigation.NavigateTo("/");}

    // =========================================
    // MODEL
    // =========================================
    private sealed class DocNode
    {
        public string Name { get; set; } = "";
        public string PhysicalPath { get; set; } = "";

    }

@page "/xlogin"

@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Antiforgery
@layout MainLayout_No_Left_RightPan

@inject IAntiforgery Antiforgery
@inject IHttpContextAccessor HttpContextAccessor
@inject NavigationManager Navigation

<PageTitle>MITANZ360Edu Login</PageTitle>

<div class="login-page">

    <!-- BACKGROUND -->
    <div class="bg-overlay"></div>

    <!-- LOGIN CARD -->
    <div class="login-card">

        <!-- HEADER -->
        <div class="xlogin-header">

            <div class="xlogin-brand-row">

                <img src="images/logo.png"
                     class="xlogin-logo"
                     alt="MITANZ360Edu Logo" />

                <h1 class="xlogin-title">
                    MITANZ360Edu
                </h1>

            </div>

            <p class="xlogin-subtitle">
                Enterprise AI Education Framework
            </p>

        </div>

        <!-- ERROR -->
        @if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(error))
        {
            <div class="login-error">

                @error

            </div>
        }

        <!-- BUTTON ROW -->
        <div class="xlogin-button-row">

            <!-- LOGIN FORM -->
            <form method="post"
                  action="/auth/login"
                  FormName="LoginForm">

                <!-- ANTIFORGERY -->
                <input type="hidden"
                       name="__RequestVerificationToken"
                       value="@GetAntiForgeryToken()" />

                <!-- EMAIL -->
                <input type="hidden"
                       name="email"
                       value="@email" />

                <!-- PASSWORD -->
                <input type="hidden"
                       name="password"
                       value="@password" />

                <button type="submit"
                        class="xlogin-btn login-btn"
                        disabled="@IsInvalidInput"
                        @onclick="OnLoginClick">

                    @if (isLoading)
                    {
                        <span>⏳ Logging in...</span>
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        <span>🔐</span>
                        <span>Login</span>
                    }

                </button>
            </form>

            <!-- GUEST FORM -->
            <form method="post"
                  action="/auth/logout"
                  FormName="GuestForm">

                <!-- ANTIFORGERY -->
                <input type="hidden"
                       name="__RequestVerificationToken"
                       value="@GetAntiForgeryToken()" />

                <button type="submit"
                        class="xlogin-btn guest-btn">

                    <span>🌍</span>
                    <span>Guest Access</span>

                </button>

            </form>

        </div>

        <!-- FORM GRID -->
        <div class="form-grid">

            <!-- EMAIL -->
            <div class="form-group">

                <label>Email Address</label>

                <input type="email"
                       @bind="email"
                       class="custom-input"
                       placeholder="Enter your email"
                       autocomplete="username" />

            </div>

            <!-- PASSWORD -->
            <div class="form-group">

                <label>Password</label>

                <div class="password-wrapper">

                    <input type="@(showPassword ? "text" : "password")"
                           @bind="password"
                           class="custom-input"
                           placeholder="Enter your password"
                           autocomplete="current-password" />

                    <button type="button"
                            class="password-toggle"
                            @onclick="TogglePassword">

                        @(showPassword ? "🙈" : "👁️")

                    </button>

                </div>

            </div>

        </div>

    </div>

</div>

@code {

    private string email = "";

    private string password = "";

    private bool showPassword;

    private string? error;

    protected override void OnInitialized()
    {
        var uri =
            Navigation.ToAbsoluteUri(
                Navigation.Uri);

        if (Microsoft.AspNetCore.WebUtilities
            .QueryHelpers
            .ParseQuery(uri.Query)
            .TryGetValue("error", out var err))
        {
            error = err;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Toggle password visibility
    /// </summary>
    private void TogglePassword()
    {
        showPassword = !showPassword;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Generate antiforgery token
    /// </summary>
    private string GetAntiForgeryToken()
    {
        var tokens =
            Antiforgery.GetAndStoreTokens(
                HttpContextAccessor.HttpContext!);

        return tokens.RequestToken ?? "";
    }
    private bool isLoading;

    private bool IsInvalidInput =>
        string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(email) ||
        string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(password);

    private void OnLoginClick()
    {
        if (IsInvalidInput)
            return;

        isLoading = true;
    }

}

    private SettingsConfig config = new();

    private bool isLoading = true;

    private bool isSaving;

    private bool showPassword;

    private string? successMessage;

    private string? errorMessage;

    private string PasswordInputType =>
        showPassword ? "text" : "password";

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            var loadedSettings =
                await SettingsService.GetSettingsAsync();

            if (loadedSettings != null)
            {
                config = loadedSettings;
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            errorMessage =
                $"Failed to load settings: {ex.Message}";
        }
        finally
        {
            isLoading = false;
        }
    }

    private async Task SaveSettingsAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            isSaving = true;

            successMessage = null;

            errorMessage = null;

            await SettingsService.SaveSettingsAsync(config);

            successMessage =
                "System settings saved successfully.";
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            errorMessage =
                $"Failed to save settings: {ex.Message}";
        }
        finally
        {
            isSaving = false;
        }
    }

    private void TogglePassword()
    {
        showPassword = !showPassword;
    }
}

@code {

    // =====================================================
    // DATA
    // =====================================================

    private List<NavigationCardModel>
        Cards = [];

    // =====================================================
    // INIT
    // =====================================================

    protected override async Task
        OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await LoadAsync();
    }

    // =====================================================
    // LOAD DATA
    // =====================================================

    private async Task LoadAsync()
    {
        Cards =
            await SharePointService
                .GetNavigationCardsAsync();

        StateHasChanged();
    }

    // =====================================================
    // CREATE
    // =====================================================

    private async Task CreateCard()
    {
        var result =
            await DialogService.OpenAsync
                <NavigationCardForm>(
                    "Create Navigation Card",
                    null,
                    new DialogOptions
                    {
                        Width = "900px",
                        Height = "750px",
                        Resizable = true,
                        Draggable = true
                    });

        if (result == true)
        {
            await LoadAsync();
        }
    }

    // =====================================================
    // EDIT
    // =====================================================

    private async Task EditCard(
        NavigationCardModel item)
    {
        var model =
            new NavigationCardModel
            {
                Id = item.Id,
                Title = item.Title,
                Subtitle = item.Subtitle,
                Icon = item.Icon,
                ImageUrl = item.ImageUrl,
                Url = item.Url,
                OpenType = item.OpenType?.ToString() ?? "Internal",
                Role = item.Role,
                Campus = item.Campus,
                IsEnabled = item.IsEnabled,
                SortOrder = item.SortOrder,
                CardColor = item.CardColor
            };

        var parameters =
            new Dictionary<string, object>
            {
                {
                    "Model",
                    model
                }
            };

        var result =
            await DialogService.OpenAsync
                <NavigationCardForm>(
                    "Edit Navigation Card",
                    parameters,
                    new DialogOptions
                    {
                        Width = "900px",
                        Height = "750px",
                        Resizable = true,
                        Draggable = true
                    });

        if (result == true)
        {
            await LoadAsync();
        }
    }

    // =====================================================
    // DUPLICATE
    // =====================================================

    private async Task DuplicateCard(
        NavigationCardModel item)
    {
        // =====================================================
        // CLONE MODEL
        // =====================================================

        var model =
            new NavigationCardModel
            {
                // EMPTY ID = NEW RECORD

                Id = string.Empty,

                Title = $"{item.Title} Copy",

                Subtitle = item.Subtitle,

                Icon = item.Icon,

                ImageUrl = item.ImageUrl,

                Url = item.Url,

                OpenType = item.OpenType,

                Role = item.Role,

                Campus = item.Campus,

                IsEnabled = item.IsEnabled,

                SortOrder = item.SortOrder,

                CardColor = item.CardColor
            };

        // =====================================================
        // OPEN FORM
        // =====================================================

        var parameters =
            new Dictionary<string, object>
            {
                {
                    "Model",
                    model
                }
            };

        var result =
            await DialogService.OpenAsync
                <NavigationCardForm>(
                    "Duplicate Navigation Card",
                    parameters,
                    new DialogOptions
                    {
                        Width = "900px",
                        Height = "750px",
                        Resizable = true,
                        Draggable = true
                    });

        if (result == true)
        {
            await LoadAsync();
        }
    }

    // =====================================================
    // DELETE
    // =====================================================

    private async Task DeleteCard(
        NavigationCardModel item)
    {
        var confirm =
            await DialogService.Confirm(
                $"Delete '{item.Title}' ?",
                "Confirm Delete");

        if (confirm == true)
        {
            await SharePointService
                .DeleteNavigationCardAsync(
                    item.Id);

            NotificationService.Notify(
                NotificationSeverity.Success,
                "Deleted",
                "Navigation card deleted.");

            await LoadAsync();
        }
    }

    // =====================================================
    // Academic Categories Icons
    // =====================================================
    private async Task OpenPageInNewTab()
    {
        await JSRuntime.InvokeVoidAsync(
            "open",
            "/icon-categories",
            "_blank");
    }
}

@page "/admin/roles"
@layout MainLayout
@attribute [Authorize(Roles = "Admin,SysAdmin")]

@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization
@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity
@using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore
@using Radzen
@using Radzen.Blazor

@using MITANZ360Edu.Web.Data

@inject IDbContextFactory<ApplicationDbContext> DbFactory
@inject IServiceScopeFactory ScopeFactory
@inject NotificationService NotificationService
@inject DialogService DialogService

<PageTitle>Application Roles Management</PageTitle>

<div class="container mt-4 page-wrap">

    <!-- ===================================================== -->
    <!-- HEADER -->
    <!-- ===================================================== -->
    <div class="top-card mb-3">

                        PageSize="10"

                                          Size="ButtonSize.Small"

                                          Click="@(async () => await OpenEditRoleBlade(r))" />

                            <RadzenButton Icon="delete"
                                          Size="ButtonSize.Small"
                                          ButtonStyle="ButtonStyle.Danger"
                                          Disabled="@busy"
                                          Click="@(async () => await AskDeleteRole(r))" />
                        </div>
                    </Template>
                </RadzenDataGridColumn>
            </Columns>

        </RadzenDataGrid>
    </div>

<!-- ===================================================== -->
<!-- ROLE SIDE PANEL -->
<!-- ===================================================== -->
<RadzenSidebar Position="SidebarPosition.Right"
               Visible="@showRoleBlade"
               Class="mit-blade">

    <div class="blade-header">
        <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-2">
            <RadzenIcon Icon="@roleBladeIcon"
                        Style="@($"color:{roleBladeIconColor};")" />

            <h4 class="mb-0">@roleBladeTitle</h4>
        </div>

        <RadzenButton Icon="close"
                      Size="ButtonSize.Small"
                      ButtonStyle="ButtonStyle.Light"
                      Click="@CloseRoleBlade" />
    </div>

    <div class="blade-body">
        <div class="row">
            <div class="col-12 mb-3">
                <RadzenLabel Text="Role Name" />
                <RadzenTextBox @bind-Value="model.Name"
                               Name="RoleName"
                               Style="width:100%;" />
            </div>

            @if (isEditMode)
            {
                <div class="col-12">
                    <div class="subtle">
                        Renaming a role updates the Identity role record. Ensure any seeded role names in code remain aligned.
                    </div>
                </div>
            }
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="blade-footer">
        <RadzenButton Text="Cancel"
                      ButtonStyle="ButtonStyle.Light"
                      Click="@CloseRoleBlade"
                      Disabled="@busy" />

        <RadzenButton Text="Save"
                      Icon="save"
                      ButtonStyle="ButtonStyle.Primary"
                      Disabled="@busy"
                      Click="AskSaveRole" />
    </div>

@code
{
    // =====================================================
    // STATE
    // =====================================================

    private List<RoleRow> roles = new();

    private bool showRoleBlade;
    private bool busy;
    private bool isEditMode;

    private string search = string.Empty;

    private string roleBladeTitle = "New Role";
    private string roleBladeIcon = "add";
    private string roleBladeIconColor = "#2563eb";

    private RoleRow? editingRole;

    private RoleEditModel model = new();

    // Optional protection for critical roles used by authorization.
    private static readonly HashSet<string> ProtectedRoleNames =
        new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
        {
            "Admin",
            "SysAdmin"
        };

    // =====================================================
    // INITIALIZE
    // =====================================================

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await LoadRoles();
    }

    // =====================================================
    // LOAD ROLES
    // =====================================================

    private async Task LoadRoles()
    {
        await using var db = await DbFactory.CreateDbContextAsync();

        roles = await
            (
                from r in db.Roles
                join ur in db.UserRoles on r.Id equals ur.RoleId into roleUsers
                where !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(r.Name)
                orderby r.Name
                select new RoleRow
                {
                    Id = r.Id,
                    Name = r.Name!,
                    NormalizedName = r.NormalizedName ?? string.Empty,
                    UsersCount = roleUsers.Count()
                }
            )
            .AsNoTracking()
            .ToListAsync();
    }

    // =====================================================
    // FILTER
    // =====================================================

    private IEnumerable<RoleRow> FilteredRoles()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(search))
        {
            return roles;
        }

        var s = search.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();

        return roles.Where(r =>
            (r.Name ?? string.Empty).ToLowerInvariant().Contains(s) ||
            (r.NormalizedName ?? string.Empty).ToLowerInvariant().Contains(s));
    }

    // =====================================================
    // CREATE
    // =====================================================

    private Task OpenCreateRoleBlade()
    {
        isEditMode = false;
        editingRole = null;

        model = new RoleEditModel
        {
            Name = string.Empty
        };

        roleBladeTitle = "New Role";
        roleBladeIcon = "add";
        roleBladeIconColor = "#2563eb";

        showRoleBlade = true;
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    // =====================================================
    // EDIT
    // =====================================================

    private Task OpenEditRoleBlade(RoleRow role)
    {
        isEditMode = true;
        editingRole = role;

        model = new RoleEditModel
        {
            Id = role.Id,
            Name = role.Name
        };

        roleBladeTitle = "Edit Role";
        roleBladeIcon = "security";
        roleBladeIconColor = "#ea580c";

        showRoleBlade = true;
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    // =====================================================
    // SAVE
    // =====================================================

    private async Task AskSaveRole()
    {
        try
        {
            busy = true;

            var validationError = ValidateModel();
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(validationError))
            {
                Notify(validationError, NotificationSeverity.Error);
                return;
            }

            using var scope = ScopeFactory.CreateScope();

            var roleManager = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<RoleManager<IdentityRole>>();

            var trimmedName = model.Name.Trim();

            if (!isEditMode)
            {
                var exists = await roleManager.RoleExistsAsync(trimmedName);
                if (exists)
                {
                    Notify("A role with this name already exists.", NotificationSeverity.Error);
                    return;
                }

                var createResult = await roleManager.CreateAsync(new IdentityRole(trimmedName));
                if (!createResult.Succeeded)
                {
                    NotifyIdentityErrors(createResult);
                    return;
                }

                Notify("Role created");
            }
            else
            {
                var role = await roleManager.FindByIdAsync(model.Id!);
                if (role is null)
                {
                    Notify("Role not found.", NotificationSeverity.Error);
                    return;
                }

                if (ProtectedRoleNames.Contains(role.Name ?? string.Empty) &&
                    !string.Equals(role.Name, trimmedName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    Notify("Protected system roles cannot be renamed.", NotificationSeverity.Error);
                    return;
                }

                var duplicate = await roleManager.FindByNameAsync(trimmedName);
                if (duplicate is not null &&
                    !string.Equals(duplicate.Id, role.Id, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                {
                    Notify("Another role with this name already exists.", NotificationSeverity.Error);
                    return;
                }

                role.Name = trimmedName;
                role.NormalizedName = trimmedName.ToUpperInvariant();

                var updateResult = await roleManager.UpdateAsync(role);
                if (!updateResult.Succeeded)
                {
                    NotifyIdentityErrors(updateResult);
                    return;
                }

                Notify("Role updated");
            }

            showRoleBlade = false;

            await LoadRoles();
            await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Notify(ex.Message, NotificationSeverity.Error);
        }
        finally
        {
            busy = false;
            await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
        }
    }

    // =====================================================
    // DELETE
    // =====================================================

    private async Task AskDeleteRole(RoleRow role)
    {
        try
        {
            if (ProtectedRoleNames.Contains(role.Name))
            {
                Notify("Protected system roles cannot be deleted.", NotificationSeverity.Error);
                return;
            }

            if (role.UsersCount > 0)
            {
                Notify("This role is assigned to users and cannot be deleted.", NotificationSeverity.Error);
                return;
            }

            var confirmed = await DialogService.Confirm(
                $"Delete role '{role.Name}'?",
                "Confirm delete",
                new ConfirmOptions
                {
                    OkButtonText = "Delete",
                    CancelButtonText = "Cancel"
                });

            if (confirmed != true)
            {
                return;
            }

            busy = true;

            using var scope = ScopeFactory.CreateScope();

            var roleManager = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<RoleManager<IdentityRole>>();

            var dbRole = await roleManager.FindByIdAsync(role.Id);
            if (dbRole is null)
            {
                Notify("Role not found.", NotificationSeverity.Error);
                return;
            }

            var deleteResult = await roleManager.DeleteAsync(dbRole);
            if (!deleteResult.Succeeded)
            {
                NotifyIdentityErrors(deleteResult);
                return;
            }

            Notify("Role deleted");

            await LoadRoles();
            await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Notify(ex.Message, NotificationSeverity.Error);
        }
        finally
        {
            busy = false;
            await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
        }
    }

    // =====================================================
    // HELPERS
    // =====================================================

    private string? ValidateModel()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(model.Name))
        {
            return "Role name is required.";
        }

        if (model.Name.Trim().Length < 2)
        {
            return "Role name must be at least 2 characters.";
        }

        return null;
    }

    private void NotifyIdentityErrors(IdentityResult result)
    {
        Notify(
            string.Join(", ", result.Errors.Select(x => x.Description)),
            NotificationSeverity.Error);
    }

    private void CloseRoleBlade()
    {
        showRoleBlade = false;
    }

    private void Notify(
        string message,
        NotificationSeverity severity = NotificationSeverity.Success)
    {
        NotificationService.Notify(new NotificationMessage
        {
            Severity = severity,
            Summary = message,
            Duration = 3000
        });
    }

    // =====================================================
    // VIEW MODELS
    // =====================================================

    private sealed class RoleRow
    {
        public string Id { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        public string NormalizedName { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        public int UsersCount { get; set; }
    }

    private sealed class RoleEditModel
    {
        public string? Id { get; set; }

        public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }
}

@page "/delete-user"
@layout MainLayout

<div class="container mt-4">

                <div style="color:#6b7280;">
                    Direct database delete without Identity services
                </div>
            </div>

            <RadzenTextBox @bind-Value="search"
                           Placeholder="Search user..."
                           Style="width:280px;"
                           Change="@(_ => ApplyFilter())" />
        </div>
    </RadzenCard>

    <!-- GRID -->
    <RadzenCard>
        <RadzenDataGrid Data="@filteredUsers"
                        TItem="ApplicationUser"

                        PageSize="10"
                        AllowSorting="true"
                        AllowFiltering="true">

            <Columns>

                <RadzenDataGridColumn TItem="ApplicationUser" Property="UserName" Title="Username" />
                <RadzenDataGridColumn TItem="ApplicationUser" Property="Email" Title="Email" />

                <RadzenDataGridColumn TItem="ApplicationUser" Title="Action">
                    <Template Context="u">
                        <RadzenButton Icon="delete"
                                      ButtonStyle="ButtonStyle.Danger"
                                      Size="ButtonSize.Small"

@code {

    private List<ApplicationUser> users = new();
    private List<ApplicationUser> filteredUsers = new();
    private string search = "";

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await LoadUsers();
    }

    // ===============================
    // LOAD USERS
    // ===============================
    private async Task LoadUsers()
    {
        await using var db = await DbFactory.CreateDbContextAsync();

        users = await db.Users
            .AsNoTracking()
            .OrderBy(x => x.UserName)
            .ToListAsync();

        filteredUsers = users.ToList();
    }

    // ===============================
    // FILTER
    // ===============================
    private void ApplyFilter()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(search))
        {
            filteredUsers = users.ToList();
        }
        else
        {
            var s = search.ToLower();

            filteredUsers = users.Where(u =>
                (u.UserName ?? "").ToLower().Contains(s) ||
                (u.Email ?? "").ToLower().Contains(s)
            ).ToList();
        }
    }

    // ===============================
    // CONFIRM DELETE
    // ===============================
    private async Task ConfirmDelete(ApplicationUser user)
    {
        var confirm = await DialogService.Confirm(
            $"DELETE user '{user.UserName}' permanently?",
            "Danger Zone",
            new ConfirmOptions
            {
                OkButtonText = "YES DELETE",
                CancelButtonText = "Cancel"
            });

        if (confirm == true)
        {
            await DeleteUserRaw(user.Id);
        }
    }

    // ===============================
    // 🔥 RAW DELETE (NO IDENTITY)
    // ===============================
    private async Task DeleteUserRaw(string userId)
    {
        try
        {
            await using var db = await DbFactory.CreateDbContextAsync();

            var user = await db.Users.FindAsync(userId);

            if (user == null)
            {
                Notify("User not found", NotificationSeverity.Warning);
                return;
            }

            // 🔐 SAFETY
            if (user.UserName?.ToLower() == "admin")
            {
                Notify("Cannot delete admin user", NotificationSeverity.Warning);
                return;
            }

            // 🔥 REMOVE RELATED DATA (CRITICAL)
            var roles = db.UserRoles.Where(x => x.UserId == userId);
            var claims = db.UserClaims.Where(x => x.UserId == userId);
            var logins = db.UserLogins.Where(x => x.UserId == userId);
            var tokens = db.UserTokens.Where(x => x.UserId == userId);

            db.UserRoles.RemoveRange(roles);
            db.UserClaims.RemoveRange(claims);
            db.UserLogins.RemoveRange(logins);
            db.UserTokens.RemoveRange(tokens);

            // 🔥 DELETE USER
            db.Users.Remove(user);

            await db.SaveChangesAsync();

            Notify("User deleted from DB");

            await LoadUsers();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Notify(ex.Message, NotificationSeverity.Error);
        }
    }

    // ===============================
    // NOTIFY
    // ===============================
    private void Notify(string msg, NotificationSeverity severity = NotificationSeverity.Success)
    {
        NotificationService.Notify(new NotificationMessage
        {
            Severity = severity,
            Summary = msg,
            Duration = 3000
        });
    }
}

@code {

    // =====================================================
    // STATE
    // =====================================================

    private List<
        JsonLookupDataService.CountryModel>
        Countries = [];

    private JsonLookupDataService.CountryModel?
        SelectedCountry;

    private JsonLookupDataService.CountryModel?
        Model;

    private bool IsNew;

    // =====================================================
    // JSON PREVIEW
    // =====================================================

    private string JsonPreview =>
        JsonSerializer.Serialize(
            Model,
            new JsonSerializerOptions
            {
                WriteIndented = true
            });

    // =====================================================
    // INIT
    // =====================================================

    protected override async Task
        OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await LoadAsync();
    }

    // =====================================================
    // LOAD
    // =====================================================

    private async Task LoadAsync()
    {
        Countries =
            await JsonLookupDataService
                .GetCountriesAsync();
    }

    // =====================================================
    // SELECT
    // =====================================================

    private void SelectCountry(
        JsonLookupDataService.CountryModel item)
    {
        IsNew = false;

        SelectedCountry = item;

        Model =
            new JsonLookupDataService.CountryModel
            {
                Name = item.Name,
                Code = item.Code,
                Currency = item.Currency,
                Timezone = item.Timezone
            };
    }

    // =====================================================
    // NEW
    // =====================================================

    private void CreateNew()
    {
        IsNew = true;

        SelectedCountry = null;

        Model =
            new JsonLookupDataService.CountryModel
            {
                Name = "",
                Code = "",
                Currency = "",
                Timezone = ""
            };
    }

    // =====================================================
    // SAVE
    // =====================================================

    private async Task SaveAsync()
    {
        if (Model == null)
            return;

        try
        {
            // =============================================
            // INSERT
            // =============================================

            if (IsNew)
            {
                await JsonLookupDataService
                    .AddCountryAsync(
                        Model);

                NotificationService.Notify(
                    NotificationSeverity.Success,
                    "Created",
                    "Country added successfully.");
            }

            // =============================================
            // UPDATE
            // =============================================

            else
            {
                await JsonLookupDataService
                    .UpdateCountryAsync(
                        Model);

                NotificationService.Notify(
                    NotificationSeverity.Success,
                    "Updated",
                    "Country updated successfully.");
            }

            await LoadAsync();

            IsNew = false;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            NotificationService.Notify(
                NotificationSeverity.Error,
                "Save Error",
                ex.Message);
        }
    }

    // =====================================================
    // DELETE
    // =====================================================

    private async Task DeleteAsync()
    {
        if (Model == null)
            return;

        try
        {
            await JsonLookupDataService
                .DeleteCountryAsync(
                    Model.Code);

            NotificationService.Notify(
                NotificationSeverity.Success,
                "Deleted",
                "Country removed.");

            await LoadAsync();

            Model = null;

            SelectedCountry = null;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            NotificationService.Notify(
                NotificationSeverity.Error,
                "Delete Error",
                ex.Message);
        }
    }
}

@page "/admin/ai-configuration"
@layout MainLayout_NoRightPan
@attribute [Authorize(Roles = "Admin,SysAdmin")]

@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Rendering
@using System.Text.Json
@using System.Text.Json.Nodes
@using Radzen

@inject IWebHostEnvironment Environment
@inject NotificationService NotificationService

<PageTitle>AI Configuration Center</PageTitle>

<div class="ai-shell">

    <RadzenRow Gap="20px">

        <!-- LEFT PANEL -->

        <RadzenColumn Size="12" SizeMD="4">

            <RadzenCard class="glass-card">

                <div class="page-title">
                    AI Configuration Center
                </div>

                <RadzenTextBox Placeholder="Search configuration..."
                               Style="width:100%"
                               @bind-Value="searchText" />

                <div class="file-list">

                    @foreach (var file in FilteredFiles)
                    {
                        <div class="file-card"
                             @onclick="() => OpenFile(file)">

                            <strong>
                                📄 @Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(file)
                            </strong>

                        </div>
                    }

                </div>

            </RadzenCard>

        </RadzenColumn>

        <!-- RIGHT PANEL -->

        <RadzenColumn Size="12" SizeMD="8">

            @if (RootNode != null)
            {
                <RadzenCard class="glass-card">

                    <div class="toolbar">

                        <h3>@SelectedFileName</h3>

                        <RadzenButton Icon="save"
                                      Text="Save"
                                      ButtonStyle="ButtonStyle.Success"
                                      Click="SaveFile" />

                    </div>

                    @if (RootNode is JsonObject obj)
                    {
                        @foreach (var property in obj)
                        {
                            @RenderProperty(property.Key, property.Value)
                        }
                    }

                </RadzenCard>
            }

        </RadzenColumn>

    </RadzenRow>

</div>

@code
{
    private List<string> Files = [];

    private string searchText = "";

    private string? SelectedFile;

    private string? SelectedFileName;

    private JsonNode? RootNode;

    private IEnumerable<string> FilteredFiles =>
        Files.Where(x =>
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(searchText)
            || Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(x)
                .Contains(
                    searchText,
                    StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));

    protected override void OnInitialized()
    {
        var folder =
            Path.Combine(
                Environment.WebRootPath,
                "AI-Eng");

        if (!Directory.Exists(folder))
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(folder);
        }

        Files = Directory
            .GetFiles(
                folder,
                "*.json",
                SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly)
            .OrderBy(Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension)
            .ToList();
    }

    private async Task OpenFile(string file)
    {
        SelectedFile = file;

        SelectedFileName =
            Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(file);

        var json =
            await File.ReadAllTextAsync(file);

        RootNode =
            JsonNode.Parse(json);

        StateHasChanged();
    }

    private async Task SaveFile()
    {
        if (RootNode is null ||
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(SelectedFile))
        {
            return;
        }

        var json =
            RootNode.ToJsonString(
                new JsonSerializerOptions
                {
                    WriteIndented = true
                });

        await File.WriteAllTextAsync(
            SelectedFile,
            json);

        NotificationService.Notify(
            NotificationSeverity.Success,
            "Saved",
            "JSON updated successfully");
    }

    private RenderFragment RenderProperty(
        string key,
        JsonNode? node) => builder =>
    {
        var seq = 0;

        builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", "field-container");

        builder.OpenElement(seq++, "label");
        builder.AddContent(seq++, SplitWords(key));
        builder.CloseElement();

        if (node is JsonValue value)
        {
            var raw = value.ToJsonString();

            if (bool.TryParse(raw, out var boolValue))
            {
                builder.OpenComponent<RadzenCheckBox<bool>>(seq++);
                builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "Value", boolValue);
                builder.AddAttribute(
                    seq++,
                    "ValueChanged",
                    EventCallback.Factory.Create<bool>(
                        this,
                        v =>
                        {
                            node.ReplaceWith(
                                JsonValue.Create(v));
                        }));

                builder.CloseComponent();
            }
            else
            {
                var text =
                    raw.Trim('"');

                builder.OpenComponent<RadzenTextBox>(seq++);
                builder.AddAttribute(
                    seq++,
                    "Style",
                    "width:100%");
                builder.AddAttribute(
                    seq++,
                    "Value",
                    text);
                builder.AddAttribute(
                    seq++,
                    "Change",
                    EventCallback.Factory.Create<string>(
                        this,
                        v =>
                        {
                            node.ReplaceWith(
                                JsonValue.Create(v));
                        }));

                builder.CloseComponent();
            }
        }
        else if (node is JsonObject childObject)
        {
            builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
            builder.AddAttribute(
                seq++,
                "class",
                "nested-card");

            foreach (var child in childObject)
            {
                builder.AddContent(
                    seq++,
                    RenderProperty(
                        child.Key,
                        child.Value));
            }

            builder.CloseElement();
        }
        else if (node is JsonArray array)
        {
            builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
            builder.AddAttribute(
                seq++,
                "class",
                "nested-card");

            builder.AddContent(
                seq++,
                $"Array Items: {array.Count}");

            builder.CloseElement();
        }

        builder.CloseElement();
    };

    private static string SplitWords(string text)
    {
        return System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex
            .Replace(
                text,
                "([a-z])([A-Z])",
                "$1 $2");
    }
}

@code {

    // =====================================================
    // PARAMETERS
    // =====================================================

    [Parameter]
    public NavigationCardModel Model { get; set; }
        = new();

    [Parameter]
    public EventCallback OnSaved { get; set; }

    // =====================================================
    // AVAILABLE ROLES
    // =====================================================

    private List<string>
        AvailableRoles = [];

    // =====================================================
    // SELECTED ROLES
    // =====================================================

    private IEnumerable<string>
        SelectedRoles = [];

    // =====================================================
    // INIT
    // =====================================================

    protected override async Task
        OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            // ================================================
            // LOAD SHAREPOINT ROLES
            // ================================================

            var roles =
                await SharePointService
                    .GetRolesAsync();

            // ================================================
            // DEBUG
            // ================================================

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"SP ROLES COUNT: {roles.Count}");

            // ================================================
            // AVAILABLE ACTIVE ROLES
            // ================================================

            AvailableRoles =
                roles

                    .Where(x =>
                        x.IsActive)

                    .Select(x =>
                        x.Title)

                    .Distinct()

                    .OrderBy(x => x)

                    .ToList();

            // ================================================
            // DEBUG
            // ================================================

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"AVAILABLE ROLES: {string.Join(",", AvailableRoles)}");

            // ================================================
            // EXISTING CARD ROLES
            // ================================================

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                Model.Role))
            {
                SelectedRoles =
                    Model.Role

                        .Split(
                            new[] { ',', ';' },
                            StringSplitOptions
                                .RemoveEmptyEntries)

                        .Select(x =>
                            x.Trim())

                        .Distinct()

                        .ToList();
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(
                $"ROLE LOAD ERROR: {ex.Message}");

            NotificationService.Notify(

                NotificationSeverity.Error,

                "Role Load Error",

                ex.Message);
        }
    }

    // =====================================================
    // ROLE CHANGED
    // =====================================================

    private void
        OnRolesChanged(object value)
    {
        if (value is IEnumerable<string> roles)
        {
            SelectedRoles =
                roles;

            Model.Role =
                string.Join(
                    ",",
                    SelectedRoles);

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"SELECTED ROLES: {Model.Role}");
        }
    }

    // =====================================================
    // SAVE
    // =====================================================

    private async Task
        SaveAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            // ================================================
            // NORMALIZE ROLES
            // ================================================

            Model.Role =
                string.Join(
                    ",",
                    SelectedRoles
                        .Distinct());

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"SAVE ROLES: {Model.Role}");

            // ================================================
            // CREATE
            // ================================================

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                Model.Id))
            {
                await SharePointService
                    .CreateNavigationCardAsync(Model);
            }

            // ================================================
            // UPDATE
            // ================================================

            else
            {
                await SharePointService
                    .UpdateNavigationCardAsync(Model);
            }

            // ================================================
            // SUCCESS
            // ================================================

            NotificationService.Notify(

                NotificationSeverity.Success,

                "Success",

                "Navigation card saved successfully.");

            // ================================================
            // CALLBACK
            // ================================================

            if (OnSaved.HasDelegate)
            {
                await OnSaved.InvokeAsync();
            }

            // ================================================
            // CLOSE
            // ================================================

            DialogService.Close(true);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(
                $"SAVE ERROR: {ex.Message}");

            NotificationService.Notify(

                NotificationSeverity.Error,

                "Save Error",

                ex.Message);
        }
    }

    // =====================================================
    // CLOSE
    // =====================================================

    private void
        Close()
    {
        DialogService.Close(false);
    }
}

@page "/reference-data/{Module}"
@layout MainLayout_NoRightPan
@attribute [Authorize(Roles = "Admin,SysAdmin")]

@using MITANZ360Edu.Web.Services

@using Radzen.Blazor

<PageTitle>Reference Data</PageTitle>

<div class="rd-container">

    <!-- HEADER -->
    <div class="Main-header">
        <h2>Reference Data • @Module</h2>
    </div>

    <!-- SEARCH -->
    <RadzenTextBox @bind-Value="SearchText"
                   Placeholder="Search Title / Code / Description"
                   Style="width:100%"
                   @oninput="OnSearchInput" />

    <div class="rd-grid">

        <!-- LEFT: CATEGORY -->
        <div class="rd-categories">
