@code {

    [Parameter] public string Module { get; set; } = "";

    private RadzenDataGrid<ReferenceDataItem>? grid;

    private List<string> Categories = new();
    private List<ReferenceDataItem> Items = new();
    private List<ReferenceDataItem> FilteredItems = new();

    private IEnumerable<ReferenceDataItem> PagedItems = new List<ReferenceDataItem>();
    private int TotalCount;

    private ReferenceDataItem CurrentItem = new();

    private string SelectedCategory = "";
    private string SearchText = "";

    private bool IsLoading;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await LoadData();
    }

    private async Task LoadData()
    {
        try
        {
            IsLoading = true;

            Categories = await SharePointService.GetReferenceCategoriesAsync(Module);

            if (Categories.Any())
            {
                await SelectCategory(Categories.First());
            }

            CurrentItem = new ReferenceDataItem();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            NotifyError(ex.Message);
        }
        finally
        {
            IsLoading = false;
        }
    }

    private async Task SelectCategory(string category)
    {
        SelectedCategory = category;

        Items = await SharePointService
            .GetReferenceDataByCategoryAsync(Module, category);

        await ApplySearch();
    }

    private async Task ApplySearch()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(SearchText))
        {
            FilteredItems = Items.ToList();
        }
        else
        {
            var search = SearchText.ToLower();

            FilteredItems = Items.Where(x =>
                (x.Title ?? "").ToLower().Contains(search) ||
                (x.Code ?? "").ToLower().Contains(search) ||
                (x.Description ?? "").ToLower().Contains(search)
            ).ToList();
        }

        if (grid != null)
        {
            await grid.FirstPage(true);
        }
    }

    private async void OnSearchInput(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        SearchText = e.Value?.ToString() ?? "";
        await ApplySearch();
    }

    private void LoadPagedData(LoadDataArgs args)
    {
        var query = FilteredItems.AsQueryable();

        TotalCount = query.Count();

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(args.OrderBy))
        {
            query = query.OrderBy(args.OrderBy);
        }

        if (args.Skip.HasValue && args.Top.HasValue)
        {
            query = query.Skip(args.Skip.Value).Take(args.Top.Value);
        }

        PagedItems = query.ToList();
    }

    private void SelectItem(ReferenceDataItem item)
    {
        CurrentItem = new ReferenceDataItem
        {
            Id = item.Id,
            Title = item.Title,
            Code = item.Code,
            Category = item.Category,
            Description = item.Description,
            Icon = item.Icon,
            Color = item.Color,
            SortOrder = item.SortOrder,
            IsActive = item.IsActive,
            IsDefault = item.IsDefault
        };
    }

    private void NewItem()
    {
        CurrentItem = new ReferenceDataItem
        {
            Category = SelectedCategory,
            IsActive = true
        };
    }

    private async Task SaveItem()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(CurrentItem.Title))
        {
            NotifyWarning("Title required");
            return;
        }

        if (CurrentItem.Id == 0)
        {
            await SharePointService.CreateReferenceDataAsync(Module, CurrentItem);
            NotifySuccess("Created");
        }
        else
        {
            await SharePointService.UpdateReferenceDataAsync(Module, CurrentItem);
            NotifySuccess("Updated");
        }

        await LoadData();
    }

    private async Task DeleteItem()
    {
        if (CurrentItem.Id == 0) return;

        if (CurrentItem.IsActive)
        {
            NotifyWarning("Deactivate before delete");
            return;
        }

        bool? confirm = await DialogService.Confirm("Delete item?", "Confirm");

        if (confirm != true) return;

        await SharePointService.DeleteReferenceDataAsync(Module, CurrentItem.Id);

        NotifySuccess("Deleted");

        await LoadData();
    }

    private void NotifySuccess(string msg) =>
        NotificationService.Notify(NotificationSeverity.Success, "Success", msg);

    private void NotifyError(string msg) =>
        NotificationService.Notify(NotificationSeverity.Error, "Error", msg);

    private void NotifyWarning(string msg) =>
        NotificationService.Notify(NotificationSeverity.Warning, "Warning", msg);
}

@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization
@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity

@using Radzen
@using Radzen.Blazor

@using MITANZ360Edu.Web.Data
@using MITANZ360Edu.Web.Models

@inject IDbContextFactory<ApplicationDbContext> DbFactory
@inject IServiceScopeFactory ScopeFactory
@inject NotificationService NotificationService

<PageTitle>User Management</PageTitle>

<div class="container mt-4 page-wrap">

    <!-- ===================================================== -->
    <!-- HEADER -->
    <!-- ===================================================== -->
    <div class="top-card mb-3">

    <!-- ===================================================== -->

    <div class="row g-3">
        @foreach (var u in FilteredUsers())

            <div class="col-12 col-md-6 col-xl-4">

                            <div class="mt-2">
                                <RadzenBadge Text="@GetStatusBadgeText(u)"

                            </div>

                            <div class="mt-2">
                                @if (userRoles.TryGetValue(u.Id, out var rr) && rr.Any())
                                {
                                    <span class="pill">@string.Join(", ", rr)</span>
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    <span class="subtle">No roles assigned</span>

                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <RadzenButton Icon="edit"

                            case UserStatus.Hold:
                            case UserStatus.Disabled:
                                <RadzenButton Text="Enable"

    </div>
</div>

<!-- ===================================================== -->
<!-- USER SIDE PANEL -->
<!-- ===================================================== -->
<RadzenSidebar Position="SidebarPosition.Right"
               Visible="@showUserBlade"
               Class="mit-blade">
    <div class="blade-header">
        <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-2">
            <RadzenIcon Icon="@userBladeIcon"
                        Style="@($"color:{userBladeIconColor};")" />

            <h4 class="mb-0">@userBladeTitle</h4>
        </div>

        <RadzenButton Icon="close"
                      Size="ButtonSize.Small"
                      ButtonStyle="ButtonStyle.Light"
                      Click="@CloseUserBlade" />
    </div>

    <div class="blade-body">
        <div class="row">
            <div class="col-md-6 mb-3">
                <RadzenLabel Text="Username" />
                <RadzenTextBox @bind-Value="model.UserName"
                               Name="Username"

                <RadzenDropDownDataGrid TValue="IEnumerable<string>"
                                        Data="@allRoles"
                                        TextProperty="Name"
                                        ValueProperty="Name"
                                        Multiple="true"
                                        Chips="true"
                                        AllowFiltering="true"
                                        @bind-Value="model.Roles"
                                        Style="width:100%;">
                    <Columns>
                        <RadzenDropDownDataGridColumn Property="Name" Title="Role" />
                    </Columns>
                </RadzenDropDownDataGrid>
            </div>

            </div>

            @if (isEditMode)
            {

                    <div class="subtle">
                        Leave password blank to keep the current password.

@code
{
    private const string HiddenUserEmail = "supper@mitanz360.edu";

    // =====================================================
    // ENUM
    // =====================================================

    private enum UserStatus
    {
        Active,
        Hold,
        Disabled
    }

    private readonly IReadOnlyList<UserStatus> statusEnumValues = Enum.GetValues<UserStatus>();

    // =====================================================
    // STATE
    // =====================================================

    private List<ApplicationUser> users = new();
    private List<RoleOption> allRoles = new();
    private Dictionary<string, List<string>> userRoles = new();

    private bool showUserBlade;
    private bool busy;
    private bool isEditMode;

    private string search = string.Empty;
    private string userBladeTitle = "New User";
    private string userBladeIcon = "person_add";
    private string userBladeIconColor = "#2563eb";

    private ApplicationUser? editingUser;
    private CreateEditUserModel model = new();

    // =====================================================
    // INITIALIZE
    // =====================================================

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await LoadRoles();
        await LoadUsersAndRoleMap();
    }

    // =====================================================
    // LOAD ROLES (IDENTITY = SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH)
    // =====================================================

    private async Task LoadRoles()
    {
        try
        {
            await using var db = await DbFactory.CreateDbContextAsync();

            allRoles = await db.Roles
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Where(r => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(r.Name))
                .OrderBy(r => r.Name)
                .Select(r => new RoleOption
                {
                    Name = r.Name!
                })
                .ToListAsync();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Notify(ex.Message, NotificationSeverity.Error);
        }
    }

    // =====================================================
    // LOAD USERS + ASSIGNED ROLES
    // =====================================================

    private async Task LoadUsersAndRoleMap()
    {
        try
        {
            await using var db = await DbFactory.CreateDbContextAsync();

            var loadedUsers = await db.Users
                .AsNoTracking()
                .OrderBy(x => x.UserName)
                .ToListAsync();

            users = loadedUsers
                .Where(u => !IsHiddenUser(u))
                .ToList();

            var visibleUserIds = users
                .Select(x => x.Id)
                .ToHashSet(StringComparer.Ordinal);

            var pairs = await
                (
                    from ur in db.UserRoles
                    join r in db.Roles on ur.RoleId equals r.Id
                    where !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(r.Name)
                    select new
                    {
                        ur.UserId,
                        RoleName = r.Name!
                    }
                )
                .AsNoTracking()
                .ToListAsync();

            userRoles = pairs
                .Where(x => visibleUserIds.Contains(x.UserId))
                .GroupBy(x => x.UserId)
                .ToDictionary(
                    g => g.Key,
                    g => g.Select(x => x.RoleName)
                          .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                          .OrderBy(x => x)
                          .ToList());
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Notify(ex.Message, NotificationSeverity.Error);
        }
    }

    // =====================================================
    // FILTER
    // =====================================================

    private IEnumerable<ApplicationUser> FilteredUsers()
    {
        var visibleUsers = users.Where(u => !IsHiddenUser(u));

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(search))
        {
            return visibleUsers;
        }

        var s = search.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();

        return visibleUsers.Where(u =>
            (u.UserName ?? string.Empty).ToLowerInvariant().Contains(s) ||
            (u.Email ?? string.Empty).ToLowerInvariant().Contains(s) ||
            (u.PhoneNumber ?? string.Empty).ToLowerInvariant().Contains(s));
    }

    // =====================================================
    // DISPLAY HELPERS
    // =====================================================

    private static string DisplayName(ApplicationUser u)
        => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(u.UserName) ? "(no username)" : u.UserName;

    private static bool IsHiddenUser(ApplicationUser u)
        => string.Equals(
            u.Email?.Trim(),
            HiddenUserEmail,
            StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    private UserStatus GetStatus(ApplicationUser u)
    {
        if (u.LockoutEnd is null || u.LockoutEnd <= DateTimeOffset.UtcNow)
        {
            return UserStatus.Active;
        }

        // Long lockout is treated as Disabled
        if (u.LockoutEnd >= DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.AddYears(50))
        {
            return UserStatus.Disabled;
        }

        return UserStatus.Hold;
    }

    private string GetStatusBadgeText(ApplicationUser u)
        => GetStatus(u) switch
        {
            UserStatus.Active => "ACTIVE",
            UserStatus.Hold => "HOLD",
            _ => "DISABLED"
        };

    private string GetStatusBadgeStyle(ApplicationUser u)
        => GetStatus(u) switch
        {
            UserStatus.Active => "background:#16a34a;color:white;",
            UserStatus.Hold => "background:#f59e0b;color:white;",
            _ => "background:#dc2626;color:white;"
        };

    // =====================================================
    // CREATE
    // =====================================================

    private async Task OpenCreateUserBlade()
    {
        await LoadRoles();

        isEditMode = false;
        editingUser = null;

        model = new CreateEditUserModel
        {
            Status = UserStatus.Active,
            Roles = Array.Empty<string>()
        };

        userBladeTitle = "New User";
        userBladeIcon = "person_add";
        userBladeIconColor = "#2563eb";

        showUserBlade = true;
    }

    // =====================================================
    // EDIT
    // =====================================================

    private async Task OpenEditUserBlade(ApplicationUser u)
    {
        if (IsHiddenUser(u))
        {
            Notify("This user cannot be managed from this screen.", NotificationSeverity.Warning);
            return;
        }

        await LoadRoles();

        isEditMode = true;
        editingUser = u;

        var roles = userRoles.TryGetValue(u.Id, out var assigned)
            ? assigned
            : new List<string>();

        model = new CreateEditUserModel
        {
            Id = u.Id,
            UserName = u.UserName ?? string.Empty,
            Email = u.Email ?? string.Empty,
            PhoneNumber = u.PhoneNumber,
            Status = GetStatus(u),
            Roles = roles.ToList(),
            Password = string.Empty,
            ConfirmPassword = string.Empty
        };

        userBladeTitle = "Edit User";
        userBladeIcon = "manage_accounts";
        userBladeIconColor = "#ea580c";

        showUserBlade = true;
    }

    // =====================================================
    // SAVE USER
    // =====================================================

    private async Task AskSaveUser()
    {
        try
        {
            busy = true;

            var validationError = ValidateModel();
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(validationError))
            {
                Notify(validationError, NotificationSeverity.Error);
                return;
            }

            using var scope = ScopeFactory.CreateScope();

            var userManager = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<UserManager<ApplicationUser>>();
            var roleManager = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<RoleManager<IdentityRole>>();

            var selectedRoles = model.Roles
                .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x))
                .Select(x => x.Trim())
                .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .ToList();

            // Validate that every selected role exists in Identity
            var existingRoleNames = await roleManager.Roles
                .Where(r => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(r.Name))
                .Select(r => r.Name!)
                .ToListAsync();

            var missingRoles = selectedRoles
                .Where(role => !existingRoleNames.Any(er => string.Equals(er, role, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
                .ToList();

            if (missingRoles.Any())
            {
                Notify($"These roles do not exist in Identity: {string.Join(", ", missingRoles)}",
                    NotificationSeverity.Error);
                return;
            }

            if (!isEditMode)
            {
                var user = new ApplicationUser
                {
                    UserName = model.UserName.Trim(),
                    Email = model.Email.Trim(),
                    PhoneNumber = NormalizeOptional(model.PhoneNumber),
                    EmailConfirmed = true
                };

                ApplyStatus(user, model.Status);

                var createResult = await userManager.CreateAsync(user, model.Password);
                if (!createResult.Succeeded)
                {
                    NotifyIdentityErrors(createResult);
                    return;
                }

                if (selectedRoles.Any())
                {
                    var addToRolesResult = await userManager.AddToRolesAsync(user, selectedRoles);
                    if (!addToRolesResult.Succeeded)
                    {
                        NotifyIdentityErrors(addToRolesResult);
                        return;
                    }
                }

                Notify("User created");
            }
            else
            {
                var user = await userManager.FindByIdAsync(model.Id!);
                if (user is null)
                {
                    Notify("User not found", NotificationSeverity.Error);
                    return;
                }

                if (IsHiddenUser(user))
                {
                    Notify("This user cannot be managed from this screen.", NotificationSeverity.Warning);
                    return;
                }

                user.UserName = model.UserName.Trim();
                user.Email = model.Email.Trim();
                user.PhoneNumber = NormalizeOptional(model.PhoneNumber);

                ApplyStatus(user, model.Status);

                var updateResult = await userManager.UpdateAsync(user);
                if (!updateResult.Succeeded)
                {
                    NotifyIdentityErrors(updateResult);
                    return;
                }

                // Optional password reset on edit
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(model.Password))
                {
                    var resetToken = await userManager.GeneratePasswordResetTokenAsync(user);
                    var resetResult = await userManager.ResetPasswordAsync(user, resetToken, model.Password);

                    if (!resetResult.Succeeded)
                    {
                        NotifyIdentityErrors(resetResult);
                        return;
                    }
                }

                // Role diff update (safer than remove-all + add-all)
                var currentRoles = await userManager.GetRolesAsync(user);

                var rolesToRemove = currentRoles
                    .Except(selectedRoles, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                    .ToList();

                var rolesToAdd = selectedRoles
                    .Except(currentRoles, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                    .ToList();

                if (rolesToRemove.Any())
                {
                    var removeResult = await userManager.RemoveFromRolesAsync(user, rolesToRemove);
                    if (!removeResult.Succeeded)
                    {
                        NotifyIdentityErrors(removeResult);
                        return;
                    }
                }

                if (rolesToAdd.Any())
                {
                    var addResult = await userManager.AddToRolesAsync(user, rolesToAdd);
                    if (!addResult.Succeeded)
                    {
                        NotifyIdentityErrors(addResult);
                        return;
                    }
                }

                Notify("User updated");
            }

            showUserBlade = false;

            await LoadRoles();
            await LoadUsersAndRoleMap();

            await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Notify(ex.Message, NotificationSeverity.Error);
        }
        finally
        {
            busy = false;
            await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
        }
    }

    // =====================================================
    // STATUS CHANGE
    // =====================================================

    private async Task AskStatusChange(ApplicationUser u, UserStatus status)
    {
        if (IsHiddenUser(u))
        {
            Notify("This user cannot be managed from this screen.", NotificationSeverity.Warning);
            return;
        }

        try
        {
            busy = true;

            using var scope = ScopeFactory.CreateScope();
            var userManager = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<UserManager<ApplicationUser>>();

            var user = await userManager.FindByIdAsync(u.Id);
            if (user is null)
            {
                Notify("User not found", NotificationSeverity.Error);
                return;
            }

            if (IsHiddenUser(user))
            {
                Notify("This user cannot be managed from this screen.", NotificationSeverity.Warning);
                return;
            }

            ApplyStatus(user, status);

            var result = await userManager.UpdateAsync(user);
            if (!result.Succeeded)
            {
                NotifyIdentityErrors(result);
                return;
            }

            Notify(status switch
            {
                UserStatus.Active => "User enabled",
                UserStatus.Hold => "User placed on hold",
                _ => "User disabled"
            });

            await LoadUsersAndRoleMap();
            await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Notify(ex.Message, NotificationSeverity.Error);
        }
        finally
        {
            busy = false;
            await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
        }
    }

    // =====================================================
    // HELPERS
    // =====================================================

    private string? ValidateModel()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(model.UserName))
        {
            return "Username is required.";
        }

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(model.Email))
        {
            return "Email is required.";
        }

        if (string.Equals(model.Email.Trim(), HiddenUserEmail, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            return "This account cannot be managed from this screen.";
        }

        if (!isEditMode && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(model.Password))
        {
            return "Password is required for a new user.";
        }

        if (!string.Equals(model.Password, model.ConfirmPassword, StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            return "Password and confirm password do not match.";
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static string? NormalizeOptional(string? value)
        => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) ? null : value.Trim();

    private static void ApplyStatus(ApplicationUser user, UserStatus status)
    {
        switch (status)
        {
            case UserStatus.Active:
                user.LockoutEnabled = false;
                user.LockoutEnd = null;
                break;

            case UserStatus.Hold:
                user.LockoutEnabled = true;
                user.LockoutEnd = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.AddDays(7);
                break;

            case UserStatus.Disabled:
                user.LockoutEnabled = true;
                user.LockoutEnd = DateTimeOffset.MaxValue;
                break;
        }
    }

    private void NotifyIdentityErrors(IdentityResult result)
    {
        Notify(
            string.Join(", ", result.Errors.Select(x => x.Description)),
            NotificationSeverity.Error);
    }

    private void CloseUserBlade()
    {
        showUserBlade = false;
    }

    private void Notify(
        string message,
        NotificationSeverity severity = NotificationSeverity.Success)
    {
        NotificationService.Notify(new NotificationMessage
        {
            Severity = severity,
            Summary = message,
            Duration = 3000
        });
    }

    // =====================================================
    // VIEW MODELS
    // =====================================================

    private sealed class RoleOption
    {
        public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }

    private sealed class CreateEditUserModel
    {
        public string? Id { get; set; }

        public string UserName { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        public string Email { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        public string? PhoneNumber { get; set; }

        public UserStatus Status { get; set; } = UserStatus.Active;

        public IEnumerable<string> Roles { get; set; } = Array.Empty<string>();

        public string Password { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        public string ConfirmPassword { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }
}

END FILE

Components\Pages\AI\AiChat.razor

@page "/ai-assistant"
@layout MainLayout

@using System.Text.Json
@using MITANZ360Edu.Web.Services.AI
@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components

@inject AiWorkflowEngine WorkflowEngine
@inject ILogger<AiChat> Logger

@code
{
    private string Prompt { get; set; } =
        string.Empty;

    private string Response { get; set; } =
        string.Empty;

    private string ErrorMessage { get; set; } =
        string.Empty;

    private bool IsLoading { get; set; }

    private string ResponseGeneratedAt { get; set; } =
        string.Empty;

    private AiOutputMode SelectedOutputMode { get; set; } =
        AiOutputMode.Text;

    private async Task ExecuteAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            ErrorMessage = string.Empty;

            Response = string.Empty;

            IsLoading = true;

            Logger.LogInformation(
                "AI chat execution started.");

            var request =
                new AiWorkflowRequest
                {
                    TaskType = AiTaskType.Chat,

                    Prompt = Prompt,

                    OutputMode = SelectedOutputMode,

                    StrictJsonResponse = false,

                    CorrelationId =
                        Guid.NewGuid().ToString()
                };

            var result =
                await WorkflowEngine.ExecuteAsync(
                    request);

            if (!result.Success)
            {
                ErrorMessage =
                    string.Join(
                        Environment.NewLine,
                        result.Errors);

                Logger.LogWarning(
                    "AI workflow returned unsuccessful result.");

                return;
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(result.RawResponse))
            {
                ErrorMessage =
                    "AI returned an empty response.";

                return;
            }

            try
            {
                using var document =
                    JsonDocument.Parse(
                        result.RawResponse);

                var content =
                    document.RootElement
                        .GetProperty("choices")[0]
                        .GetProperty("message")
                        .GetProperty("content")
                        .GetString();

                Response =
                    content ??
                    "No response generated.";
            }
            catch (Exception jsonEx)
            {
                Logger.LogWarning(
                    jsonEx,
                    "Failed to parse AI response.");

                Response =
                    "Unable to parse AI response.";
            }

            ResponseGeneratedAt =
                DateTime.Now.ToString(
                    "dd MMM yyyy hh:mm tt");

            Logger.LogInformation(
                "AI chat execution completed successfully.");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Logger.LogError(
                ex,
                "AI chat execution failed.");

            ErrorMessage =
                ex.Message;
        }
        finally
        {
            IsLoading = false;
        }
    }
}

</style>

@code
{
    private List<string> WorkflowFiles =
        [];

    private string SelectedWorkflow =
        string.Empty;

    private string Response =
        string.Empty;

    private string ErrorMessage =
        string.Empty;

    private string GeneratedAt =
        string.Empty;

    private bool IsLoading;

    private AiOutputMode SelectedOutputMode { get; set; } =
        AiOutputMode.Html;

    protected override void OnInitialized()
    {
        try
        {
            var folder =
                Path.Combine(
                    Environment.WebRootPath,
                    "AI-Eng");

            if (!Directory.Exists(folder))
            {
                Directory.CreateDirectory(folder);
            }

            WorkflowFiles =
                Directory
                    .GetFiles(folder, "*.json")
                    .Select(Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension)
                    .OrderBy(x => x)
                    .ToList();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Logger.LogError(
                ex,
                "Failed to load workflow files.");

            ErrorMessage =
                ex.Message;
        }
    }

    private async Task ExecuteWorkflowAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            ErrorMessage = string.Empty;

            Response = string.Empty;

            IsLoading = true;

            var workflowPath =
                Path.Combine(
                    Environment.WebRootPath,
                    "AI-Eng",
                    $"{SelectedWorkflow}.json");

            if (!File.Exists(workflowPath))
            {
                ErrorMessage =
                    "Workflow file not found.";

                return;
            }

            var rawJson =
                await File.ReadAllTextAsync(
                    workflowPath);

            Logger.LogInformation(
                "Executing workflow: {Workflow}",
                SelectedWorkflow);

            var request =
                new AiWorkflowRequest
                {
                    TaskType =
                        AiTaskType.Chat,

                    Prompt =
                        rawJson,

                    OutputMode =
                        SelectedOutputMode,

                    StrictJsonResponse =
                        SelectedOutputMode ==
                        AiOutputMode.JsonOnly,

                    SystemPrompt =
                        """
                        You are an enterprise AI workflow execution engine.

                        The provided JSON contains:
                        - instructions
                        - orchestration
                        - execution rules
                        - output requirements
                        - workflow metadata

                        Read the JSON carefully.

                        Execute the workflow exactly as instructed.

                        Return output according to the workflow definition.
                        """,

                    CorrelationId =
                        Guid.NewGuid().ToString()
                };

            var result =
                await WorkflowEngine.ExecuteAsync(
                    request);

            if (!result.Success)
            {
                ErrorMessage =
                    string.Join(
                        System.Environment.NewLine,
                        result.Errors);

                return;
            }

            Response =
                ExtractContent(
                    result.RawResponse);

            GeneratedAt =
                DateTime.Now.ToString(
                    "dd MMM yyyy hh:mm tt");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Logger.LogError(
                ex,
                "Workflow execution failed.");

            ErrorMessage =
                ex.Message;
        }
        finally
        {
            IsLoading = false;
        }
    }


private static string ExtractContent(
    string rawResponse)
    {
        try
        {
            // STEP 1
            // Extract AI content

            using var document =
                JsonDocument.Parse(rawResponse);

            var content =
                document.RootElement
                    .GetProperty("choices")[0]
                    .GetProperty("message")
                    .GetProperty("content")
                    .GetString();

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(content))
            {
                return rawResponse;
            }

            // STEP 2
            // Remove markdown wrappers

            content =
                content
                    .Replace("```json", "")
                    .Replace("```", "")
                    .Trim();

            // STEP 3
            // Try parse JSON

            using var jsonDocument =
                JsonDocument.Parse(content);

            var root =
                jsonDocument.RootElement;

            // STEP 4
            // Build Enterprise HTML

            var html =
                new System.Text.StringBuilder();

            html.Append(
            """
            <div class='container-fluid'>

                <div class='row g-4'>
            """);

            // SUMMARY

            if (root.TryGetProperty(
                "summary",
                out var summary))
            {
                html.Append(
                    $"""
                <div class='col-12'>

                    <div class='card glass-card-inner'>

                        <div class='card-body'>

                            <h3 class='mb-3'>
                                Executive Summary
                            </h3>

                            <p>
                                {summary.GetString()}
                            </p>

                        </div>

                    </div>

                </div>
                """);
            }

            // CURRENCY ANALYSIS

            if (root.TryGetProperty(
                "currencyAnalysis",
                out var currencies))
            {
                foreach (var item in
                    currencies.EnumerateArray())
                {
                    html.Append(
                        $"""
                    <div class='col-md-6'>

                        <div class='card glass-card-inner h-100'>

                            <div class='card-body'>

                                <h4 class='mb-3 text-primary'>
                                    {item.GetProperty("currency").GetString()}
                                </h4>

                                <table class='table table-borderless'>

                                    <tr>
                                        <td>
                                            Best Buying
                                        </td>

                                        <td>
                                            <strong>
                                                {item.GetProperty("bestBuyingBank").GetString()}
                                            </strong>
                                        </td>
                                    </tr>

                                    <tr>
                                        <td>
                                            Best Selling
                                        </td>

                                        <td>
                                            <strong>
                                                {item.GetProperty("bestSellingBank").GetString()}
                                            </strong>
                                        </td>
                                    </tr>

                                    <tr>
                                        <td>
                                            Highest Buying
                                        </td>

                                        <td>
                                            {item.GetProperty("highestBuyingRate").GetDecimal()}
                                        </td>
                                    </tr>

                                    <tr>
                                        <td>
                                            Lowest Selling
                                        </td>

                                        <td>
                                            {item.GetProperty("lowestSellingRate").GetDecimal()}
                                        </td>
                                    </tr>

                                    <tr>
                                        <td>
                                            Variance
                                        </td>

                                        <td>
                                            {item.GetProperty("variance").GetDecimal()}
                                        </td>
                                    </tr>

                                </table>

                                <div class='alert alert-primary mt-3'>

                                    {item.GetProperty("insight").GetString()}

                                </div>

                            </div>

                        </div>

                    </div>
                    """);
                }
            }

            // MARKET INSIGHTS

            if (root.TryGetProperty(
                "marketInsights",
                out var marketInsights))
            {
                html.Append(
                    $"""
                <div class='col-12'>

                    <div class='card glass-card-inner'>

                        <div class='card-body'>

                            <h3 class='mb-3'>
                                Market Insights
                            </h3>

                            <p>
                                {marketInsights.GetString()}
                            </p>

                        </div>

                    </div>

                </div>
                """);
            }

            // RISK INDICATORS

            if (root.TryGetProperty(
                "riskIndicators",
                out var risks))
            {
                html.Append(
                    $"""
                <div class='col-12'>

                    <div class='card glass-card-inner'>

                        <div class='card-body'>

                            <h3 class='mb-3 text-danger'>
                                Risk Indicators
                            </h3>

                            <p>
                                {risks.GetString()}
                            </p>

                        </div>

                    </div>

                </div>
                """);
            }

            // RECOMMENDATIONS

            if (root.TryGetProperty(
                "recommendations",
                out var recommendations))
            {
                html.Append(
                    $"""
                <div class='col-12'>

                    <div class='card glass-card-inner'>

                        <div class='card-body'>

                            <h3 class='mb-3 text-success'>
                                Recommendations
                            </h3>

                            <p>
                                {recommendations.GetString()}
                            </p>

                        </div>

                    </div>

                </div>
                """);
            }

            html.Append(
            """
                </div>

            </div>
            """);

            return html.ToString();
        }
        catch
        {
            return rawResponse;
        }
    }

@code {
    private List<AIRepositoryItem> items = new();
    private JsonObject JsonModel = new();
    private string ActiveTab = "";

    private int? SelectedItemId;

    private bool ShowDeleteConfirm;
    private bool ShowNotification;
    private string SaveMessage;
    private bool IsGenerating;

    private string SummaryText = "";
    private string HtmlContent = "";
    private string FileUrl = "";

    private string OriginalMetadata = "";

    private List<string> PromptFiles = new();
    private string SelectedPrompt = "";
    private bool isGenerating = false;
    private string aiStatusMessage = "";

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        items = await SharePointService.GetAIRepositoryItemsAsync(orderBy: "id desc");
        LoadPromptFiles();
        await RefreshNew();
    }

    private void OnCourseChanged(int? id)
    {
        SelectedItemId = id;

        if (!id.HasValue)
            return;

        var item = items.FirstOrDefault(x => x.Id == id);

        if (item == null)
        {
            Console.WriteLine("❌ Item not found");
            return;
        }

        Console.WriteLine($"✅ Loading Item ID: {item.Id}");

        try
        {
            // ✅ Keep original metadata safe
            OriginalMetadata = item.Metadata ?? "";

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(item.Metadata))
            {
                var parsed = JsonNode.Parse(item.Metadata)?.AsObject();

                if (parsed != null)
                {
                    JsonModel = parsed;

                    Console.WriteLine($"✅ Metadata loaded ({item.Metadata.Length} chars)");
                }
                else
                {
                    Console.WriteLine("⚠ Metadata parsed as null - keeping existing JsonModel");
                }
            }
            else
            {
                Console.WriteLine("⚠ Metadata is empty - keeping existing JsonModel");
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine("❌ Metadata parse failed");
            Console.WriteLine(ex.Message);

            // ✅ Never clear JsonModel
            // ✅ Never load template here
            // ✅ Never overwrite OriginalMetadata
        }

        ActiveTab = JsonModel?.FirstOrDefault().Key ?? "";

        SummaryText = item.Summary ?? "";

        SelectedPrompt = item.Tags?.Trim() ?? "";

        HtmlContent = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(item.HtmlReport)
            ? "<p>No HTML content</p>"
            : $@"<div style='background:#fff;padding:20px'>
                {SanitizeHtml(item.HtmlReport)}
            </div>";

        FileUrl = BuildFileUrl(item.Id);

        StateHasChanged();
    }

    private async Task SaveJson()
    {
        try
        {
            var courseName =
                JsonModel?["CourseSetup"]?["CourseDetails"]?["CourseName"]?.ToString()
                ?? "Untitled";

            // ✅ Never allow null / empty metadata
            var metadata =
                JsonModel != null && JsonModel.Count > 0
                    ? JsonModel.ToJsonString()
                    : OriginalMetadata;

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(metadata))
            {
                SaveMessage = "❌ Metadata cannot be empty";
                ShowNotification = true;
                return;
            }

            if (!SelectedItemId.HasValue)
            {
                // ✅ NEW RECORD
                await SharePointService.CreateAIRepositoryItemAsync(
                    new AIRepositoryItem
                    {
                        Title = courseName,
                        Metadata = metadata,
                        HtmlReport = HtmlContent,
                        Summary = SummaryText,
                        Tags = SelectedPrompt,
                        Status = "Pending",
                        Score = CalculateScore(HtmlContent)
                    });

                items = await SharePointService.GetAIRepositoryItemsAsync(orderBy: "id desc");

                SelectedItemId = items.FirstOrDefault()?.Id;

                // ✅ Keep latest metadata snapshot
                OriginalMetadata = metadata;

                SaveMessage = "✅ New course created";
            }
            else
            {
                // ✅ EXISTING RECORD
                await SharePointService.UpdateAIRepositoryItemAsync(
                    new AIRepositoryItem
                    {
                        Id = SelectedItemId.Value,
                        Title = courseName,
                        Metadata = metadata,
                        Summary = SummaryText,
                        HtmlReport = HtmlContent,
                        Tags = SelectedPrompt
                    });

                // ✅ Refresh backup after successful save
                OriginalMetadata = metadata;

                SaveMessage = "✅ Course updated";
            }

            ShowNotification = true;

            await Task.Delay(2000);

            ShowNotification = false;

            items = await SharePointService.GetAIRepositoryItemsAsync(orderBy: "id desc");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine("❌ Save Error");
            Console.WriteLine(ex);

            SaveMessage = "❌ Save failed";
            ShowNotification = true;
        }
    }

    private void ConfirmDelete()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("✅ Confirm clicked");
        ShowDeleteConfirm = true;
    }

    private void CloseDeleteDialog()
    {
        ShowDeleteConfirm = false;
    }

    private async Task DeleteCourse()
    {
        if (!SelectedItemId.HasValue) return;

        Console.WriteLine($"Deleting {SelectedItemId}");

        await SharePointService.DeleteAIRepositoryItemAsync(SelectedItemId.Value);

        items = await SharePointService.GetAIRepositoryItemsAsync(orderBy: "id desc");

        await RefreshNew();
        SaveMessage = "🗑 Deleted";
        ShowNotification = true;

        ShowDeleteConfirm = false;

        await Task.Delay(2000);
        ShowNotification = false;
    }

    private RenderFragment RenderActiveTab() => builder =>
    {
        int seq = 0;

        // ✅ SUMMARY TAB
        if (ActiveTab == "Summary")
        {
            builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
            builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", "section");

            // ✅ HEADER
            builder.OpenElement(seq++, "h3");
            builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "style", "margin-top:18px; color:darkorange;");
            builder.AddContent(seq++, "Summary");
            builder.CloseElement();

            // ✅ SUMMARY TEXT
            builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
            builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", "summary-box");
            builder.AddContent(seq++, SummaryText ?? "No summary available");
            builder.CloseElement();

            // ✅ SCORE + TAGS
            var score = CalculateScore(HtmlContent);

            builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
            builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "style",
                $"margin-top:10px;" +
                "padding:10px;" +
                "border-radius:6px;" +
                $"background:{(score > 80 ? "#d4edda" : score > 60 ? "#fff3cd" : "#f8d7da")};" +
                "border:1px solid #ddd;"
            );

            // ✅ SCORE
            builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
            builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "style", "font-weight:600;");
            builder.AddContent(seq++, $"Score: {score}");
            builder.CloseElement();

            // ✅ TAGS
            builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
            builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "style", "margin-top:6px;");
            builder.AddContent(seq++, $"Tags: {SelectedPrompt}");
            builder.CloseElement();

            builder.CloseElement(); // ✅ CLOSE SCORE BOX

            // ✅ REPORT HEADER
            builder.OpenElement(seq++, "h3");
            builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "style", "margin-top:18px; color:darkorange;");
            builder.AddContent(seq++, "Report");
            builder.CloseElement();

            // ✅ HTML RENDER
            builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
            builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "style",
                "background:#fff;" +
                "padding:10px;" +
                "border:1px solid #ddd;" +
                "max-height:400px;" +
                "overflow:auto;"
            );

            builder.AddMarkupContent(seq++, SanitizeHtml(HtmlContent));

            builder.CloseElement(); // ✅ CLOSE HTML BOX

            // ✅ FILE HEADER
            builder.OpenElement(seq++, "h3");
            builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "style", "margin-top:18px; color:darkorange;");
            builder.AddContent(seq++, "Att: File");
            builder.CloseElement();

            // ✅ FILE LINK
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(FileUrl))
            {
                builder.OpenElement(seq++, "a");
                builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "href", FileUrl);
                builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "target", "_blank");
                builder.AddContent(seq++, "📎 Download AI Result");
                builder.CloseElement();
            }
            else
            {
                builder.OpenElement(seq++, "p");
                builder.AddContent(seq++, "No file available");
                builder.CloseElement();
            }

            builder.CloseElement(); // ✅ CLOSE MAIN SECTION

            return;
        }

        // ✅ JSON TABS
        if (!JsonModel.ContainsKey(ActiveTab))
            return;

        RenderNode(builder, ref seq, JsonModel[ActiveTab], JsonModel, ActiveTab);
    };

    private void RenderNode(RenderTreeBuilder builder, ref int seq, JsonNode node, JsonObject parent, string key)
    {
        // ✅ OBJECT
        if (node is JsonObject jsonObject)
        {
            // ✅ Dropdown FIRST
            if (jsonObject.ContainsKey("Value") && jsonObject.ContainsKey("Options"))
            {
                var currentValue = jsonObject["Value"]?.ToString();

                var dropdownOptions = jsonObject["Options"]?
                    .AsArray()
                    .Select(option => option?.ToString())
                    .Where(option => option != null)
                    .ToList() ?? new List<string>();

                builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
                builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", "field");

                builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
                builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", "field-label");
                builder.AddContent(seq++, key);
                builder.CloseElement();

                builder.OpenComponent<RadzenDropDown<string>>(seq++);
                builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "Data", dropdownOptions);
                builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "Value", currentValue);
                builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "Style", "width:100%");

                builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "Change",
                    EventCallback.Factory.Create<object>(this, value =>
                    {
                        jsonObject["Value"] = value?.ToString();
                    }));

                builder.CloseComponent();
                builder.CloseElement();
                return;
            }

            // ✅ NORMAL SECTION
            builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
            builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", "section");

            builder.OpenElement(seq++, "h3");
            builder.AddContent(seq++, key);
            builder.CloseElement();

            builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
            builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", "group");

            foreach (var property in jsonObject)
            {
                RenderNode(builder, ref seq, property.Value, jsonObject, property.Key);
            }

            builder.CloseElement(); // group
            builder.CloseElement(); // section
            return;
        }

        // ✅ ARRAY (FIXED + SAFE NAMING)
        else if (node is JsonArray jsonArrayNode)
        {
            builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
            builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", "field");

            builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
            builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", "field-label");
            builder.AddContent(seq++, key);
            builder.CloseElement();

            for (int i = 0; i < jsonArrayNode.Count; i++)
            {
                int currentIndex = i;

                builder.OpenComponent<RadzenTextBox>(seq++);
                builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "Value", jsonArrayNode[currentIndex]?.ToString());
                builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "Style", "margin-bottom:6px;width:100%");

                builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "Change",
                    EventCallback.Factory.Create<string>(this, newValue =>
                    {
                        jsonArrayNode[currentIndex] = newValue;
                    }));

                builder.CloseComponent();
            }

            builder.CloseElement();
            return;
        }

        // ✅ VALUE
        else if (node is JsonValue jsonValueNode)
        {
            builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
            builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", "field");

            builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
            builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", "field-label");
            builder.AddContent(seq++, key);
            builder.CloseElement();

            builder.OpenComponent<RadzenTextBox>(seq++);
            builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "Value", jsonValueNode.ToString());
            builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "Style", "width:100%");

            builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "Change",
                EventCallback.Factory.Create<string>(this, newValue =>
                {
                    parent[key] = newValue;
                }));

            builder.CloseComponent();
            builder.CloseElement();
        }
    }

    private async Task GenerateContentAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            // ✅ Save current JSON first
            if (SelectedItemId.HasValue)
            {
                await SaveJson();
            }

            IsGenerating = true;
            SaveMessage = "🤖 Generating content...";
            ShowNotification = true;

            await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
            await Task.Yield();

            var response = await AIService.GenerateContentAsync(
                JsonModel,
                SelectedPrompt
            );

            if (response == null)
            {
                SaveMessage = "⚠ No AI response";
                return;
            }

            SaveMessage = "🧠 Processing AI response...";
            await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);

            HtmlContent = response.Html ?? "";


            SummaryText = GenerateSummary(HtmlContent);

            if (SelectedItemId.HasValue)
            {

                var aiResult = new AIResultDto
                {
                    Html = HtmlContent,
                    Summary = SummaryText,
                    Tags = SelectedPrompt,
                    // ✅ REMOVE Metadata COMPLETELY
                    Score = CalculateScore(HtmlContent)
                };

                await SharePointService.UpdateAIFieldsAsync(
                    SelectedItemId.Value,
                    aiResult,
                    SelectedPrompt,
                    CancellationToken.None
                );
            }

            SaveMessage = "✅ AI content generated & saved!";
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine("❌ AI ERROR:");
            Console.WriteLine(ex);

            SaveMessage = "❌ AI generation failed";
        }
        finally
        {
            IsGenerating = false;

            await Task.Delay(1500);
            ShowNotification = false;

            await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
        }
    }

    private string BuildFileUrl(int itemId)
    {
        var baseUrl = Configuration["SharePoint:BaseUrl"];

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(baseUrl))
        {
            Console.WriteLine("❌ SharePoint BaseUrl missing in appsettings");
            return string.Empty;
        }

        return $"{baseUrl}/AI_Result_{itemId}";
    }

    private void SetSummaryTab()
    {
        ActiveTab = "Summary";
    }

    private string ConvertJsonToRichHtml(string json)
    {
        try
        {
            var root = JsonNode.Parse(json)?.AsObject();

            if (root == null)
                return "<p>No content available</p>";

            var html = new System.Text.StringBuilder();

            html.Append("<div style='font-family:Segoe UI; line-height:1.6;'>");

            foreach (var section in root)
            {
                html.Append($"<h2 style='color:#0078d4;border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;padding-bottom:4px;'>{section.Key}</h2>");

                if (section.Value is JsonObject obj)
                {
                    foreach (var field in obj)
                    {
                        html.Append("<div style='margin-bottom:10px;'>");

                        html.Append($"<strong style='color:#333'>{field.Key}:</strong><br/>");

                        if (field.Value is JsonObject nested)
                        {
                            foreach (var sub in nested)
                            {
                                html.Append($"<div style='margin-left:15px'>• {sub.Key}: {sub.Value}</div>");
                            }
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            html.Append($"<span>{field.Value}</span>");
                        }

                        html.Append("</div>");
                    }
                }

                html.Append("<br/>");
            }

            html.Append("</div>");

            return html.ToString();
        }
        catch
        {
            return $"<pre>{System.Net.WebUtility.HtmlEncode(json)}</pre>";
        }
    }

    private void AppendField(StringBuilder sb, string label, JsonNode value)
    {
        sb.Append($@"
        <div style='display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding:6px 0; border-bottom:1px solid #f2f2f2;'>
            <span style='font-weight:500'>{label}</span>
            <span>{value}</span>
        </div>
    ");
    }

    private async Task RefreshNew()
    {
        try
        {
            Console.WriteLine("✅ NEW COURSE INITIALIZED");

            SelectedItemId = null;

            SummaryText = "";
            HtmlContent = "";
            FileUrl = "";

            items = await SharePointService.GetAIRepositoryItemsAsync(orderBy: "id desc");

            // ✅ ONLY PLACE WHERE TEMPLATE IS ALLOWED
            var path = Path.Combine(
                Env.WebRootPath,
                "Data",
                "template.json");

            JsonModel =
                JsonNode.Parse(File.ReadAllText(path))?.AsObject()
                ?? new JsonObject();

            // ✅ KEEP TEMPLATE AS BACKUP METADATA
            OriginalMetadata = JsonModel.ToJsonString();

            Console.WriteLine(
                $"✅ Template metadata loaded ({OriginalMetadata.Length} chars)");

            ActiveTab = JsonModel.FirstOrDefault().Key ?? "";

            SaveMessage = "🆕 New course template loaded";
            ShowNotification = true;

            await Task.Delay(1500);

            ShowNotification = false;

            await InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine("❌ New template load failed");
            Console.WriteLine(ex);

            SaveMessage = "❌ New template load failed";
            ShowNotification = true;
        }
    }

    private void LoadPromptFiles()
    {
        var promptFolder =
            Path.Combine(
                Env.WebRootPath,
                "Data",
                "Prompts");

        if (!Directory.Exists(promptFolder))
            return;

        PromptFiles = Directory
            .GetFiles(promptFolder, "*.txt")
            .Select(Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension)
            .OrderBy(x => x)
            .ToList();

        SelectedPrompt =
            PromptFiles.FirstOrDefault() ?? "";
    }

    private string SanitizeHtml(string html)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(html))
            return "";

        var clean = html;

        // ✅ Decode SharePoint encoding
        try
        {
            clean = System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Deserialize<string>($"\"{clean}\"") ?? clean;
            clean = System.Net.WebUtility.HtmlDecode(clean);
        }
        catch { }

        // ✅ REMOVE ExternalClass
        clean = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(
            clean,
            @"ExternalClass[^\s""]*",
            "",
            System.Text.RegularExpressions.RegexOptions.IgnoreCase
        );

        // ✅ REMOVE Bootstrap card + dark styles (MAIN FIX)
        clean = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(
            clean,
            @"\b(card|card-body|shadow-sm|mb-\d+|bg-dark|text-white)\b",
            "",
            System.Text.RegularExpressions.RegexOptions.IgnoreCase
        );

        // ✅ FORCE WHITE BACKGROUND
        clean = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(
            clean,
            @"background\s*:\s*[^;]+;",
            "background:white;",
            System.Text.RegularExpressions.RegexOptions.IgnoreCase
        );

        return clean;
    }

    private string CleanHtml(string html)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(html)) return "";

        var clean = html;

        // ✅ Remove SharePoint ExternalClass
        clean = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(
            clean,
            @"class=""ExternalClass[^""]*""",
            "",
            System.Text.RegularExpressions.RegexOptions.IgnoreCase
        );

        // ✅ Remove Bootstrap card classes completely
        clean = clean.Replace("card", "")
                     .Replace("card-body", "")
                     .Replace("shadow-sm", "")
                     .Replace("mb-4", "");

        return clean;
    }

    private string GenerateSummary(string html)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(html)) return "";

        // ✅ Remove HTML tags
        var text = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(html, "<.*?>", " ");

        // ✅ Trim + limit
        text = text.Trim();

        if (text.Length > 200)
            text = text.Substring(0, 200) + "...";

        return text;
    }

    private decimal CalculateScore(string html)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(html)) return 0;

        decimal score = 50;

        if (html.Contains("<table")) score += 15;
        if (html.Contains("<ul")) score += 10;
        if (html.Contains("<h2")) score += 10;
        if (html.Length > 1000) score += 15;

        return Math.Min(score, 100);
    }


}

    private List<string> Categories = new();
    private List<string> CourseTypes = new();
    private List<string> Levels = new();
    private List<string> Languages = new();
    private List<string> DeliveryModes = new();

    [Parameter]
    public int? Id { get; set; }

    private CourseModel Model = new();

    private string? errorMessage;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            if (Id.HasValue && Id.Value > 0)
            {
                var course =
                    await SharePointService
                        .GetCourseByIdAsync(Id.Value);

                if (course != null)
                {
                    Model = course;
                }
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Logger.LogError(
                ex,
                "Error loading course.");

            errorMessage = ex.Message;
        }
        // ✅ Load JSON files

        Categories = await LoadJsonList("wwwroot/data/course-categories.json");
        CourseTypes = await LoadJsonList("wwwroot/data/course-types.json");
        Levels = await LoadJsonList("wwwroot/data/course-levels.json");
        Languages = await LoadJsonList("wwwroot/data/course-languages.json");
        DeliveryModes = await LoadJsonList("wwwroot/data/course-delivery-modes.json");
    }

    private async Task SaveAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            if (Model.Id > 0)
            {
                await SharePointService
                    .UpdateCourseAsync(Model);
            }
            else
            {
                await SharePointService
                    .CreateCourseAsync(Model);
            }

            NavigationManager.NavigateTo("/courses");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Logger.LogError(
                ex,
                "Error saving course.");

            errorMessage = ex.Message;
        }
    }

    private void Cancel()
    {
        NavigationManager.NavigateTo("/courses");
    }

    private async Task<List<string>> LoadJsonList(string path)
    {
        var json = await File.ReadAllTextAsync(path);

        return System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer
            .Deserialize<List<string>>(json) ?? new();
    }
}

    private List<CourseModel> Courses = new();

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            isLoading = true;

            Courses =
                (await SharePointService.GetCoursesAsync())
                .ToList();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Logger.LogError(
                ex,
                "Error loading courses.");

            errorMessage = ex.Message;
        }
        finally
        {
            isLoading = false;
        }
    }

            $"/courses/edit/{id}");
    }

    private static string GetImageUrl(string? imageUrl)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(imageUrl))
            return "/Images/Courses/AI-Edu.png";

        return imageUrl.StartsWith("http", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            ? imageUrl
            : $"/Images/Courses/{imageUrl}";
    }

@code {

    private List<CourseModel> courses = new();
    private bool isLoading = true;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            courses = (await SharePointService.GetCoursesAsync())?.ToList() ?? new();
        }
        finally
        {
            isLoading = false;
        }
    }

    // ✅ Navigate to Course Information Page by CourseId only
    private void OpenCourseInfo(CourseModel course)
    {
        if (course == null) return;

        Nav.NavigateTo($"/course/{course.Id}");
    }

    // ✅ ✅ ✅ FINAL FIX — SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH
    private void OpenCourse(CourseModel course)
    {
        if (course == null || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(course.FolderId))
            return;

        // ✅ FORCE correct display name (fallback logic)
        var displayName = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(course.CourseCode)
            ? course.CourseCode        // ✅ USE THIS (Test001)
            : course.Title ?? "Course";

        var safeName = Uri.EscapeDataString(displayName);

        //Nav.NavigateTo($"/course/{course.FolderId}?name={safeName}");
        Nav.NavigateTo($"/lms-student-cont-viewer/{course.FolderId}");
    }

    private static string GetImageUrl(string? imageUrl)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(imageUrl))
            return "/Images/Courses/AI-Edu.png";

        return imageUrl.StartsWith("http", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            ? imageUrl
            : $"/Images/Courses/{imageUrl}";
    }

    private async Task ConfirmDelete(int courseId, string? title)
    {
        var confirmed = await DialogService.Confirm(
            $"Are you sure you want to delete '{title ?? "this course"}'?",
            "Confirm Delete",
            new ConfirmOptions
            {
                OkButtonText = "Yes, Delete",
                CancelButtonText = "Cancel"
            });

        if (confirmed != true)
            return;

        try
        {
            await SharePointService.DeleteCourseAsync(courseId);

            // ✅ Update UI immediately
            courses = courses.Where(c => c.Id != courseId).ToList();

            // ✅ Optional success message (recommended)
            await DialogService.Alert("Course deleted successfully.", "Success");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            await DialogService.Alert(ex.Message, "Delete Failed");
        }
    }
    private async Task ConfirmClone(int courseId, string? title)
    {
        var original = await SharePointService.GetCourseByIdAsync(courseId);

        if (original == null)
        {
            await DialogService.Alert("Course not found", "Error");
            return;
        }

        var clone = new CourseModel
        {
            Title = original.Title + " (Copy)",
            CourseCode = original.CourseCode + "-COPY",
            CourseCategory = original.CourseCategory,
            CourseType = original.CourseType,
            Level = original.Level
        };

        var newId = await SharePointService.CreateCourseAsync(clone);

        Nav.NavigateTo($"/courses/edit/{newId}");
    }
}

@code {
    [Parameter] public List<LibraryItem> Items { get; set; } = new();
    [Parameter] public LibraryItem? SelectedItem { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public bool IsLoading { get; set; }

    [Parameter] public EventCallback<LibraryItem> OnItemSelected { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public EventCallback<LibraryItem> OnItemOpen { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public EventCallback<LibraryItem> OnFolderOpen { get; set; }

    // ✅ ADD THIS (REQUIRED)
    [Parameter] public EventCallback<LibraryItem> OnEditRequested { get; set; }

    private string _sortField = "name";
    private bool _sortAsc = true;

    private string FolderCountLabel =>
        $"{Items.Count(x => x.IsFolder)} folders";

    private string FileCountLabel =>
        $"{Items.Count(x => !x.IsFolder)} files";

    private async Task SelectAsync(LibraryItem item)
    {
        await OnItemSelected.InvokeAsync(item);
    }

    private async Task OpenAsync(LibraryItem item)
    {
        if (item.IsFolder)
            await OnFolderOpen.InvokeAsync(item);
        else
            await OnItemOpen.InvokeAsync(item);
    }

    private void Sort(string field)
    {
        if (_sortField == field)
            _sortAsc = !_sortAsc;
        else
        {
            _sortField = field;
            _sortAsc = true;
        }
    }

    private IEnumerable<LibraryItem> SortedItems()
    {
        var folders = Items.Where(x => x.IsFolder)
            .OrderBy(x => x.Name);

        var files = SortFiles(Items.Where(x => !x.IsFolder));

        return folders.Concat(files);
    }

    private IEnumerable<LibraryItem> SortFiles(IEnumerable<LibraryItem> files)
    {
        var sorted = _sortField switch
        {
            "size" => files.OrderBy(x => x.Size),
            "modified" => files.OrderBy(x => x.LastModified),
            _ => files.OrderBy(x => x.Name)
        };

        return _sortAsc ? sorted : sorted.Reverse();
    }

    private string GetSortIndicator(string field)
    {
        if (_sortField != field) return "";
        return _sortAsc ? "↑" : "↓";
    }

    private string GetDisplayName(LibraryItem item) =>
        string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(item.Name) ? "(Unnamed)" : item.Name;

    private string GetTypeLabel(LibraryItem item) =>
        item.IsFolder ? "Folder" :
        System.IO.Path.GetExtension(item.Name)?.TrimStart('.').ToUpper() ?? "FILE";

    private string FormatSize(long bytes)
    {
        if (bytes < 1024) return $"{bytes} B";
        if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return $"{bytes / 1024.0:F1} KB";
        return $"{bytes / (1024.0 * 1024):F2} MB";
    }
    private async Task ViewDocument(LibraryItem item)
    {
        if (item == null || item.IsFolder)
            return;

        await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("open", $"/api/files/{item.Id}", "_blank");
    }

}

Components\Pages\Folders\DocumentViewer.razor
====================================================================
@* ============================================================
   DocumentViewer
   Renders a LibraryItem in-browser. Office documents are served
   through /api/documents/render/{id}, which converts them to PDF
   server-side (see SharePointService.DocumentViewer.cs) — the
   student never gets a direct download link to the original file.
   ============================================================ *@
@using MITANZ360Edu.Web.Services

<div class="doc-viewer">

    @if (!IsSupported)
    {
        <div class="doc-viewer-empty">
            <div class="doc-viewer-empty-icon">📄</div>
            <div>This file type can't be previewed in-browser.</div>
        </div>
    }
    else if (IsLoading)
    {
        <div class="doc-viewer-loading">
            <div class="doc-viewer-spinner" aria-hidden="true"></div>
            <div>@LoadingMessage</div>
        </div>
    }
    else if (HasError)
    {
        <div class="doc-viewer-empty doc-viewer-error">
            <div class="doc-viewer-empty-icon">⚠️</div>
            <div>@ErrorMessage</div>
        </div>
    }
    else if (ViewMode == "image")
    {
        <img class="doc-viewer-image"
             src="@RenderUrl"
             alt="@(Item?.Title ?? Item?.Name)"
             @onload="HandleLoaded"
             @onerror="HandleError" />
    }
    else
    {
        @* Covers PDF (native + converted), HTML, and text *@
        <iframe class="doc-viewer-frame"
                src="@FrameSrc"
                title="@(Item?.Title ?? Item?.Name)"
                @onload="HandleLoaded"></iframe>
    }

</div>

@code {
    /// <summary>The library item to preview. Only Name/Id/Title need to be set.</summary>
    [Parameter, EditorRequired] public LibraryItem? Item { get; set; }

    private bool IsLoading = true;
    private bool HasError;
    private string ErrorMessage = "";
    private string ViewMode = "";
    private bool IsSupported = true;
    private LibraryItem? _lastItem;

    private static readonly HashSet<string> ImageExtensions = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
        { ".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".gif", ".webp" };

    private static readonly HashSet<string> ViewableExtensions = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
    {
        ".pdf", ".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".gif", ".webp", ".htm", ".html", ".txt",
        ".doc", ".docx", ".rtf", ".odt", ".xls", ".xlsx", ".ods",
        ".ppt", ".pptx", ".odp", ".vsd", ".vsdx"
    };

    private string LoadingMessage =>
        IsOfficeType ? "Preparing document for preview…" : "Loading…";

    private bool IsOfficeType
    {
        get
        {
            var ext = Path.GetExtension(Item?.Name ?? "");
            return !ImageExtensions.Contains(ext) &&
                   !string.Equals(ext, ".pdf", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
                   !string.Equals(ext, ".htm", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
                   !string.Equals(ext, ".html", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
                   !string.Equals(ext, ".txt", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        }
    }

    private string RenderUrl =>
        $"/api/documents/render/{Uri.EscapeDataString(Item!.Id)}";

    // #toolbar=0&navpanes=0 suppresses the built-in download/print controls
    // in Chromium's native PDF viewer. Firefox and Safari do not honor this
    // fragment, so this reduces — but cannot fully guarantee — download
    // access from the browser's own viewer chrome. There is no browser API
    // that fully disables it; the reliable control point is that we never
    // link to the original file for Office documents.
    private string FrameSrc =>
        ViewMode == "pdf" ? $"{RenderUrl}#toolbar=0&navpanes=0" : RenderUrl;

    protected override void OnParametersSet()
    {
        if (Item == null || Item.Id == _lastItem?.Id)
            return;

        _lastItem = Item;
        IsLoading = true;
        HasError = false;

        var ext = Path.GetExtension(Item.Name ?? "");

        IsSupported = ViewableExtensions.Contains(ext);

        ViewMode = ImageExtensions.Contains(ext)
            ? "image"
            : string.Equals(ext, ".pdf", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                ? "pdf"
                : IsOfficeType
                    ? "pdf"   // Office docs are served pre-converted as PDF
                    : "raw";  // html / txt
    }

    private void HandleLoaded() => IsLoading = false;

    private void HandleError()
    {
        IsLoading = false;
        HasError = true;
        ErrorMessage = "This file couldn't be loaded. It may have been moved or you may not have access.";
    }
}

<style>
    .doc-viewer {
        position: relative;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        min-height: 480px;
        background: #f6f8fb;
        border-radius: 10px;
        overflow: hidden;
        border: 1px solid #e6ebf5;
    }

    .doc-viewer-frame,
    .doc-viewer-image {
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        min-height: 480px;
        border: 0;
        display: block;
        background: #fff;
    }

    .doc-viewer-image {
        object-fit: contain;
    }

    .doc-viewer-loading,
    .doc-viewer-empty {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        gap: 10px;
        color: #6d7b99;

    }
