@* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   LibraryBreadcrumb.razor  (new)

   Per the architecture doc's open question: SharePointService has no
   "get parent chain" call today, so this builds the trail client-side
   from the folder-click history the workspace already tracks, rather
   than adding a new Graph round-trip. If a server-side parent chain
   is added later, only LibraryWorkspace's PathStack construction needs
   to change — this component just renders whatever list it's given.
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ *@
@using MITANZ360Edu.Web.Services

<div class="lib-breadcrumb">
    <span class="crumb root @(Path.Count == 0 ? "current" : "")" @onclick="() => OnCrumbClick.InvokeAsync(null)">
        📚 Library
    </span>

    @for (int i = 0; i < Path.Count; i++)
    {
        var folder = Path[i];
        var isLast = i == Path.Count - 1;
        <span class="crumb-sep">›</span>
        <span class="crumb @(isLast ? "current" : "")" @onclick="() => OnCrumbClick.InvokeAsync(isLast ? null : folder)">
            @(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(folder.Title) ? folder.Name : folder.Title)
        </span>
    }
</div>

@code {
    [Parameter] public List<LibraryItem> Path { get; set; } = new();
    [Parameter] public EventCallback<LibraryItem?> OnCrumbClick { get; set; }
}

        .crumb:hover {

                <div class="lms-action-bar">

                        }
                    </button>

                    <button type="button"
                            class="btn-open-online"
                            @onclick="OpenOnlineAsync"
                            disabled="@string.IsNullOrEmpty(Item.WebUrl)">
                        🔗 Open Online
                    </button>

                    <button type="button"
                            class="btn-danger"
                            @onclick="() => showDeleteConfirm = true"
                            disabled="@(isSaving || isDeleting)">
                        🗑 Delete
                    </button>

                    <button type="button"
                            class="btn-secondary"
                            @onclick="CancelEdit"
                            disabled="@isSaving">
                        ✕ Cancel
                    </button>

                    <button @onclick="ViewDocument" class="btn-secondary">
                        View / Download
                    </button>


                    @if (LastSavedAt.HasValue)
                    {
                        <span style="font-size:.75rem;color:#94a3b8;margin-left:8px;">
                            ✔ Saved @LastSavedAt.Value.ToString("HH:mm:ss")
                        </span>
                    }
                </div>
            }
        </div>

        <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
             RIGHT PANEL — QUICK INFO + STATUS + RELATED
        ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
        <div class="lms-right">

            @if (Item != null)
            {
                <!-- PUBLISH STATUS BANNER -->
                <div class="publish-banner @GetPublishBannerClass()">
                    <span style="font-size:1.2rem;">@GetPublishBannerIcon()</span>
                    <div>
                        <div style="font-weight:700;font-size:.88rem;">@GetPublishStatusLabel()</div>
                        <div style="font-size:.72rem;opacity:.85;">@GetPublishBannerSub()</div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- QUICK INFO -->
                <div class="mini-card">
                    <h4>Quick Info</h4>
                    <div class="quick-info-row">
                        <span class="qi-label">File</span>
                        <span class="qi-value">@Item.Name</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="quick-info-row">
                        <span class="qi-label">Type</span>
                        <span class="qi-value">
                            <span class="file-type-badge @GetFileTypeCss()">
                                @GetFileTypeIcon() @GetFileTypeLabel()
                            </span>
                        </span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="quick-info-row">
                        <span class="qi-label">Size</span>
                        <span class="qi-value">@FormatFileSize(Item.Size)</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="quick-info-row">
                        <span class="qi-label">Modified</span>
                        <span class="qi-value">@Item.LastModified?.ToString("dd MMM yyyy")</span>
                    </div>
                    @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Item.CourseId))
                    {
                        <div class="quick-info-row">
                            <span class="qi-label">Course</span>
                            <span class="qi-value">@Item.CourseId</span>
                        </div>
                    }
                    @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Item.ContentId))
                    {
                        <div class="quick-info-row">
                            <span class="qi-label">Content ID</span>
                            <span class="qi-value" style="font-family:monospace;font-size:.75rem;">@Item.ContentId</span>
                        </div>
                    }
                </div>

                <!-- CONTENT TYPE -->
                @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Item.ContentTypeCode))
                {
                    <div class="mini-card">
                        <h4>Content Type</h4>
                        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
                            <span class="ct-tag">@GetActTypeIcon(Item.ContentTypeCode) @Item.ContentTypeCode</span>
                            @if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Item.Source))

@code {

    [Parameter] public string ItemId { get; set; } = "";

    // ✅ Inject Configuration directly (clean solution)
    [Inject] IConfiguration Config { get; set; } = default!;

    private string DriveId = "";

    private LibraryItem? Item;
    private ActMetadata ActMeta = new();

    private bool isLoading = true;
    private bool isSaving = false;
    private bool isDeleting = false;
    private bool showDeleteConfirm = false;

    private string StatusMessage = "";
    private string StatusClass = "info";
    private string StatusIcon = "ℹ️";

    private DateTime? LastSavedAt;

    private int MetaTab = 0;

    private string JsonValidationMsg = "";
    private string JsonValidationClass = "info";

    List<CourseModel> courses = new();
    List<CourseDropdownDto> courseDropdownList = new();

    // ✅ INIT
    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            isLoading = true;

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ItemId))
            {
                SetStatus("❌ Invalid item URL.", "error");
                return;
            }

            DriveId = Config["SharePoint:Libraries:LMS:DriveId"];

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(DriveId))
            {
                SetStatus("❌ DriveId missing in config.", "error");
                return;
            }

            // ✅ Load item
            Item = await _spService.GetItemAsync(DriveId, ItemId);

            if (Item == null)
            {
                SetStatus("❌ Item not found.", "error");
                return;
            }

            // ✅ EXISTING LOGIC
            ParseActMeta();

            // ✅ ✅ ✅ ADD THIS BLOCK (Course Dropdown)

            var allCourses = (await _spService.GetCoursesAsync()).ToList();
            courses = allCourses;

            courseDropdownList = courses.Select(c => new CourseDropdownDto
            {
                Id = c.Id,
                Code = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(c.CourseCode)
                    ? $"COURSE-{c.Id}"
                    : c.CourseCode,
                Display = $"{c.CourseCode ?? "NO-CODE"} - {c.Title}"
            }).ToList();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            SetStatus($"❌ Load error: {ex.Message}", "error");
        }
        finally
        {
            isLoading = false;
        }
    }
    // ✅ SAVE
    private async Task SaveChangesAsync()
    {
        if (Item == null) return;

        try
        {
            isSaving = true;
            StatusMessage = "";

            SyncActMetaToJson();

            // ✅ ✅ ADD HERE (THIS IS THE FIX)
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Item.ContentId))
            {
                Item.ContentId = GenerateCONTref();
            }

            // ✅ Save AFTER assigning ID
            await _spService.UpdateLibraryItemFullAsync(DriveId, ItemId, Item);

            LastSavedAt = DateTime.Now;
            SetStatus("✅ Saved successfully.", "success");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            SetStatus($"❌ Save failed: {ex.Message}", "error");
        }
        finally
        {
            isSaving = false;
        }
    }
    // ✅ DELETE
    private async Task DeleteItemAsync()
    {
        if (Item == null) return;

        try
        {
            isDeleting = true;
            showDeleteConfirm = false;

            await _spService.DeleteItemAsync(DriveId, ItemId);

            Nav.NavigateTo("/lms-library?deleted=1");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            SetStatus($"❌ Delete failed: {ex.Message}", "error");
        }
        finally
        {
            isDeleting = false;
        }
    }

    // ✅ QUICK ACTIONS
    private async Task TogglePublishAsync()
    {
        if (Item == null) return;
        Item.IsPublished = !Item.IsPublished;
        await SaveChangesAsync();
    }

    private async Task ToggleArchiveAsync()
    {
        if (Item == null) return;
        Item.IsArchived = !Item.IsArchived;
        await SaveChangesAsync();
    }

    private void CancelEdit() => Nav.NavigateTo("/lms-library");

    private async Task OpenOnlineAsync()
    {
        if (Item == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(Item.WebUrl)) return;
        await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("open", Item.WebUrl, "_blank");
    }

    private async Task CopyItemIdToClipboard()
    {
        if (Item == null) return;
        await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("navigator.clipboard.writeText", Item.Id);
        SetStatus("✅ Copied.", "success");
    }

    // ✅ ACT META
    private void ParseActMeta()
    {
        if (Item == null || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Item.ACTMetaJson))
        {
            ActMeta = new();
            return;
        }

        try
        {
            ActMeta = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ActMetadata>(
                Item.ACTMetaJson,
                new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true }
            ) ?? new();
        }
        catch { ActMeta = new(); }
    }

    private void SyncActMetaToJson()
    {
        if (Item == null) return;

        try
        {
            Item.ACTMetaJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(ActMeta);
        }
        catch { }
    }

    // ✅ JSON
    private void FormatMetadataJson()
    {
        if (Item == null) return;

        try
        {
            var parsed = JsonDocument.Parse(Item.MetadataJson ?? "{}");
            Item.MetadataJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(parsed, new JsonSerializerOptions { WriteIndented = true });

            JsonValidationMsg = "✅ JSON formatted.";
            JsonValidationClass = "success";
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            JsonValidationMsg = $"❌ Invalid JSON: {ex.Message}";
            JsonValidationClass = "error";
        }
    }

    private void ValidateMetadataJson()
    {
        if (Item == null) return;

        try
        {
            JsonDocument.Parse(Item.MetadataJson ?? "{}");

            JsonValidationMsg = "✅ Valid JSON.";
            JsonValidationClass = "success";
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            JsonValidationMsg = $"❌ Invalid JSON: {ex.Message}";
            JsonValidationClass = "error";
        }
    }

    // ✅ UI HELPERS
    private void SetStatus(string message, string type)
    {
        StatusMessage = message;
        StatusClass = type;
        StatusIcon = type switch
        {
            "success" => "✅",
            "error" => "⛔",
            _ => "ℹ️"
        };
    }

    private string GetPublishStatusClass() =>
        Item?.IsArchived == true ? "archived" :
        Item?.IsPublished == true ? "published" : "unpublished";

    private string GetPublishStatusLabel() =>
        Item?.IsArchived == true ? "Archived" :
        Item?.IsPublished == true ? "Published" : "Draft";

    private string GetPublishBannerClass() =>
        Item?.IsArchived == true ? "archived" :
        Item?.IsPublished == true ? "" : "unpublished";

    private string GetPublishBannerIcon() =>
        Item?.IsArchived == true ? "🗄" :
        Item?.IsPublished == true ? "✅" : "⏳";

    private string GetPublishBannerSub() =>
        Item?.IsArchived == true ? "Archived" :
        Item?.IsPublished == true ? "Visible" :
        "Draft";

    // ✅ FILE TYPE
    private string GetFileTypeCss()
    {
        var mime = Item?.ContentType?.ToLower() ?? "";
        if (Item?.IsFolder == true) return "ft-folder";
        if (mime.Contains("pdf")) return "ft-pdf";
        if (mime.Contains("word")) return "ft-word";
        if (mime.Contains("excel")) return "ft-excel";
        if (mime.Contains("powerpoint")) return "ft-ppt";
        if (mime.Contains("video")) return "ft-video";
        if (mime.Contains("image")) return "ft-image";
        return "ft-other";
    }

    private string GetFileTypeIcon()
    {
        if (Item?.IsFolder == true) return "📁";
        var mime = Item?.ContentType?.ToLower() ?? "";
        if (mime.Contains("pdf")) return "📕";
        if (mime.Contains("word")) return "📘";
        if (mime.Contains("excel")) return "📗";
        if (mime.Contains("powerpoint")) return "📙";
        if (mime.Contains("video")) return "🎬";
        if (mime.Contains("image")) return "🖼️";
        return "📄";
    }

    private string GetFileTypeLabel()
    {
        if (Item?.IsFolder == true) return "Folder";
        var mime = Item?.ContentType?.ToLower() ?? "";
        if (mime.Contains("pdf")) return "PDF";
        if (mime.Contains("word")) return "Word";
        if (mime.Contains("excel")) return "Excel";
        if (mime.Contains("powerpoint")) return "PowerPoint";
        if (mime.Contains("video")) return "Video";
        if (mime.Contains("image")) return "Image";
        return "File";
    }

    private string GetActTypeIcon(string? type) => type?.ToLower() switch
    {
        "reading" => "📖",
        "video" => "🎬",
        "quiz" => "✅",
        "group" => "👥",
        "lab" => "🧪",
        "assignment" => "📝",
        _ => "📄"
    };

    private string FormatFileSize(long bytes)
    {
        if (bytes <= 0) return "—";
        if (bytes < 1024) return $"{bytes} B";
        if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return $"{bytes / 1024.0:F1} KB";
        return $"{bytes / (1024.0 * 1024):F2} MB";
    }

    private async Task ViewDocument()
    {
        await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("open", $"/api/files/{ItemId}", "_blank");
    }
    
    public class CourseDropdownDto
    {
        public int Id { get; set; }
        public string Code { get; set; }
        public string Display { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }

    public string GenerateCONTref()
    {
        var now = DateTime.UtcNow;

        return $"CONT-{now:yyyy-ddHHmmssfff}";
    }

    private void OnCourseChanged(object value)
    {
        if (Item == null) return;

        Item.CourseId = value?.ToString() ?? "";

        var course = courses.FirstOrDefault(c => c.CourseCode == Item.CourseId);

        if (course == null) return;

        var meta = new
        {
            courseCode = course.CourseCode,
            courseTitle = course.Title,
            courseDescription = StripHtml(course.Description)
        };

        Item.MetadataJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(meta, new JsonSerializerOptions
        {
            WriteIndented = true
        });
    }

    private string StripHtml(string? html)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(html)) return "";

        // ✅ Remove HTML tags
        var text = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(html, "<.*?>", string.Empty);

        // ✅ Decode HTML entities (&nbsp;, &#128216;, etc.)
        text = System.Net.WebUtility.HtmlDecode(text);

        // ✅ Optional: normalize spaces
        text = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(text, @"\s+", " ").Trim();

        return text;
    }
}

Components\Pages\Folders\LibraryTree.razor

@using System.Linq
@using MITANZ360Edu.Web.Services
@inject SharePointService _spService

<div class="lib-nav-shell">
    <div class="lib-nav-header">
        <div class="lib-nav-title">LIBRARY NAVIGATION</div>

        <button type="button"
                class="lib-nav-collapse-btn"
                title="Collapse navigation"
                aria-label="Collapse navigation">
            &#171;
        </button>
    </div>

    <div class="lib-tree" role="tree" aria-label="Library folders">
        @if (isLoadingRoot)
        {
            <div class="lib-tree-empty">Loading library…</div>
        }
        else
        {
            @foreach (var item in _rootItems)
            {
                @RenderTreeItem(item, 0)
            }
        }
    </div>
</div>

@code {
    [Parameter] public string DriveId { get; set; } = "";
    [Parameter] public LibraryItem? SelectedFolder { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public EventCallback<LibraryItem> OnFolderSelected { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public EventCallback<string> OnDriveResolved { get; set; }
    [Parameter] public EventCallback<List<LibraryItem>> OnRootLoaded { get; set; }

    private List<LibraryItem> _rootItems = new();
    private readonly Dictionary<string, List<LibraryItem>> _childrenCache = new();
    private readonly HashSet<string> _expanded = new();
    private readonly HashSet<string> _loadingFolders = new();

    private bool isLoadingRoot = true;
    private string? _lastLoadedDriveId;

    protected override async Task OnParametersSetAsync()
    {
        // Safer than only OnInitializedAsync when parameters can change later.
        if (_rootItems.Count == 0 || _lastLoadedDriveId != DriveId)
        {
            await LoadRootAsync();
            _lastLoadedDriveId = DriveId;
        }
    }

    private async Task LoadRootAsync()
    {
        isLoadingRoot = true;

        try
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(DriveId))
            {
                var ctx = await _spService.GetRootContextAsync();

                DriveId = ctx.DriveId;

                _rootItems = ctx.Items
                    .Where(x => x.IsFolder)
                    .ToList();

                _childrenCache["root"] = ctx.Items;

                if (OnDriveResolved.HasDelegate)
                    await OnDriveResolved.InvokeAsync(DriveId);

                if (OnRootLoaded.HasDelegate)
                    await OnRootLoaded.InvokeAsync(ctx.Items);
            }
            else
            {
                var items = await _spService.GetLibraryFolderChildrenAsync(DriveId, "root");

                _rootItems = items
                    .Where(x => x.IsFolder)
                    .ToList();

                _childrenCache["root"] = items;

                if (OnRootLoaded.HasDelegate)
                    await OnRootLoaded.InvokeAsync(items);
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            isLoadingRoot = false;
        }
    }

    private async Task ToggleExpandAsync(LibraryItem folder)
    {
        if (_expanded.Contains(folder.Id))
        {
            _expanded.Remove(folder.Id);
            return;
        }

        _expanded.Add(folder.Id);

        if (!_childrenCache.ContainsKey(folder.Id))
        {
            _loadingFolders.Add(folder.Id);
            StateHasChanged();

            try
            {
                var children = await _spService.GetLibraryFolderChildrenAsync(folder.DriveId, folder.Id);
                _childrenCache[folder.Id] = children ?? new List<LibraryItem>();
            }
            finally
            {
                _loadingFolders.Remove(folder.Id);
            }
        }
    }

    private async Task SelectFolderAsync(LibraryItem item)
    {
        if (OnFolderSelected.HasDelegate)
            await OnFolderSelected.InvokeAsync(item);
    }

    private async Task HandleKeyDownAsync(Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Web.KeyboardEventArgs e, LibraryItem item)
    {
        if (e.Key == "Enter" || e.Key == " ")
        {
            await SelectFolderAsync(item);
        }
    }

    private string GetDisplayName(LibraryItem item)
        => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(item.Title) ? item.Name : item.Title;

    private string GetNodeIcon(LibraryItem item, int depth)
    {
        var name = GetDisplayName(item).Trim();

        // top-level style by semantic name
        if (depth == 0)
        {
            if (name.Contains("AI-Generated-Reports", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return "⭐";
            if (name.Contains("All-Staff", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return "👥";
            if (name.Contains("Courses", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return "🎓";
            if (name.Contains("Group-Administrators", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return "👥";
        }

        if (name.Contains("sysadmin", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return "🌐";
        if (name.Contains("Tutor", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return "👤";
        if (name.Contains("Models", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return "🧊";
        if (name.Contains("Activities", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return "📈";
        if (name.Contains("Share", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return "🔗";
        if (name.Contains("Assessment", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return "📋";

        return "📁";
    }

    private string GetItemClass(bool isSelected, int depth)
    {
        var cls = "lib-tree-item";
        if (isSelected) cls += " selected";
        if (depth == 0) cls += " top-level";
        return cls;
    }

    private RenderFragment RenderTreeItem(LibraryItem item, int depth) => builder =>
    {
        if (!item.IsFolder) return;

        var isExpanded = _expanded.Contains(item.Id);
        var isSelected = SelectedFolder?.Id == item.Id;
        var isLoadingThis = _loadingFolders.Contains(item.Id);
        var displayName = GetDisplayName(item);
        var iconText = GetNodeIcon(item, depth);

        var seq = 0;

        builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", "lib-tree-node");

        // ROW
        builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", GetItemClass(isSelected, depth));
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "style", $"--node-indent:{depth * 22}px;");
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "role", "treeitem");
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "tabindex", "0");
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "aria-expanded", item.IsFolder ? isExpanded : null);
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "onclick", EventCallback.Factory.Create(this, () => SelectFolderAsync(item)));
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "onkeydown", EventCallback.Factory.Create<Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Web.KeyboardEventArgs>(this, e => HandleKeyDownAsync(e, item)));

        // CHEVRON
        builder.OpenElement(seq++, "span");
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", $"lib-tree-chevron {(isExpanded ? "expanded" : "")}");
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "title", isExpanded ? "Collapse" : "Expand");
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "onclick", EventCallback.Factory.Create(this, () => ToggleExpandAsync(item)));
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "onclick:stopPropagation", true);
        builder.AddContent(seq++, item.IsFolder ? "▸" : "");
        builder.CloseElement();

        // ICON
        builder.OpenElement(seq++, "span");
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", "lib-tree-icon");
        builder.AddContent(seq++, iconText);
        builder.CloseElement();

        // NAME
        builder.OpenElement(seq++, "span");
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", "lib-tree-name");
        builder.AddContent(seq++, displayName);
        builder.CloseElement();

        // LOADING
        if (isLoadingThis)
        {
            builder.OpenElement(seq++, "span");
            builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", "lib-tree-spinner");
            builder.AddContent(seq++, "…");
            builder.CloseElement();
        }

        builder.CloseElement(); // row

        // CHILDREN
        if (isExpanded && _childrenCache.ContainsKey(item.Id))
        {
            builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
            builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", "lib-tree-children");

            foreach (var child in _childrenCache[item.Id].Where(x => x.IsFolder))
            {
                builder.AddContent(seq++, RenderTreeItem(child, depth + 1));
            }

            builder.CloseElement();
        }

        builder.CloseElement(); // node
    };
}

@page "/lms-library"
@layout MainLayout_No_Left_RightPan

@using System.Linq
@using MITANZ360Edu.Web.Services
@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Forms

@inject SharePointService _spService
@inject AuthenticationStateProvider AuthState
@inject IJSRuntime JS
@inject NavigationManager Nav

<PageTitle>Library — MITANZ360Edu</PageTitle>

<div class="workspace">

    <div class="workspace-main">

        <!-- LEFT -->
        <aside class="workspace-tree">

            <div class="workspace-tree-scroll">
                <LibraryTree DriveId="@DriveId"
                             SelectedFolder="@CurrentFolder"
                             OnDriveResolved="@(id => DriveId = id)"
                             OnRootLoaded="@HandleRootLoaded"
                             OnFolderSelected="@HandleFolderNavigate" />
            </div>
        </aside>

        <!-- CENTER -->
        <section class="workspace-center">

            <div class="workspace-header d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between">

                <!-- LEFT: BREADCRUMB -->
                <div class="workspace-breadcrumb">
                    <LibraryBreadcrumb Path="@PathStack"
                                       OnCrumbClick="@HandleCrumbClick" />
                </div>

                <!-- RIGHT: ACTION BUTTONS -->
                <div class="workspace-actions d-flex gap-2">

                    <!-- Upload -->
                    <label class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm m-0">
                        <i class="bi bi-upload me-1"></i> Upload
                        <InputFile OnChange="HandleFileSelected"
                                   style="display:none"
                                   multiple />
                    </label>

                    <!-- Refresh -->
                    <button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm"
                            @onclick="HandleRefreshAsync">
                        <i class="bi bi-arrow-clockwise me-1"></i> Refresh
                    </button>

                </div>
                
            </div>

            <div class="workspace-grid">
                <ContentGrid Items="@CurrentChildren"
                             SelectedItem="@SelectedItem"
                             IsLoading="@IsLoadingChildren"
                             OnItemSelected="@HandleItemSelected"
                             OnItemOpen="@HandleItemOpen"
                             OnEditRequested="@OpenEditor" />
            </div>

        </section>

        <!-- RIGHT -->
        <aside class="workspace-property-panel">
            <div class="workspace-property-scroll">

                @if (SelectedItem != null && !SelectedItem.IsFolder)
                {
                    <div class="wp-panel">

                        <!-- USER INFO -->
                        <div class="wp-group">
                            <div class="wp-row">
                                <span class="wp-label">User</span>
                                <span class="wp-value">@userName</span>

@code {

    private string DriveId = string.Empty;

    private LibraryItem? CurrentFolder;
    private List<LibraryItem> CurrentChildren = new();
    private List<LibraryItem> _rootItems = new();
    private List<LibraryItem> PathStack = new();

    private LibraryItem? SelectedItem;
    private bool IsLoadingChildren;
    private bool IsDetailExpanded;

    private string? userName;
    private string? userEmail;
    private List<string> roles = new();

    // ✅ NEW: path cache
    private readonly Dictionary<string, List<LibraryItem>> _pathCache = new();

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        var authState = await AuthState.GetAuthenticationStateAsync();
        var user = authState.User;

        userName = user.Identity?.Name;

        userEmail =
            user.FindFirst("preferred_username")?.Value ??
            user.FindFirst("upn")?.Value ??
            user.FindFirst(System.Security.Claims.ClaimTypes.Email)?.Value ??
            user.FindFirst("email")?.Value ??
            user.Identity?.Name ??
            "";

        roles = user.Claims
            .Where(c => c.Type == "roles" || c.Type == System.Security.Claims.ClaimTypes.Role)
            .Select(c => c.Value)
            .ToList();
    }
    private void HandleRootLoaded(List<LibraryItem> items)
    {
        _rootItems = items ?? new();
        CurrentFolder = null;
        CurrentChildren = _rootItems.ToList();
        SelectedItem = null;

        PathStack.Clear();
        _pathCache.Clear();
    }

    private async Task HandleFolderNavigate(LibraryItem folder)
    {
        if (folder == null) return;
        if (CurrentFolder?.Id == folder.Id) return;

        IsLoadingChildren = true;

        // ✅ clear stale selection
        SelectedItem = null;
        IsDetailExpanded = false;

        CurrentFolder = folder;

        var children = await _spService
            .GetLibraryFolderChildrenAsync(folder.DriveId, folder.Id);

        CurrentChildren = children ?? new();

        // ✅ cache children paths
        CacheChildPaths(folder, CurrentChildren);

        // ✅ update breadcrumb
        PathStack = BuildPath(folder);

        IsLoadingChildren = false;
    }

    private async Task HandleCrumbClick(LibraryItem? folder)
    {
        if (folder == null)
        {
            CurrentFolder = null;
            CurrentChildren = _rootItems.ToList();
            SelectedItem = null;
            PathStack.Clear();
            return;
        }

        await HandleFolderNavigate(folder);
    }

    private Task HandleItemSelected(LibraryItem item)
    {
        if (item.IsFolder)
            return Task.CompletedTask;

        SelectedItem = item;
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private void HandleItemOpen(LibraryItem item)
    {
        if (item.IsFolder)
        {
            SelectedItem = null;
            _ = HandleFolderNavigate(item);
            return;
        }

        SelectedItem = item;
    }

    private void OpenEditor(LibraryItem item)
    {
        if (item == null) return;

        Nav.NavigateTo($"/library-edit/{Uri.EscapeDataString(item.Id)}");
    }

    // ✅ NEW: path builder
    private List<LibraryItem> BuildPath(LibraryItem folder)
    {
        if (_pathCache.TryGetValue(folder.Id, out var cached))
            return cached.ToList();

        return new List<LibraryItem> { folder };
    }

    // ✅ NEW: path cache builder
    private void CacheChildPaths(LibraryItem parent, IEnumerable<LibraryItem> children)
    {
        var parentPath = _pathCache.ContainsKey(parent.Id)
            ? _pathCache[parent.Id]
            : new List<LibraryItem> { parent };

        foreach (var child in children.Where(x => x.IsFolder))
        {
            _pathCache[child.Id] = parentPath.Append(child).ToList();
        }
    }

    private async Task HandleFileSelected(InputFileChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        var files = e.GetMultipleFiles();

        foreach (var file in files)
        {
            try
            {
                // ✅ MAX SIZE CONTROL (20MB)
                var stream = file.OpenReadStream(maxAllowedSize: 20 * 1024 * 1024);

                // ✅ DIRECTLY PASS STREAM (IMPORTANT FIX)
                await _spService.UploadFileAsync(
                    DriveId,
                    CurrentFolder?.Id ?? "root",
                    file.Name,
                    stream
                );
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Console.WriteLine($"Upload failed: {file.Name} - {ex.Message}");
            }
        }

        // ✅ Refresh UI
        await HandleRefreshAsync();
    }

    private async Task HandleRefreshAsync()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(DriveId))
            return;

        IsLoadingChildren = true;

        try
        {
            if (CurrentFolder != null)
            {
                var children = await _spService
                    .GetLibraryFolderChildrenAsync(DriveId, CurrentFolder.Id);

                CurrentChildren = children ?? new();
            }
            else
            {
                CurrentChildren = _rootItems.ToList();
            }

            // ✅ Clear selection (optional but recommended)
            SelectedItem = null;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"Refresh failed: {ex.Message}");
        }
        finally
        {
            IsLoadingChildren = false;
        }
    }

}

                    </div>
                }
            }

            @if (_isEdit)
            {
                <EditForm Model="@_edit" OnValidSubmit="Save">

                    <RadzenTabs>
                        <Tabs>

                            <RadzenTabsItem Text="General">
                                <RadzenTextBox @bind-Value="_edit.EnrollmentNo" Class="w-100" />
                                <RadzenTextBox @bind-Value="_edit.Status" Class="w-100" />
                            </RadzenTabsItem>

                            <RadzenTabsItem Text="Student">
                                <RadzenTextBox Value="@_edit.StudentName" Disabled="true" />
                            </RadzenTabsItem>

                            <RadzenTabsItem Text="Dates">
                                <RadzenDatePicker @bind-Value="_edit.EnrollmentDate" />
                            </RadzenTabsItem>

                        </Tabs>
                    </RadzenTabs>

                </EditForm>
            }

        </div>
    </div>
}


@code {
    private string _filterGroupId = "";

    private List<Enrollment> _items = new();
    private List<Group> _groups = new();
    private List<Student> _students = new();

    private List<string> _selectedStudents = new();
    private string _selectedGroup = "";

    private Enrollment _edit = new();

    private bool _panelOpen;
    private bool _isEdit;

    private string _studentSearch = "";
    private string _debouncedSearch = "";

    private CancellationTokenSource _cts = new();

    private string _previewGroup;
    private string _previewCourse;
    private string _previewIntake;
    private string _previewCampus;

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await Load();
    }

    private async Task Load()
    {
        _items = await EnrollmentService.GetEnrollmentsAsync();
        _groups = await GroupService.GetGroupsAsync();
        _students = await StudentService.GetStudentsAsync();
    }

    private void New()
    {
        _isEdit = false;
        _selectedStudents.Clear();
        _selectedGroup = "";
        _panelOpen = true;
    }

    private void Edit(Enrollment e)
    {
        _isEdit = true;
        _edit = e;
        _panelOpen = true;
    }

    private void Close() => _panelOpen = false;

    private async Task Save()
    {
        if (_isEdit)
        {
            await EnrollmentService.UpdateEnrollmentAsync(_edit);
            await Load();
            Close();
            return;
        }

        if (!_selectedStudents.Any())
        {
            NotificationService.Notify(NotificationSeverity.Warning, "Select students");
            return;
        }

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_selectedGroup))
        {
            NotificationService.Notify(NotificationSeverity.Warning, "Select group");
            return;
        }

        var group = _groups.First(g => g.GroupId == _selectedGroup);

        foreach (var sid in _selectedStudents)
        {
            if (IsAlreadyEnrolled(sid))
                continue;

            var student = _students.FirstOrDefault(s => s.StudentNumber == sid);
            if (student == null) continue;

            var e = new Enrollment
            {
                Title = student.FullName,

                EnrollmentNo = await EnrollmentService.GenerateTempEnrollmentNumberAsync(),
                EnrollmentId = await EnrollmentService.GenerateTempEnrollmentNumberAsync(),

                StudentNumber = student.StudentNumber,
                StudentName = student.FullName,
                Email = student.Email,
                Mobile = student.Phone,

                GroupId = group.GroupId,
                GroupName = group.GroupName,
                GroupCode = group.GroupCode,

                CourseCode = group.CourseCode,
                CourseName = group.CourseName,
                IntakeName = group.IntakeName,
                CampusName = group.CampusName,

                StartDate = group.StartDate,
                EndDate = group.EndDate,

                Status = "Active",
                EnrollmentDate = DateTime.UtcNow
            };

            await EnrollmentService.CreateEnrollmentAsync(e);
        }

        await Load();
        Close();

        NotificationService.Notify(NotificationSeverity.Success, "Success", "Enrollments created");
    }

    private async Task Delete(Enrollment e)
    {
        if (await DialogService.Confirm("Delete?") == true)
        {
            await EnrollmentService.DeleteEnrollmentAsync(e.Id);
            await Load();
        }
    }

    private bool IsAlreadyEnrolled(string sid)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_selectedGroup))
            return false;

        return _items.Any(x =>
            x.StudentNumber == sid &&
            x.GroupId == _selectedGroup);
    }

    private void OnStudentChecked(string studentNumber, object? value)
    {
        if ((bool)(value ?? false))
        {
            if (!_selectedStudents.Contains(studentNumber))
                _selectedStudents.Add(studentNumber);
        }
        else
        {
            _selectedStudents.Remove(studentNumber);
        }
    }

    private void OnGroupChanged(object value)
    {
        _selectedGroup = value?.ToString();

        var g = _groups.FirstOrDefault(x => x.GroupId == _selectedGroup);
        if (g == null) return;

        _previewGroup = g.GroupName;
        _previewCourse = g.CourseName;
        _previewIntake = g.IntakeName;
        _previewCampus = g.CampusName;
    }

    private IEnumerable<Student> GetFilteredStudents()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_debouncedSearch))
            return _students;

        return _students.Where(s =>
            (s.FullName?.Contains(_debouncedSearch, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false) ||
            (s.StudentNumber?.Contains(_debouncedSearch, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? false));
    }

    private async Task OnSearchChanged(string value)
    {
        _studentSearch = value;

        _cts.Cancel();
        _cts = new CancellationTokenSource();

        try
        {
            await Task.Delay(500, _cts.Token);
            _debouncedSearch = _studentSearch;
            StateHasChanged();
        }
        catch { }
    }

    private IEnumerable<Enrollment> GetFilteredEnrollments()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_filterGroupId))
            return _items;

        return _items.Where(e => e.GroupId == _filterGroupId);
    }
    private void OnFilterGroupChanged(object value)
    {
        _filterGroupId = value?.ToString();
    }
}

@code {

    #region Fields
    private List<Group> _groups = new();
    private Group _editModel = new();
    private string _searchText = "";
    private bool _loading;
    private bool _saving;
    private bool _panelOpen;
    #endregion

    #region Lifecycle
    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await Load();
    }
    #endregion

    #region Data
    private async Task Load()
    {
        try
        {
            _loading = true;
            Logger.LogInformation("Loading groups");

            _groups = await GroupService.GetGroupsAsync();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Logger.LogError(ex, "Load failed");
            NotificationService.Notify(NotificationSeverity.Error, "Error", ex.Message);
        }
        finally
        {
            _loading = false;
        }
    }

    private async Task Refresh() => await Load();

    #endregion

    #region Search
    private void ApplySearch()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_searchText))
            return;

        _groups = _groups.Where(g =>
            g.GroupCode.Contains(_searchText, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
            g.GroupName.Contains(_searchText, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
            g.CourseName.Contains(_searchText, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
            g.TutorName.Contains(_searchText, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
        ).ToList();
    }
    #endregion

    #region CRUD

    private async Task NewGroup()
    {
        _editModel = new Group
        {
            GroupId = await GroupService.GenerateTempGroupNumberAsync()
        };

        _panelOpen = true;
    }

    private void OpenEditor(Group g)
    {
        _editModel = g.Clone();
        _panelOpen = true;
    }

    private async Task SaveGroup()
    {
        try
        {
            _saving = true;

            if (_editModel.Id == 0)
                await GroupService.CreateGroupAsync(_editModel);
            else
                await GroupService.UpdateGroupAsync(_editModel);

            NotificationService.Notify(NotificationSeverity.Success, "Success", "Saved");

            await Load();
            _panelOpen = false;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Logger.LogError(ex, "Save failed");
            NotificationService.Notify(NotificationSeverity.Error, "Error", ex.Message);
        }
        finally
        {
            _saving = false;
        }
    }

    private async Task Delete(Group g)
    {
        if (await DialogService.Confirm("Delete group?", "Confirm") == true)
        {
            await GroupService.DeleteGroupAsync(g.Id);
            await Load();
        }
    }

    private async Task Clone(Group g)
    {
        var x = g.Clone();
        x.Id = 0;
        x.GroupCode += "-COPY";
        x.GroupId = await GroupService.GenerateTempGroupNumberAsync();

        _editModel = x;
        _panelOpen = true;

        Logger.LogInformation("Clone created");
    }

    #endregion

    #region UI
    private void ClosePanel() => _panelOpen = false;
    #endregion

}

@code {

    private void NavigateTo(string url)
    {
        try
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"Navigating To: {url}");

            Navigation.NavigateTo(url);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"Navigation Error: {ex.Message}");
        }
    }

    private void GoToLogin()
    {
        try
        {
            Console.WriteLine("Redirecting To Login");

            Navigation.NavigateTo("/xlogin", forceLoad: true);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"Login Redirect Error: {ex.Message}");
        }
    }
}

                                        SelectedItem.MetadataJson))
                                    {
                                        <pre>
@SelectedItem.MetadataJson
                                        </pre>
                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                        <span class="text-muted">
                                            No metadata available.
                                        </span>
                                    }

                                </div>

                            </div>

                        </div>

                    </RadzenTabsItem>

                </RadzenTabs>

            </div>

    </div>

@code {

    private bool IsLoading = true;

    private bool IsSidebarCollapsed;

    private List<LibraryItem> RootItems = [];

    private LibraryItem? SelectedItem;

    private readonly Dictionary<string, List<LibraryItem>>
        FolderChildren = [];

    private readonly HashSet<string>
        ExpandedFolders = [];

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await LoadRootAsync();
    }

    private async Task LoadRootAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            IsLoading = true;

            RootItems =
                await SharePointService
                    .GetLibraryRootAsync();
        }
        finally
        {
            IsLoading = false;
        }
    }

    private void ToggleSidebar()
    {
        IsSidebarCollapsed =
            !IsSidebarCollapsed;
    }

    private async Task SelectItemAsync(
        LibraryItem item)
    {
        SelectedItem = item;

        if (item.IsFolder)
        {
            if (ExpandedFolders.Contains(item.Id))
            {
                ExpandedFolders.Remove(item.Id);
            }
            else
            {
                ExpandedFolders.Add(item.Id);

                if (!FolderChildren.ContainsKey(item.Id))
                {
                    var children =
                        await SharePointService
                            .GetLibraryFolderChildrenAsync(
                                item.DriveId,
                                item.Id);

                    FolderChildren[item.Id] = children;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private async Task OpenInSharePoint()
    {
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
            SelectedItem?.WebUrl))
        {
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync(
                "open",
                SelectedItem.WebUrl,
                "_blank");
        }
    }

    private void GoHome()
    {
        NavigationManager.NavigateTo("/");
    }

    private string GetLargeFileIcon(
        LibraryItem item)
    {
        var extension =
            Path.GetExtension(item.Name)
                .ToLowerInvariant();

        return extension switch
        {
            ".xlsx" => "📗",
            ".docx" => "📘",
            ".pdf" => "📕",
            ".png" => "🖼️",
            ".jpg" => "🖼️",
            ".html" => "📄",
            _ => item.IsFolder ? "📁" : "📄"
        };
    }

    private string GetSmallFileIcon(
        string fileName)
    {
        var extension =
            Path.GetExtension(fileName)
                .ToLowerInvariant();

        return extension switch
        {
            ".xlsx" => "📗",
            ".docx" => "📘",
            ".pdf" => "📕",
            ".png" => "🖼️",
            ".jpg" => "🖼️",
            ".html" => "📄",
            _ => "📄"
        };
    }

    private string GetFileExtension(
        string fileName)
    {
        return Path.GetExtension(fileName)
            .Replace(".", string.Empty)
            .ToLowerInvariant();
    }

    private string FormatSize(long bytes)
    {
        if (bytes <= 0)
        {
            return "0 KB";
        }

        return $"{bytes / 1024.0:F1} KB";
    }

    private RenderFragment RenderTreeItem(
        LibraryItem item)
        => builder =>
        {
            var seq = 0;

            var expanded =
                ExpandedFolders.Contains(item.Id);

            var icon = item.IsFolder
                ? expanded
                    ? "📖"
                    : "📁"
                : GetSmallFileIcon(item.Name);

            builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");

            builder.OpenElement(seq++, "button");

            builder.AddAttribute(
                seq++,
                "class",
                SelectedItem?.Id == item.Id
                    ? "lms-tree-item active"
                    : "lms-tree-item");

            builder.AddAttribute(
                seq++,
                "onclick",
                EventCallback.Factory.Create(
                    this,
                    async () => await SelectItemAsync(item)));

            builder.AddContent(
                seq++,
                IsSidebarCollapsed
                    ? icon
                    : $"{icon} {item.Name}");

            builder.CloseElement();

            if (item.IsFolder
                && expanded
                && FolderChildren.ContainsKey(item.Id))
            {
                builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");

                builder.AddAttribute(
                    seq++,
                    "class",
                    "lms-child-items");

                foreach (var child
                         in FolderChildren[item.Id])
                {
                    builder.AddContent(
                        seq++,
                        RenderTreeItem(child));
                }

                builder.CloseElement();
            }

            builder.CloseElement();
        };

    private RenderFragment RenderProperty(
        string icon,
        string label,
        string value)
        => builder =>
        {
            var seq = 0;

            builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
            builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", "lms-property-row");

            builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
            builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", "lms-property-label");
            builder.AddContent(seq++, $"{icon} {label}");
            builder.CloseElement();

            builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
            builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class", "lms-property-value");
            builder.AddContent(seq++, value);
            builder.CloseElement();

            builder.CloseElement();
        };
}

        new("08 • Continue Learning", "Move forward using recent files, favorites, and next-step recommendations.", "fa-solid fa-arrow-right" )
    ];

    private readonly IReadOnlyList<FaqItem> Faqs =
    [
        new("How do I upload learning resources?", "Authorized contributors upload to the correct course or module location, add metadata and tags, set permissions, and publish into the governed library structure."),
        new("Who can edit content?", "Edit rights are role-based. Administrators and System Administrators manage broad scope, while Trainers typically manage content they own or are assigned to maintain."),
        new("How do permissions work?", "Permissions follow role-aware access patterns and can be applied at library, folder, or resource level depending on the governance model."),
        new("Can I preview Office documents before downloading?", "Yes. Supported file types such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and PDF can be previewed directly to confirm relevance before action."),
        new("Can deleted files be restored?", "Authorized administrative roles can restore recoverable items where retention and recycle patterns have been configured."),
        new("How does AI help inside the library?", "AI improves search, summarizes long content, recommends related material, suggests metadata, and helps guide study progression." )
    ];

    private record ActionLink(string Title, string Icon, string Target);
    private record MetricCard(string Title, string Value, string Icon, string Description);
    private record MiniInsight(string Title, string Description, string Icon);
    private record SectionCard(string Title, string Icon, string Description);
    private record TimelineStep(string Number, string Title, string Description);
    private record GuideBlock(string Title, string Icon, IReadOnlyList<string> Items);
    private record CrudPanel(string Title, string Icon, IReadOnlyList<string> Items);
    private record RoleMatrix(string Role, string Scope, bool Create, bool Read, bool Update, bool Delete);
    private record FaqItem(string Question, string Answer);
}

    [Parameter]
    public string ItemId { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    private LibraryItem? Item;

    private const string GlassCardStyle = @"
        border-radius:28px;
        padding:1.5rem;
        background:
            rgba(255,255,255,0.78);
        backdrop-filter:blur(20px);
        border:
            1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.24);
        box-shadow:
            0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);";

    private const string MetadataBoxStyle = @"
        background:
            rgba(255,255,255,0.82);
        border:
            1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
        border-radius:20px;
        padding:1.25rem;
        height:100%;";

    private const string MetadataValueStyle = @"
        color:#323130;
        font-weight:700;
        font-size:1rem;
        margin-top:0.35rem;";

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        Item =
            await SharePointService
                .GetLibraryItemByIdAsync(ItemId);
    }

    private void ClosePage()
    {
        NavigationManager.NavigateTo(
            "/lms-library-CRUD");
    }

    private bool IsImage(
        string fileName)
    {
        var ext =
            Path.GetExtension(fileName)?
                .ToLowerInvariant();

        return ext is
            ".png" or
            ".jpg" or
            ".jpeg" or
            ".gif" or
            ".webp";
    }

    private string GetPreviewUrl()
    {
        if (Item == null
            || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                Item.WebUrl))
        {
            return string.Empty;
        }

        return Item.WebUrl.Contains("?")
            ? $"{Item.WebUrl}&web=1"
            : $"{Item.WebUrl}?web=1";
    }

    private string GetItemIcon()
    {
        if (Item == null)
        {
            return "description";
        }

        if (Item.IsFolder)
        {
            return "folder";
        }

        var extension =
            Path.GetExtension(Item.Name)?
                .ToLowerInvariant();

        return extension switch
        {
            ".doc" or ".docx" => "article",
            ".xls" or ".xlsx" => "table_chart",
            ".ppt" or ".pptx" => "slideshow",
            ".pdf" => "picture_as_pdf",
            ".png" or ".jpg" or ".jpeg" => "image",
            ".mp4" or ".avi" => "movie",
            ".mp3" => "audiotrack",
            ".zip" => "folder_zip",
            ".json" => "data_object",
            ".cs" or ".js" or ".ts" => "code",
            _ => "description"
        };
    }

    private static string FormatBytes(
        long bytes)
    {
        string[] suffix =
        [
            "B",
            "KB",
            "MB",
            "GB",
            "TB"
        ];

        double len = bytes;

        int order = 0;

        while (len >= 1024
               && order < suffix.Length - 1)
        {
            order++;

            len /= 1024;
        }

        return $"{len:0.##} {suffix[order]}";
    }
}

    private List<LibraryItem> Items = new();

    private List<LibraryItem> FilteredItems = new();

    private Stack<(string DriveId, string FolderId, string Name)>
        NavigationHistory = new();

    private string SearchText = string.Empty;

    private string SelectedFilter = "All";

    private bool IsLoading;

    private string? ErrorMessage;

    private string CurrentPath = "/";

    private string SelectedDetailsTab = "overview";

    private string NewFolderName = string.Empty;

    private readonly List<string> FilterOptions =
    [
        "All",
        "Files",
        "Folders"
    ];

    private const string GlassCardStyle = @"
        border-radius:24px;
        padding:1.25rem;
        background:
            rgba(255,255,255,0.72);
        backdrop-filter:blur(18px);
        border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.24);
        box-shadow:
            0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);";

    private const string ItemCardStyle = @"
        height:100%;
        border-radius:24px;
        padding:1.5rem;
        cursor:pointer;
        transition:all .25s ease;
        background:
            rgba(255,255,255,0.78);
        backdrop-filter:blur(18px);
        border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.24);
        box-shadow:
            0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);";

    private const string ToolbarButtonStyle = @"
        border-radius:20px;
        height:20px;
        padding-left:20px;
        padding-right:20px;
        font-weight:300;";

    private const string DetailsCardStyle = @"
        border-radius:24px;
        padding:1.5rem;
        background:
            rgba(255,255,255,0.82);
        border:
            1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.24);
        box-shadow:
            0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);";

    private bool CanNavigateUp =>
        NavigationHistory.Count > 0;

    private string UploadUrl => "api/lms/upload";

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await LoadRootAsync();
    }

    private async Task LoadRootAsync()
    {
        Items =
            await SharePointService
                .GetLibraryRootAsync();

        FilterItems();

        CurrentPath = "/";
    }

    private void FilterItems()
    {
        IEnumerable<LibraryItem> query =
            Items;

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(SearchText))
        {
            query = query.Where(x =>
                x.Name.Contains(
                    SearchText,
                    StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        }

        query = SelectedFilter switch
        {
            "Files" =>
                query.Where(x => !x.IsFolder),

            "Folders" =>
                query.Where(x => x.IsFolder),

            _ => query
        };

        FilteredItems =
            query.ToList();
    }

    private async Task HandleItemClick(LibraryItem item)
    {
        if (item.IsFolder)
        {
            await OpenFolder(item);
        }
        else if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(item.WebUrl))
        {
            await JS.InvokeVoidAsync(
                "open",
                item.WebUrl,
                "_blank");
        }
    }

    private async Task OpenFolder(LibraryItem item)
    {
        if (NavigationHistory.Count == 0)
        {
            var root =
                await SharePointService.GetRootContextAsync();

            NavigationHistory.Push(
                (
                    root.DriveId,
                    root.FolderId,
                    "Home"
                ));
        }

        NavigationHistory.Push(
            (
                item.DriveId,
                item.Id,
                item.Name
            ));

        Items =
            await SharePointService
                .GetLibraryFolderChildrenAsync(
                    item.DriveId,
                    item.Id);

        FilterItems();

        BuildPath();
    }

    private async Task NavigateUp()
    {
        if (NavigationHistory.Count <= 1)
        {
            NavigationHistory.Clear();

            await LoadRootAsync();

            return;
        }

        NavigationHistory.Pop();

        var current =
            NavigationHistory.Peek();

        Items =
            await SharePointService
                .GetLibraryFolderChildrenAsync(
                    current.DriveId,
                    current.FolderId);

        FilterItems();

        BuildPath();
    }

    private async Task RefreshAsync()
    {
        await LoadRootAsync();
    }

    private void BuildPath()
    {
        if (NavigationHistory.Count == 0)
        {
            CurrentPath = "/";

            return;
        }

        CurrentPath =
            "/" + string.Join(
                "/",
                NavigationHistory
                    .Reverse()
                    .Select(x => x.Name));
    }

    private void ChangeDetailsTab(
        string tab)
    {
        SelectedDetailsTab = tab;

        InvokeAsync(StateHasChanged);
    }

    private string GetTabButtonStyle(
        string tab)
    {
        var active =
            SelectedDetailsTab == tab;

        return active
            ? @"
                width:100%;
                justify-content:flex-start;
                border-radius:18px;
                background:
                    linear-gradient(
                        135deg,
                        #0078D4,
                        #106EBE);
                color:white;
                border:none;
                padding:14px;
                font-weight:700;"
            : @"
                width:100%;
                justify-content:flex-start;
                border-radius:18px;
                background:
                    rgba(255,255,255,0.78);
                color:#323130;
                border:
                    1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
                padding:14px;
                font-weight:600;";
    }

    private string GetPreviewUrl(LibraryItem item)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
            item.WebUrl))
        {
            return string.Empty;
        }

        return item.WebUrl.Contains("?")
            ? $"{item.WebUrl}&web=1"
            : $"{item.WebUrl}?web=1";
    }

    private void OpenEditPage(LibraryItem item)
    {
        NavigationManager.NavigateTo(
            $"/lms-crud-edit/{item.Id}");
    }

    private async Task ConfirmDelete(LibraryItem item)
    {
        await SharePointService
            .DeleteItemAsync(
                item.DriveId,
                item.Id);

        await RefreshAsync();
    }

    private async Task OpenCreateFolderDialog()
    {
        await Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    private void OnUploadProgress(
        UploadProgressArgs args)
    {
    }

    private async Task OnUploadComplete(
        UploadCompleteEventArgs args)
    {
        await RefreshAsync();
    }

    private static string GetItemIcon(LibraryItem item)
    {
        if (item.IsFolder)
            return "folder";

        var extension =
            Path.GetExtension(item.Name)?
                .ToLowerInvariant();

        return extension switch
        {
            ".doc" or ".docx" => "article",
            ".xls" or ".xlsx" => "table_chart",
            ".ppt" or ".pptx" => "slideshow",
            ".pdf" => "picture_as_pdf",
            ".png" or ".jpg" or ".jpeg" => "image",
            ".mp4" or ".avi" => "movie",
            ".mp3" => "audiotrack",
            ".zip" => "folder_zip",
            ".json" => "data_object",
            ".cs" or ".js" or ".ts" => "code",
            _ => "description"
        };
    }
}

@code {

    [Parameter] public string DriveId { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    [Parameter] public string ItemId { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    private LibraryItem? Model;
    private bool IsLoading = true;

    protected override async Task OnParametersSetAsync()
    {
        IsLoading = true;
        Model = await SharePointService.GetItemAsync(DriveId, ItemId);
        IsLoading = false;
    }

    private async Task SaveAsync()
    {
        await SharePointService.UpdateLibraryItemAsync(
            DriveId, ItemId, Model!);

        NotificationService.Notify(
            NotificationSeverity.Success,
            "Saved",
            "Document updated");
    }

    private async Task DeleteAsync()
    {
        await SharePointService.DeleteItemAsync(DriveId, ItemId);
        await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("location.reload");
    }
}

@code {

    [Parameter]
    public string FolderId { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    [Parameter]
    [SupplyParameterFromQuery(Name = "name")]
    public string? CourseNameQuery { get; set; }

    private string CourseName = "Course";

    private List<LibraryItem>? Categories;
    private List<LibraryItem>? Items;

    private string? SelectedCategoryId;

    private List<LibraryItem> Breadcrumb = new();

    protected override async Task OnParametersSetAsync()
    {
        CourseName = CourseNameQuery ?? "Course";

        Categories = await SharePointService
            .GetCourseCategoriesAsync(FolderId);

        var first = Categories?.FirstOrDefault();

        if (first != null)
        {
            await SelectCategory(first);
        }
    }

    private async Task SelectCategory(LibraryItem category)
    {
        SelectedCategoryId = category.Id;

        Breadcrumb.Clear();
        Breadcrumb.Add(category);

        Items = await SharePointService
            .GetFolderContentAsync(category.Id);
    }

    private async Task OpenItem(LibraryItem item)
    {
        if (item.IsFolder)
        {
            Breadcrumb.Add(item);

            Items = await SharePointService
                .GetFolderContentAsync(item.Id);
        }
        else
        {
            Nav.NavigateTo(
                $"/document/{item.Id}?name={Uri.EscapeDataString(item.Name)}");
        }
    }

    private async Task NavigateTo(int index)
    {
        var target = Breadcrumb[index];

        Breadcrumb = Breadcrumb
            .Take(index + 1)
            .ToList();

        Items = await SharePointService
            .GetFolderContentAsync(target.Id);
    }

    private string GetFileType(LibraryItem item)
        => item.IsFolder
            ? "Folder"
            : Path.GetExtension(item.Name)
                .Trim('.')
                .ToUpper();

    private string RemoveExtension(string name)
        => Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(name);

    private string FormatSize(long? size)
        => size == null
            ? "-"
            : $"{size / 1024:N0} KB";

    private string GetFileIcon(LibraryItem item)
    {
        if (item.IsFolder)
            return "📁";

        var ext = Path.GetExtension(item.Name).ToLower();

        return ext switch
        {
            ".pdf" => "📄",
            ".doc" => "📝",
            ".docx" => "📝",
            ".ppt" => "📊",
            ".pptx" => "📊",
            ".xls" => "📈",
            ".xlsx" => "📈",
            ".zip" => "🗜️",
            ".txt" => "📃",
            ".jpg" => "🖼️",
            ".jpeg" => "🖼️",
            ".png" => "🖼️",
            ".gif" => "🖼️",
            ".mp4" => "🎬",
            ".avi" => "🎬",
            ".mp3" => "🎵",
            ".wav" => "🎵",
            ".json" => "⚙️",
            ".xml" => "⚙️",
            ".cs" => "💻",
            ".razor" => "💻",
            ".html" => "🌐",
            ".htm" => "🌐",
            ".url" => "🔗",
            _ => "📄"
        };
    }

    private string Clean(string name)
        => name.Contains("_")
            ? name.Split("_", 2)[1]
            : name;
}

@code {
    [Parameter] public string FolderId { get; set; }

    private List<LibraryItem>? Files;
    private LibraryItem? SelectedFile;
    private bool IsLoading;

    protected override async Task OnParametersSetAsync()
    {
        Files = await SharePointService.GetFolderFilesAsync(FolderId);
    }

    // =========================================
    // SELECT FILE
    // =========================================
    private async Task SelectFile(LibraryItem file)
    {
        SelectedFile = file;
        IsLoading = true;

        await Task.Delay(300); // UX smoother (fake loading)
        IsLoading = false;
    }

    // =========================================
    // HELPERS
    // =========================================
    private string GetFileUrl(string id)
        => $"/api/documents/view/{id}";

    private async Task DownloadFile(string id)
    {
        await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("open", GetFileUrl(id), "_blank");
    }

    private bool IsPdf(LibraryItem file)
        => file.ContentType?.Contains("pdf") == true;

    private bool IsImage(LibraryItem file)
        => file.ContentType?.Contains("image") == true;

    private string FormatBytes(long bytes)
    {
        if (bytes <= 0) return "0 B";
        string[] sizes = { "B", "KB", "MB", "GB" };
        int order = (int)Math.Log(bytes, 1024);
        return $"{bytes / Math.Pow(1024, order):0.##} {sizes[order]}";
    }

    private string GetFileIcon(string? type)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(type)) return "📁";

        if (type.Contains("pdf")) return "📄";
        if (type.Contains("image")) return "🖼";
        if (type.Contains("word")) return "📘";
        if (type.Contains("excel")) return "📊";

        return "📁";
    }
}

        }

        {
            <img src="@FileUrl" class="image-preview" />
        }
        else if (IsVideo)

            <video class="video-player"
                   controls
                   playsinline
                   preload="metadata">
                <source src="@FileUrl">
                Your browser does not support video playback.
            </video>
        }
        else if (IsHtml)
        {
            <iframe src="@FileUrl" width="100%" height="100%"></iframe>
        }
        @if (IsOffice)
        {
            <iframe src="@OfficeViewerUrl"
                    width="100%"
                    height="100%"
                    frameborder="0">
            </iframe>
        }
    </div>

</div>

@code {

    [Parameter] public string Id { get; set; }

    [Parameter]
    [SupplyParameterFromQuery(Name = "name")]
    public string? Name { get; set; }
    private string FileName => Name ?? "Document";
    private string FileUrl => $"/api/documents/view/{Id}?name={Uri.EscapeDataString(FileName)}";
    private bool IsPdf => FileName.EndsWith(".pdf", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    private string OfficeViewerUrl =>
        $"https://view.officeapps.live.com/op/embed.aspx?src={Uri.EscapeDataString(AbsoluteFileUrl)}";
    private string AbsoluteFileUrl =>
        $"{Nav.BaseUri.TrimEnd('/')}/api/documents/view/{Id}?name={Uri.EscapeDataString(FileName)}";

    private bool IsHtml =>
        FileName.EndsWith(".html", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
        FileName.EndsWith(".htm", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    private bool IsImage =>
        FileName.EndsWith(".png") ||
        FileName.EndsWith(".jpg") ||
        FileName.EndsWith(".jpeg");

    private bool IsVideo =>
        FileName.EndsWith(".mp4", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
        FileName.EndsWith(".webm", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
        FileName.EndsWith(".mov", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
        FileName.EndsWith(".avi", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    private bool IsOffice =>
        FileName.EndsWith(".docx", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
        FileName.EndsWith(".doc", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
        FileName.EndsWith(".xlsx", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
        FileName.EndsWith(".xls", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
        FileName.EndsWith(".pptx", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
        FileName.EndsWith(".ppt", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
        FileName.EndsWith(".vsdx", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    private async Task GoBack()
    {
        await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("history.back");
    }
}

@page "/video-player"

<div class="layout">

    <!-- LEFT SIDEBAR -->
    <div class="sidebar">

        <div class="info-card">
            <strong>Instructions</strong><br />
            Select a video from the list to start learning.<br /><br />

            <strong>Legal Notice</strong><br />
            Educational use only.<br />
            Credits belong to creators.<br /><br />

            Thank you
        </div>

        <button class="home-btn" @onclick="GoHome">
            Home
        </button>

        <h2>Available Videos</h2>

        @foreach (var video in Videos)
        {
            <div class="video-card" @onclick="() => OpenVideo(video.Url)">
                <b>@video.Title</b>
            </div>
        }

    </div>

    <!-- MAIN CONTENT -->
    <div class="main">
        <div class="header">Video Learning Portal</div>
        <img src="/images/edu/mar-11.png" class="hero-image" />
    </div>

</div>

@if (IsOpen)
{
    <div class="overlay" tabindex="0" @onkeydown="HandleKey">

        <div class="player">

            <button class="close" @onclick="CloseVideo">X</button>

            <iframe src="@SelectedVideo"
                    allow="autoplay; encrypted-media"
                    allowfullscreen>
            </iframe>

        </div>
    </div>
}

@code {
    private string? SelectedVideo;
    private bool IsOpen;

    private readonly List<VideoItem> Videos = new()
    {
        new VideoItem("Azure Intro", "https://www.youtube.com/embed/aYByANhgT_w?autoplay=1&rel=0"),
        new VideoItem("Global Teaching Reach", "https://www.youtube.com/embed/8ylwXUn44ZI?autoplay=1&rel=0"),
        new VideoItem("Top 10 Uni in NZ", "https://www.youtube.com/embed/hwP3EysM2A8?autoplay=1&rel=0"),
        new VideoItem("Top 10 Uni in AU", "https://www.youtube.com/embed/X3YUw0PtdNc?autoplay=1&rel=0")
    };

    private void OpenVideo(string url)
    {
        SelectedVideo = url;
        IsOpen = true;
    }

    private void CloseVideo()
    {
        IsOpen = false;
        SelectedVideo = null;
    }

    private void HandleKey(KeyboardEventArgs e)
    {
        if (e.Key == "Escape")
        {
            CloseVideo();
        }
    }

    private void GoHome()
    {
        Nav.NavigateTo("/");
    }

    private sealed record VideoItem(string Title, string Url);
}
