Components\Pages\ModelContent\ModelContent.razor
====================================================================
@page "/model-content"
@layout MainLayout_NoRightPan

@using MITANZ360Edu.Web.Models
@using MITANZ360Edu.Web.Services
@using Radzen
@using Radzen.Blazor

@inject ModelContentService ModelContentService
@inject SharePointService SharePointService
@inject NotificationService NotificationService
@inject DialogService DialogService
@inject ILogger<ModelContent> Logger

<PageTitle>Model Content</PageTitle>

<div class="mc-shell">

    <div class="mc-main-grid">

        <!-- LEFT -->
        <div class="mc-card">

            <div class="mc-card-header">

                <div class="mc-title">Content Management</div>

                <div class="mc-subtitle">
                    Enterprise educational content records
                </div>

                <div class="mc-toolbar">

                    <RadzenTextBox @bind-Value="_search"
                                   Placeholder="Search content..."
                                   Style="width:260px;" />

                    <RadzenDropDown @bind-Value="_filterPublished"
                                    Data="@_publishFilters"
                                    Style="width:180px;" />

                    <RadzenDropDown TValue="string"
                                    Data="@_contentTypes"
                                    TextProperty="Title"
                                    ValueProperty="Code"
                                    @bind-Value="_filterContentType"
                                    Placeholder="Content Type"
                                    Style="width:220px;" />

                    <RadzenButton Text="Refresh"
                                  Icon="refresh"
                                  Click="@LoadAsync" />

                    <RadzenButton Text="New Content"
                                  Icon="add_circle"
                                  Click="@CreateNew"
                                  Style="background:#ff6b35;border:none;" />

                </div>

            </div>

            <div class="mc-grid-wrapper">

                <RadzenDataGrid TItem="ModelContentModel"
                                Data="@FilteredItems"
                                AllowPaging="true"
                                PageSize="10">

                    <Columns>

                        <RadzenDataGridColumn Property="Title" Title="Title" />

                        <RadzenDataGridColumn Property="CourseId" Title="Course ID" />

                        <RadzenDataGridColumn Property="ModuleNo" Title="Module" />

                        <RadzenDataGridColumn Title="Type">
                            <Template Context="item">
                                <span class="mc-type-pill">
                                    @GetContentTypeTitle(item.ContentTypeCode)
                                </span>
                            </Template>
                        </RadzenDataGridColumn>

                        <RadzenDataGridColumn Title="Status">
                            <Template Context="item">
                                <span class="mc-status-pill @(item.IsPublished ? "mc-published" : "mc-draft")">
                                    @(item.IsPublished ? "Published" : "Draft")
                                </span>
                            </Template>
                        </RadzenDataGridColumn>

                        <RadzenDataGridColumn Title="Actions">
                            <Template Context="item">
                                <div class="mc-actions">

                                    <RadzenButton Icon="visibility"
                                                  Click="@(() => SelectView(item))" />

                                </div>
                            </Template>
                        </RadzenDataGridColumn>

                    </Columns>

                </RadzenDataGrid>

            </div>

        </div>

        <!-- RIGHT -->
        <div class="mc-card">

            <div class="mc-card-header">
                <div class="mc-title">Content Editor</div>
            </div>

            <div class="mc-editor">

                @if (_selected == null)
                {
                    <div>Select or create content.</div>
                }
                else
                {
                    <RadzenTemplateForm TItem="ModelContentModel"
                                        Data="@_selected"
                                        Submit="@SaveAsync">

                        <RadzenTabs>

                            <Tabs>

                                <RadzenTabsItem Text="General">

                                    <RadzenTextBox @bind-Value="_selected.Title"
                                                   Style="width:100%;" />

                                    <RadzenDropDown Data="@_courses"
                                                    TextProperty="CourseCode"
                                                    ValueProperty="CourseCode"
                                                    @bind-Value="_selected.CourseId"
                                                    Style="width:100%;" />

                                    <RadzenTextBox @bind-Value="_selected.ModuleNo"
                                                   Style="width:100%;" />

                                    <!-- ✅ FIXED DROPDOWN -->
                                    <RadzenDropDown TValue="string"
                                                    Data="@_contentTypes"
                                                    TextProperty="Title"
                                                    ValueProperty="Code"
                                                    @bind-Value="_selected.ContentTypeCode"
                                                    Style="width:100%;" />

                                    <RadzenNumeric @bind-Value="_selected.DurationMinutes"
                                                   Style="width:100%;" />

                                </RadzenTabsItem>

                            </Tabs>

                        </RadzenTabs>

                        <RadzenButton Text="Save"
                                      ButtonType="ButtonType.Submit" />

                    </RadzenTemplateForm>
                }

            </div>

        </div>

    </div>

</div>

@code {

    private List<ModelContentModel> _items = new();
    private List<ReferenceDataItem> _contentTypes = new();
    private IReadOnlyList<CourseModel> _courses = new List<CourseModel>();

    private ModelContentModel? _selected;

    private string _search = "";
    private string _filterPublished = "All";
    private string? _filterContentType;

    private readonly List<string> _publishFilters =
    [
        "All",
        "Published",
        "Draft"
    ];

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await LoadAsync();
    }

    private async Task LoadAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            _items = await ModelContentService.GetAllAsync();

            _courses = await SharePointService.GetCoursesAsync();

            _contentTypes = await SharePointService
                .GetReferenceDataByCategoryAsync("LMS", "ContentType");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Logger.LogError(ex, "Load failed");

            NotificationService.Notify(
                NotificationSeverity.Error,
                "Error",
                ex.Message);
        }
    }

    private IEnumerable<ModelContentModel> FilteredItems =>
        _items
            .Where(x =>
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_search)
                || (x.Title ?? "").Contains(_search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            .Where(x =>
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_filterContentType)
                || x.ContentTypeCode == _filterContentType)
            .Where(x =>
                _filterPublished == "All"
                || (_filterPublished == "Published" && x.IsPublished)
                || (_filterPublished == "Draft" && !x.IsPublished));

    private void CreateNew()
    {
        _selected = new ModelContentModel();
    }

    private void SelectView(ModelContentModel item)
    {
        _selected = item;
    }

    private async Task SaveAsync()
    {
        if (_selected == null) return;

        var ok = _selected.Id == 0
            ? await ModelContentService.CreateAsync(_selected)
            : await ModelContentService.UpdateAsync(_selected);

        if (ok)
        {
            NotificationService.Notify(NotificationSeverity.Success, "Saved", "Success");
            await LoadAsync();
        }
    }

    // ✅ TITLE MAPPING FIX
    private string GetContentTypeTitle(string? code)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(code))
            return "N/A";

        var match = _contentTypes
            .FirstOrDefault(x => x.Code == code);

        return match?.Title ?? code;
    }
}

        @if (_loaded)

                Loaded @Items.Count item(s)
            </div>
        }

        <RadzenDataGrid TItem="ModelContentModel"
                        Data="@Items"
                        AllowPaging="true"
                        AllowSorting="true"
                        AllowFiltering="true"
                        PageSize="10"
                        EmptyText="No content records found."
                        Style="background:white;color:black;">

            <Columns>

                <RadzenDataGridColumn TItem="ModelContentModel"
                                      Property="Title"
                                      Title="Title" />

                <RadzenDataGridColumn TItem="ModelContentModel"
                                      Property="CourseId"
                                      Title="Course" />

                <RadzenDataGridColumn TItem="ModelContentModel"
                                      Property="ModuleNo"
                                      Title="Module" />

                <RadzenDataGridColumn TItem="ModelContentModel"
                                      Property="ContentTypeDisplay"
                                      Title="Type" />

                <RadzenDataGridColumn TItem="ModelContentModel"
                                      Property="PublishStatus"
                                      Title="Status" />

            </Columns>

        </RadzenDataGrid>

    </div>

</div>

@code {

    private List<ModelContentModel> Items =
        new();

    private string _error =
        string.Empty;

    private bool _loaded;

    protected override async Task
        OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await LoadAsync();
    }

    private async Task LoadAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            _error =
                string.Empty;

            _loaded =
                false;

            Logger.LogInformation(
                "Loading ModelContent records.");

            Items =
                await ModelContentService
                    .GetAllAsync();

            _loaded = true;

            NotificationService.Notify(
                NotificationSeverity.Success,
                "Loaded",
                $"Loaded {Items.Count} record(s).");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Logger.LogError(
                ex,
                "ModelContent loading failed.");

            _error =
                ex.Message;

            NotificationService.Notify(
                NotificationSeverity.Error,
                "Load Failed",
                ex.Message);
        }
    }
}

Components\Pages\Student\LMS-Student-Viewer.razor
====================================================================
@page "/lms-student-cont-viewer/{FolderId}"

@layout MainLayout_No_Left_RightPan

@using MITANZ360Edu.Web.Services
@using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components
@inject SharePointService _spService
@inject IJSRuntime JS

<PageTitle>Student Document Viewer</PageTitle>

<style>
    .layout {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 250px 1fr;
        height: 100vh;
        background: #F8FAFC;
    }

    .left-panel {
        background: #fff;
        border-right: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
        padding: 12px;
        border-radius: 15px;
    }

    .right-panel {
        padding: 12px;
    }

    .file-row {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        padding: 6px;
        border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
    }

    .tree-item {
        padding: 6px 10px;
        cursor: pointer;
        border-radius: 8px;
    }

        .tree-item:hover {
            background: #eff6ff;
        }

        .tree-item.active {
            background: #dbeafe;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

    .empty-state {
        padding: 12px;
        border: 1px solid #fdba74;
        border-radius: 10px;
        background: #fff7ed;
    }
</style>

<div class="layout">

    <!-- LEFT -->
    <div class="left-panel">
        <div style="font-weight:600;">Course Content</div>

        @if (RootFolders == null)
        {
            <div>Loading...</div>
        }
        else if (RootFolders.Count == 0)
        {
            <div class="empty-state">No folders available</div>
        }
        else
        {
            @foreach (var folder in RootFolders)
            {
                @RenderTree(folder, 0)
            }
        }

    </div>

    <!-- RIGHT -->
    <div class="right-panel">

        @if (Files == null)
        {
            <div class="empty-state">Select a folder</div>
        }
        else if (Files.Count == 0)
        {
            <div class="empty-state">No files here</div>
        }
        else
        {
            @foreach (var file in Files)
            {
                <div class="file-row">
                    <div>
                        @((MarkupString)GetFileIcon(file.ContentType))
                        @file.Name
                    </div>

                    <div>
                        <button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm"
                                @onclick="() => ViewFile(file.Id)">
                            View
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            }
        }

    </div>

</div>

@code {
    [Parameter]
    public string? FolderId { get; set; }

    private string Role = "Admin"; // or "Student" / "Tutor" / "Trainer"

    private bool IsStudent => Role == "Student";
    private bool IsTutor => Role == "Tutor" || Role == "Trainer";
    private bool IsAdmin => Role == "Admin";

    private List<LibraryItem>? RootFolders;
    private Dictionary<string, List<LibraryItem>> FolderTree = new();
    private List<LibraryItem>? Files;

    private string DriveId = string.Empty;
    private HashSet<string> Expanded = new();
    private string SelectedFolderId = string.Empty;

    protected override async Task OnParametersSetAsync()
    {
        await LoadFolderContentAsync();
    }

    // ✅ CENTRAL FILTER RULE
    private bool IsHiddenForUser(LibraryItem item)
    {
        if (Role == "Tutor" || Role == "Trainer")
            return false;

        return item.IsFolder &&
               item.Name.StartsWith("01_Tutor", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    }

    private async Task LoadFolderContentAsync()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(FolderId)) return;

        DriveId = await _spService.GetLmsDriveIdAsync();

        var folder = await _spService.GetItemAsync(DriveId, FolderId);

        // ✅ BLOCK STUDENT DIRECT ACCESS
        if ((IsStudent || IsAdmin) && folder != null && folder.Name.StartsWith("01_Tutor", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            RootFolders = new();
            Files = new();
            return;
        }

        var items = await _spService.GetLibraryFolderChildrenAsync(DriveId, FolderId);

        var visible = items
            .Where(x => !IsHiddenForUser(x))
            .ToList();

        RootFolders = visible
            .Where(x => x.IsFolder)
            .OrderBy(x => x.Name)
            .ToList();

        Files = visible
            .Where(x => !x.IsFolder && x.IsPublished && !x.IsArchived)
            .OrderBy(x => x.Name)
            .ToList();

        FolderTree[FolderId] = visible;
        SelectedFolderId = FolderId;
    }

    private async Task ExpandFolder(string id)
    {
        if (!FolderTree.ContainsKey(id))
        {
            var items = await _spService.GetLibraryFolderChildrenAsync(DriveId, id);

            FolderTree[id] = items
                .Where(x => !IsHiddenForUser(x))
                .ToList();
        }
    }

    private async Task LoadFolder(string id)
    {
        List<LibraryItem> items;

        if (FolderTree.ContainsKey(id))
        {
            items = FolderTree[id];
        }
        else
        {
            items = (await _spService.GetLibraryFolderChildrenAsync(DriveId, id))
                .Where(x => !IsHiddenForUser(x))
                .ToList();

            FolderTree[id] = items;
        }

        Files = items
            .Where(x => !x.IsFolder && x.IsPublished && !x.IsArchived)
            .OrderBy(x => x.Name)
            .ToList();
    }

    private async Task ViewFile(string id)
    {
        await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("open", $"/api/files/{id}", "_blank");
    }

    private RenderFragment RenderTree(LibraryItem folder, int level) => builder =>
    {
        int seq = 0;

        bool isExpanded = Expanded.Contains(folder.Id);
        bool isSelected = SelectedFolderId == folder.Id;

        builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class",
            $"tree-item {(isSelected ? "active" : "")}");
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "style", $"padding-left:{level * 16}px");

        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "onclick", EventCallback.Factory.Create(this, async () =>
        {
            SelectedFolderId = folder.Id;

            if (isExpanded)
                Expanded.Remove(folder.Id);
            else
            {
                Expanded.Add(folder.Id);
                await ExpandFolder(folder.Id);
            }

            await LoadFolder(folder.Id);
        }));

        builder.AddContent(seq++, folder.Name);
        builder.CloseElement();

        if (isExpanded && FolderTree.ContainsKey(folder.Id))
        {
            foreach (var child in FolderTree[folder.Id]
                         .Where(x => x.IsFolder)
                         .OrderBy(x => x.Name))
            {
                builder.AddContent(seq++, RenderTree(child, level + 1));
            }
        }
    };

    private string GetFileIcon(string? contentType)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(contentType))
            return "<i class='bi bi-file'></i>";

        var m = contentType.ToLower();

        if (m.Contains("pdf")) return "<i class='bi bi-file-earmark-pdf'></i>";
        if (m.Contains("image")) return "<i class='bi bi-file-earmark-image'></i>";

        return "<i class='bi bi-file'></i>";
    }
}

@code {

    private ClaimsPrincipal? user;
    private bool isAdmin;
    private bool isTrainer;

    private List<LibraryItem>? RootFolders;
    private Dictionary<string, List<LibraryItem>> FolderTree = new();
    private List<LibraryItem>? Files;

    private List<LibraryItem> Breadcrumbs = new();
    private string DriveId = "";

    private bool ShowInfoCard = false;
    private bool ShowAssessmentCard = false;

    private LibraryItem? SelectedItem;
    private ActMetadata? ActMeta;

    private HashSet<string> Expanded = new();
    private string SelectedFolderId = "";

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        DriveId = await _spService.GetLmsDriveIdAsync();

        var items = await _spService.GetLibraryFolderChildrenAsync(DriveId, "root");

        RootFolders = items.Where(x => x.IsFolder).ToList();
        FolderTree["root"] = items;

        Breadcrumbs = new List<LibraryItem>
        {
            new LibraryItem { Id = "root", Name = "Root" }
        };

        var authState = await AuthState.GetAuthenticationStateAsync();
        user = authState.User;

        isAdmin = user?.IsInRole("Admin") ?? false;
        isTrainer = user?.IsInRole("Trainer") ?? false;

    }

    private async Task ExpandFolder(string id)
    {
        if (!FolderTree.ContainsKey(id))
        {
            FolderTree[id] = await _spService.GetLibraryFolderChildrenAsync(DriveId, id);
        }
    }

    private async Task LoadFolder(string id)
    {
        var items = await _spService.GetLibraryFolderChildrenAsync(DriveId, id);

        Files = items.Where(x => !x.IsFolder).ToList();

        // ✅ prevent duplicate breadcrumb
        var exists = Breadcrumbs.Any(x => x.Id == id);
        if (!exists)
        {
            var folderName = FolderTree.ContainsKey(id)
                ? FolderTree[id].FirstOrDefault()?.Name ?? "Folder"
                : "Folder";

            Breadcrumbs.Add(new LibraryItem
            {
                Id = id,
                Name = folderName
            });
        }
    }

    private async Task NavigateBreadcrumb(string id)
    {
        var index = Breadcrumbs.FindIndex(x => x.Id == id);
        Breadcrumbs = Breadcrumbs.Take(index + 1).ToList();

        await LoadFolder(id);
    }

    private async Task ViewFile(string id)
    {
        await JS.InvokeVoidAsync("open", $"/api/files/{id}", "_blank");
    }

    private void ShowInfo(LibraryItem item)
    {
        SelectedItem = item;
        ShowInfoCard = true;
    }

    private void ShowAssessment(LibraryItem item)
    {
        SelectedItem = item;

        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.ACTMetaJson))
        {
            try
            {
                ActMeta = System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ActMetadata>(item.ACTMetaJson);
            }
            catch
            {
                ActMeta = null;
            }
        }

        ShowAssessmentCard = true;
    }

    private void ClosePopup()
    {
        ShowInfoCard = false;
        ShowAssessmentCard = false;
    }

    private RenderFragment RenderTree(LibraryItem folder, int level) => builder =>
    {
        int seq = 0;

        bool isExpanded = Expanded.Contains(folder.Id);
        bool isSelected = SelectedFolderId == folder.Id;

        var icon = level switch
        {
            0 => "bi-diagram-3",
            1 => "bi-collection",
            _ => "bi-folder"
        };

        builder.OpenElement(seq++, "div");
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "class",
            $"tree-item level-{level} {(isSelected ? "active" : "")}");
        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "style", $"padding-left:{level * 16}px");

        builder.AddAttribute(seq++, "onclick", EventCallback.Factory.Create(this, async () =>
        {
            SelectedFolderId = folder.Id;

            if (isExpanded)
                Expanded.Remove(folder.Id);
            else
            {
                Expanded.Add(folder.Id);
                await ExpandFolder(folder.Id);
            }

            await LoadFolder(folder.Id);
        }));

        builder.AddMarkupContent(seq++, $@"
            <i class='bi {icon}'></i>
            <span>{folder.Name}</span>
        ");

        builder.CloseElement();

        if (isExpanded && FolderTree.ContainsKey(folder.Id))
        {
            foreach (var child in FolderTree[folder.Id].Where(x => x.IsFolder))
            {
                builder.AddContent(seq++, RenderTree(child, level + 1));
            }
        }
    };

    private string GetFileIcon(string? contentType)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(contentType))
            return "<i class='bi bi-file-earmark'></i>";

        var m = contentType.ToLowerInvariant();

        // Documents
        if (m.Contains("pdf")) return "<i class='bi bi-file-earmark-pdf'></i>";
        if (m.Contains("word")) return "<i class='bi bi-file-earmark-word'></i>";
        if (m.Contains("excel")) return "<i class='bi bi-file-earmark-excel'></i>";

        // Web / HTML
        if (m.Contains("html") || m.Contains("htm"))
            return "<i class='bi bi-filetype-html'></i>";

        // Presentations
        if (m.Contains("presentation") || m.Contains("powerpoint") || m.Contains("ppt"))
            return "<i class='bi bi-file-earmark-ppt'></i>";

        // ✅ Images (JPEG added here)
        if (m.StartsWith("image/") ||
            m.Contains("jpeg") ||
            m.Contains("jpg") ||
            m.Contains("png") ||
            m.Contains("gif") ||
            m.Contains("bmp") ||
            m.Contains("webp"))
            return "<i class='bi bi-file-earmark-image'></i>";

        // ✅ Video
        if (m.StartsWith("video/") ||
            m.Contains("mp4") ||
            m.Contains("webm") ||
            m.Contains("avi") ||
            m.Contains("mov") ||
            m.Contains("mkv") ||
            m.Contains("mpeg") ||
            m.Contains("wmv"))
            return "<i class='bi bi-file-earmark-play'></i>";

        return "<i class='bi bi-file-earmark'></i>";
    }

    private bool HasAssessment(LibraryItem item)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.ACTMetaJson))
            return false;

        try
        {
            var meta = System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ActMetadata>(item.ACTMetaJson);
            return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(meta?.Url);
        }
        catch
        {
            return false;
        }
    }

    private string GetStatusText(dynamic file)
    {
        if (file.IsArchived) return "Archived";
        if (file.IsPublished) return "Published";
        return "Draft";
    }

    private string GetStatusIcon(dynamic file)
    {
        if (file.IsArchived) return "bi bi-archive";
        if (file.IsPublished) return "bi bi-upload";
        return "bi bi-file-earmark";
    }

    private string GetStatusClass(dynamic file)
    {
        if (file.IsArchived) return "btn-warning";
        if (file.IsPublished) return "btn-success";
        return "btn-secondary";
    }

    private async Task ToggleFileStatus(dynamic file)
    {
        // ✅ CASE 1: Draft → Publish
        if (!file.IsPublished && !file.IsArchived)
        {
            file.IsPublished = true;
            file.IsArchived = false;
        }

        // ✅ CASE 2: Published → Archive
        else if (file.IsPublished)
        {
            bool confirm = await JS.InvokeAsync<bool>(
                "confirm",
                "Are you sure you want to archive this file?"
            );

            if (!confirm) return;

            file.IsPublished = false;
            file.IsArchived = true;
        }

        // ✅ CASE 3: Archived → Draft
        else if (file.IsArchived)
        {
            file.IsPublished = false;
            file.IsArchived = false;
        }

        try
        {
            await _spService.UpdateStatus(
                file.DriveId,
                file.Id,
                file.IsPublished,
                file.IsArchived
            );

            StateHasChanged();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"Error saving status: {ex.Message}");

            // Optional: revert UI if save fails
            // (very important for consistency)
        }
    }

    private bool IsFolderVisibleForRole(LibraryItem folder)
    {
        if (folder == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(folder.Name))
            return false;

        // ✅ ADMIN RULE
        if (isAdmin)
        {
            var adminAllowed = new[]
            {
            "All-Staff",
            "AI-Generated-Reports",
            "Group-Administrators",
            "Group-Marketing",
            "Group-Students",
            "Group-Trainers"
            };

            return adminAllowed.Contains(folder.Name);
        }

        // ✅ TRAINER RULE
        if (isTrainer)
        {
            var trainerAllowed = new[]
            {
            "Courses",
            "All-Staff",
            "AI-Generated-Reports",
            "Group-Trainers"
            };

            return trainerAllowed.Contains(folder.Name);
        }

        // ✅ DEFAULT (safe)
        return false;
    }

}

@code {

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await SessionInitializer.InitializeAsync();
    }

    private bool ShowProfilePopup;

    private void ToggleProfilePopup()
    {
        ShowProfilePopup = !ShowProfilePopup;
    }

    public class StudentCourse
    {
        public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        public string Code { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        public string Lecturer { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        public string Schedule { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        public int Progress { get; set; }
    }

    private List<StudentCourse> Courses = new()
    {
        new StudentCourse
        {
            Name = "Cloud Infrastructure",
            Code = "AZ900-101",
            Lecturer = "Mr. Fernando",
            Schedule = "Mon & Wed",
            Progress = 75
        },

        new StudentCourse
        {
            Name = "Microsoft Power Platform",
            Code = "PL900-201",
            Lecturer = "Mrs. Silva",
            Schedule = "Tue & Thu",
            Progress = 62
        },

        new StudentCourse
        {
            Name = "Cyber Security Fundamentals",
            Code = "SEC-110",
            Lecturer = "Mr. Perera",
            Schedule = "Friday",
            Progress = 84
        },

        new StudentCourse
        {
            Name = "AI Automation Systems",
            Code = "AI-500",
            Lecturer = "Dr. Kumar",
            Schedule = "Saturday",
            Progress = 48
        }
    };

    private string GetInitials()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
            UserSession.CurrentUser.FullName))
        {
            return "GU";
        }

        var parts =
            UserSession.CurrentUser.FullName
                .Split(' ',
                    StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);

        if (parts.Length == 1)
        {
            return parts[0]
                .Substring(0, 1)
                .ToUpper();
        }

        return string.Concat(
            parts[0][0],
            parts[1][0]).ToUpper();
    }

    private void CloseProfilePopup()
    {
        ShowProfilePopup = false;
    }
}

                            <InputSelect @bind-Value="Model.IsActive" class="form-control">
                                <option value="true">Active</option>
                                <option value="false">Inactive</option>
                            </InputSelect>
                        </div>

                        <div class="form-group">
                            <label>Created Date</label>
                            <InputText @bind-Value="Model.CreatedDate" class="form-control" disabled />
                        </div>

                        <div class="form-group">
                            <label>Created By</label>
                            <InputText @bind-Value="Model.CreatedBy" class="form-control" disabled />
                        </div>

                        <div class="form-group">
                            <label>Modified By</label>
                            <InputText @bind-Value="Model.ModifiedBy" class="form-control" disabled />
                        </div>

                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- ACTION BAR -->
                <div class="action-bar">
                    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">
                        Save
                    </button>
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" @onclick="OnCancel">
                        Cancel
                    </button>
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-danger" @onclick="ConfirmDelete">
                        Delete
                    </button>
                </div>

            </EditForm>
        </div>
    </div>

</div>

@code {

    private List<StudentProfile> Data = new();
    private StudentProfile Model = new();
    private StudentProfile? Selected;

    private List<ReferenceDataItem> Country = new();
    private List<ReferenceDataItem> Faculty = new();
    private List<ReferenceDataItem> AcademicStatus = new();
    private List<ReferenceDataItem> StudyModes = new();

    private string Search = "";
    private bool Loading;
    private string StatusMessage = "";
    private string LastRefresh = DateTime.Now.ToString("HH:mm");

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        await Load();
        Country = await SharePointService.GetReferenceDataByCategoryAsync("LMS", "Country");
        Faculty = await SharePointService.GetReferenceDataByCategoryAsync("LMS", "Faculty");
        AcademicStatus = await SharePointService.GetReferenceDataByCategoryAsync("LMS", "AcademicStatus");
        StudyModes = await SharePointService.GetReferenceDataByCategoryAsync("LMS", "StudyModes");
    }

    private async Task Load()
    {
        Data = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Search)
            ? await StudentService.GetStudentsAsync()
            : await StudentService.SearchStudentsAsync(Search);

        if (Data.Any())
            Select(Data.First());

        LastRefresh = DateTime.Now.ToString("HH:mm");
    }

    private void Select(StudentProfile s)
    {
        Selected = s;
        Model = s.Clone();
    }

    private async Task Save()
    {
        try
        {
            Model.Normalize();
            Model.Validate();

            if (Model.Id == 0)
            {
                var id = await StudentService.CreateStudentAsync(Model);
                if (id == 0)
                {
                    StatusMessage = "Create failed";
                    return;
                }
            }
            else
            {
                var result = await StudentService.UpdateStudentAsync(Model);
                if (!result)
                {
                    StatusMessage = "Update failed";
                    return;
                }
            }

            StatusMessage = " Saved: successfully ✅ " + Model.Title;
            await Load();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            StatusMessage = "Error: " + ex.Message;
        }
    }

    private async Task ConfirmDelete()
    {
        if (Selected == null) return;

        var confirmed = await JS.InvokeAsync<bool>("confirm", "Delete student?");
        if (!confirmed) return;

        await StudentService.DeleteStudentAsync(Selected.Id);
        StatusMessage = "Deleted successfully";
        await Load();
    }

    private void NewStudent()
    {
        Selected = null;
        Model = new StudentProfile { IsActive = true };
    }

    private Timer? _searchDebounce;

    private void OnSearchChanged(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        Search = e.Value?.ToString() ?? "";

        _searchDebounce?.Dispose();

        _searchDebounce = new Timer(async _ =>
        {
            await InvokeAsync(async () =>
            {
                await Load();
                StateHasChanged();
            });
        }, null, 300, Timeout.Infinite);
    }

    void OnCancel()
    {
        NavManager.NavigateTo(NavManager.Uri, forceLoad: true);
    }
}

@code {

    private List<ReferenceDataItem> Country = new();
    private List<ReferenceDataItem> Faculty = new();

    // ── STATE ──────────────────────────────────────
    private StudentProfile Model = new();
    private string StatusMessage = "";
    private bool isSubmitting = false;
    private bool isCheckingEmail = false;
    private bool IsConfirmed = false;
    private bool ShowValidationSummary = false;

    // ── EMAIL CHECK ────────────────────────────────
    private string EmailCheckMessage = "";
    private bool IsEmailExists = false;

    // ── HELPERS ────────────────────────────────────
    private string GetStatusClass() =>
        StatusMessage.StartsWith("✅") ? "success" :
        StatusMessage.StartsWith("❌") ? "error" : "info";

    private string GetStatusIcon() =>
        StatusMessage.StartsWith("✅") ? "✅" :
        StatusMessage.StartsWith("❌") ? "⛔" : "ℹ️";

    private string GetEmailInputClass()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(EmailCheckMessage)) return "";
        return IsEmailExists ? "input-error" : "input-success";
    }

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        Model.StudentNumber = await _studentService.GenerateTempStudentNumberAsync();
        Country = await _studentService.GetReferenceDataByCategoryAsync("LMS", "Country");
        Faculty = await _studentService.GetReferenceDataByCategoryAsync("LMS", "Faculty");

    }

    // ── EMAIL CHECK ────────────────────────────────
    private async Task CheckEmailManually()
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Model.Email))
            return;

        isCheckingEmail = true;
        EmailCheckMessage = "Checking…";
        IsEmailExists = false;

        try
        {
            var results = await _studentService.SearchStudentsAsync(Model.Email);

            IsEmailExists = results.Any(s =>
                s.Email.Equals(Model.Email, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));

            EmailCheckMessage = IsEmailExists
                ? "This email is already registered. Contact the Administrator."
                : "Email is available — you can proceed.";
        }
        catch
        {
            EmailCheckMessage = "Could not verify email. Please try again.";
            IsEmailExists = false;
        }
        finally
        {
            isCheckingEmail = false;
        }
    }

    // ── REGISTER ───────────────────────────────────
    private async Task Register()
    {
        ShowValidationSummary = false;

        try
        {
            isSubmitting = true;
            StatusMessage = "";

            if (IsEmailExists)
            {
                StatusMessage = "❌ Cannot submit — this email is already registered.";
                return;
            }

            // Double-check email server-side before creating
            var existing = await _studentService.SearchStudentsAsync(Model.Email);

            if (existing.Any(s =>
                s.Email.Equals(Model.Email, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
            {
                StatusMessage = "❌ Email already registered.";
                IsEmailExists = true;
                return;
            }

            Model.Normalize();
            Model.StudentNumber = await _studentService.GenerateTempStudentNumberAsync();
            Model.IsActive = false;

            var id = await _studentService.CreateStudentAsync(Model);

            if (id == 0)
            {
                StatusMessage = "❌ Registration could not be completed. Please try again.";
                return;
            }

            StatusMessage = $"✅ Registered successfully! Your temporary number is {Model.StudentNumber}. " +
                            "An administrator will review your application.";
            ResetForm();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            StatusMessage = $"❌ Unexpected error: {ex.Message}";
        }
        finally
        {
            isSubmitting = false;
        }
    }

    // ── RESET ──────────────────────────────────────
    private async Task ResetForm()
    {
        Model = new StudentProfile();

        Model.StudentNumber =
            await _studentService.GenerateTempStudentNumberAsync();

        IsConfirmed = false;
        EmailCheckMessage = "";
        IsEmailExists = false;
    }


    private async Task ConfirmReset()
    {
        var confirmed = await JSRuntime.InvokeAsync<bool>(
            "confirm",
            "Clear all entered data?"
        );

        if (confirmed)
        {
            await ResetForm();
        }
    }

}

====================================================================
END FILE

                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-warning"
                            disabled="@(Workflow is null)"

                <div class="list-group list-group-flush">

                        </button>
                    }
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Designer -->
            <div class="col-5 bg-body">
                <div class="p-3">

                    @if (Workflow is null)

                        <div class="alert alert-info p-4">

                            <h5 class="mb-3">
                                🧠 AI Workflow Studio – Quick Guide
                            </h5>
                            <code>Scrape🌐🔎📡→Process⚙️🧩🔄→Save💾🗄️📂→Notify🔔📩📢</code>

                            <ol class="mb-3">
                                <li>
                                    <strong>Create or Load Workflow</strong><br />

                                <div class="list-group">
                                    @foreach (var step in Workflow.DataSources.OrderBy(x => x.Order))

                                        <button class="list-group-item list-group-item-action"
                                                @onclick="() => SelectStep(step)">
                                            <div class="d-flex justify-content-between">

                                                <span>
                                                    <strong>@step.Name</strong>

                                                        @step.Type
                                                    </span>
                                                </span>

                                                <span>Order: @step.Order</span>

                                            </div>
                                        </button>
                                    }
                                </div>

                            </div>

                    }

                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Properties (FULL RESTORED) -->
            <div class="col-3 border-start bg-light">
                <div class="p-3">

                    <h6 class="border-bottom pb-2">Properties</h6>
                    @if (SelectedStep is not null)
                    {
                        <div class="mb-3">
                            <label class="form-label">Name</label>

                            <input class="form-control" @bind="SelectedStep.Output" />

                            <input class="form-control" type="number" @bind="SelectedStep.Order" />
                        </div>

                        <div class="form-check mb-3">
                            <input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox"
                                   @bind="SelectedStep.Enabled" />

                        <div class="form-check mb-3">
                            <input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox"
                                   @bind="SelectedStep.ContinueOnError" />

                            </label>

                        @* SCRAPE / HTTP *@

                                <label class="form-label">URL</label>
                                <input class="form-control"
                                       value="@GetSetting("url")"

                                       @onchange="SetPath" />

                            <div class="mb-3">
                                <label class="form-label">Destination</label>
                                <input class="form-control"

                                <label class="form-label">

                        }

                        @* SQL *@
                        @if (SelectedStep.Type.Equals("sql", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        {
                            <div class="mb-3">
                                <label class="form-label">Connection</label>
                                <input class="form-control"
                                       value="@GetSetting("connection")"
                                       @onchange="SetConnection" />

                            <div class="mb-3">
                                <label class="form-label">SQL Query</label>
                                <textarea rows="5" class="form-control"
                                          @onchange="SetQuery">@GetSetting("query")</textarea>
                            </div>
                        }

                        @* EMAIL *@
                        @if (SelectedStep.Type.Equals("email", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        {
                            <div class="mb-3">
                                <label class="form-label">To</label>
                                <input class="form-control"
                                       value="@GetSetting("to")"
                                       @onchange="SetEmailTo" />
                            </div>

                            <div class="mb-3">
                                <label class="form-label">Subject</label>
                                <input class="form-control"
                                       value="@GetSetting("subject")"
                                       @onchange="SetEmailSubject" />
                            </div>

                            <div class="mb-3">
                                <label class="form-label">Body</label>
                                <textarea rows="5" class="form-control"
                                          @onchange="SetEmailBody">@GetSetting("body")</textarea>
                            </div>
                        }


                        @* SHAREPOINT *@
                        @if (SelectedStep.Type.Equals("sharepoint", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        {
                            <div class="mb-3">
                                <label class="form-label">Site URL</label>
                                <input class="form-control"
                                       value="@GetSetting("siteUrl")"
                                       @onchange="SetSiteUrl" />
                            </div>

                            <div class="mb-3">
                                <label class="form-label">List Name</label>
                                <input class="form-control"
                                       value="@GetSetting("listName")"
                                       @onchange="SetListName" />
                            </div>

                            <div class="mb-3">
                                <label class="form-label">Operation</label>
                                <select class="form-select"
                                        value="@GetSetting("operation")"
                                        @onchange="SetOperation">
                                    <option value="read">Read</option>
                                    <option value="create">Create</option>
                                    <option value="update">Update</option>
                                    <option value="delete">Delete</option>
                                </select>
                            </div>
                        }

                        @* AI *@
                        @if (SelectedStep.Type.Equals("ai", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        {
                            <div class="mb-3">
                                <label class="form-label">Provider</label>
                                <InputSelect class="form-select"
                                             @bind-Value="AiProvider">
                                    <option value="AzureOpenAI">Azure OpenAI</option>
                                    <option value="OpenAI">OpenAI</option>
                                    <option value="OpenRouter">OpenRouter</option>
                                </InputSelect>
                            </div>

                            <div class="mb-3">
                                <label class="form-label">Model</label>
                                <InputText class="form-control"
                                           @bind-Value="AiModel" />
                            </div>

                            <div class="mb-3">
                                <label class="form-label">Prompt</label>
                                <InputTextArea rows="6"
                                               class="form-control"
                                               @bind-Value="AiPrompt" />
                            </div>
                        }

                        <div class="mt-3">
                            <button type="button"
                                    class="btn btn-outline-danger btn-sm w-100"
                                    @onclick="ShowDeleteConfirmation">
                                Remove Step
                            </button>
                        </div>
                        @if (ShowDeleteDialog)
                        {
                            <div class="modal fade show d-block"
                                 style="background:rgba(0,0,0,.5);">

                                <div class="modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered">
                                    <div class="modal-content">

                                        <div class="modal-header bg-danger text-white">
                                            <h5 class="modal-title">
                                                Confirm Delete
                                            </h5>
                                        </div>

                                        <div class="modal-body">
                                            Are you sure you want to delete
                                            <strong>@SelectedStep?.Name</strong>?
                                        </div>

                                        <div class="modal-footer">

                                            <button class="btn btn-secondary"
                                                    @onclick="CancelDelete">
                                                Cancel
                                            </button>

                                            <button class="btn btn-danger"
                                                    @onclick="@(() => DeleteConfirmed())">
                                                Delete
                                            </button>

                                        </div>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        }
                    }

                </div>
            </div>

        </div>

        @* ✅ PLACE WORKFLOW DELETE MODAL HERE *@
        @if (ShowWorkflowDeleteDialog)
        {
            <div class="modal fade show d-block"
                 style="background:rgba(0,0,0,.5);">

                <div class="modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered">
                    <div class="modal-content">

                        <div class="modal-header bg-danger text-white">
                            <h5 class="modal-title">
                                Confirm Workflow Delete
                            </h5>
                        </div>

                        <div class="modal-body">
                            Are you sure you want to delete workflow
                            <strong>@Workflow?.Name</strong>?
                        </div>

                        <div class="modal-footer">

                            <button class="btn btn-secondary"
                                    @onclick="CancelWorkflowDelete">
                                Cancel
                            </button>

                            <button class="btn btn-danger"
                                    @onclick="DeleteWorkflowConfirmed">
                                Delete
                            </button>

                        </div>

                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        }


        <!-- ✅ Console Footer -->
        <div class="wf-console border-top bg-dark text-light p-3 flex-shrink-0">

            <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-2">
                <div>
                    <strong class="text-warning">Workflow Console</strong>
                    <span class="ms-2 badge bg-secondary">@Logs.Count</span>
                </div>

                <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-light"
                        @onclick="ClearLogs">
                    <i class="bi bi-trash"></i> Clear
                </button>
            </div>

            <div style="max-height:200px; overflow-y:auto;">
                @if (!Logs.Any())
                {
                    <div class="text-secondary">No log entries available.</div>
                }
                else
                {
                    @foreach (var line in Logs)
                    {
                        <div class="py-1 px-2 mb-1 rounded"
                             style="background:#1f2937;color:white;">
                            @line
                        </div>
                    }
                }
            </div>

        </div>

    </div>

@code
{
    private WorkflowDefinition? Workflow;

    private WorkflowStep? SelectedStep;

    private WorkflowContext? Result;

    private List<string> WorkflowFiles = [];

    private List<string> Logs = [];

    private string SearchText = string.Empty;

    private IReadOnlyCollection<IWorkflowPlugin> Plugins = [];

    private bool ShowDeleteDialog;

    private bool ShowWorkflowDeleteDialog;

    private string AiModel
    {
        get => GetSetting("model");
        set => SetSetting("model", value);
    }

    private string AiPrompt
    {
        get => GetSetting("prompt");
        set => SetSetting("prompt", value);
    }

    private void SetOperation(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        SelectedStep!.Settings["operation"] =
            e.Value?.ToString() ?? "read";
    }

    private void ConfirmWorkflowDelete()
    {
        ShowWorkflowDeleteDialog = true;
    }

    private void CancelWorkflowDelete()
    {
        ShowWorkflowDeleteDialog = false;
    }

    private async Task DeleteWorkflowConfirmed()
    {
        ShowWorkflowDeleteDialog = false;

        await DeleteWorkflow();
    }

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        WorkflowFiles = await WorkflowService.GetWorkflowsAsync();

        Plugins = PluginManager.GetAll();
    }

    private IEnumerable<string> FilteredWorkflows =>
        string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(SearchText)
            ? WorkflowFiles
            : WorkflowFiles.Where(x =>
                x.Contains(
                    SearchText,
                    StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));

    private bool CanSave => Workflow is not null;

    private bool CanDelete => Workflow is not null;

    private bool CanExecute =>
      Workflow is not null &&
      Workflow.DataSources.Any(s => s.Enabled);

    private string AiProvider
    {
        get => GetSetting("provider") ?? "AzureOpenAI";
        set
        {
            if (SelectedStep is not null)
            {
                SelectedStep.Settings["provider"] = value;
            }
        }
    }

    private void NewWorkflow()
    {
        Workflow = new WorkflowDefinition
        {
            Name = "New Workflow"
        };

        SelectedStep = null;

        Log("Workflow created.");
    }

    private async Task LoadWorkflow(string file)
    {
        Workflow = await WorkflowService.LoadAsync(file);

        SelectedStep = null;

        Log($"Loaded {file}");
    }

    private async Task SaveWorkflow()
    {
        if (Workflow is null)
            return;

        await WorkflowService.SaveAsync(Workflow);

        WorkflowFiles =
            await WorkflowService.GetWorkflowsAsync();

        Log("Workflow saved.");

        StateHasChanged();
    }

    private async Task DeleteWorkflow()
    {
        if (Workflow is null)
            return;

        await WorkflowService.DeleteAsync(
            $"{Workflow.Name}.json");

        Workflow = null;

        SelectedStep = null;

        WorkflowFiles =
            await WorkflowService.GetWorkflowsAsync();

        Log("Workflow deleted.");

        StateHasChanged();
    }

    private async Task ExecuteWorkflow()
    {
        if (Workflow is null)
            return;

        try
        {
            Log($"Executing workflow: {Workflow.Name}");

            Result = await WorkflowService.ExecuteAsync(Workflow);

            Log("═══════════════════════════════");
            Log("WORKFLOW COMPLETED");
            Log("═══════════════════════════════");

            if (Result?.Variables is not null &&
                Result.Variables.Count > 0)
            {
                foreach (var variable in Result.Variables)
                {
                    Log($"OUTPUT: {variable.Key}");

                    var value = variable.Value?.ToString() ?? "(null)";

                    if (value.Length > 2000)
                    {
                        value = value[..2000] + "...";
                    }

                    Log(value);

                    Log("───────────────────────────────");
                }
            }
            else
            {
                Log("No output variables returned.");
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Log($"ERROR: {ex.Message}");
        }
    }
    private void ValidateWorkflow()
    {
        if (Workflow is null) return;

        var errors = Validator.Validate(Workflow);

        if (errors.Count == 0)
        {
            Log("Validation passed.");
            return;
        }

        foreach (var error in errors)
        {
            Log(error);
        }
    }

    private void SelectStep(WorkflowStep step)
    {
        SelectedStep = step;
    }

    private void AddPlugin(string type)
    {
        if (Workflow is null)
            return;

        var step = new WorkflowStep
        {
            Name = $"{type} step",
            Type = type,
            Enabled = true,
            Order = Workflow.DataSources.Count + 1,
            Output = $"{type}Output"
        };

        switch (type.ToLowerInvariant())
        {
            case "ai":
                step.Settings["provider"] = "AzureOpenAI";
                step.Settings["model"] = "gpt-5";
                step.Settings["prompt"] = "Enter your prompt here...";
                break;

            case "http":
                step.Settings["method"] = "GET";
                step.Settings["url"] = "";
                break;

            case "scrape":
                step.Settings["url"] = "";
                break;

            case "sql":
                step.Settings["connection"] = "";
                step.Settings["query"] = "";
                break;

            case "email":
                step.Settings["to"] = "";
                step.Settings["subject"] = "";
                step.Settings["body"] = "";
                break;

            case "sharepoint":
                step.Settings["siteUrl"] = "";
                step.Settings["listName"] = "";
                step.Settings["operation"] = "read";
                break;

            case "file":
                step.Settings["path"] = "";
                step.Settings["fileName"] = "Report.html";
                break;
        }

        Workflow.DataSources.Add(step);

        SelectedStep = step;

        Log($"{type} step added.");

        StateHasChanged();
    }

    private void ShowDeleteConfirmation()
    {
        Log("Delete button clicked");
        ShowDeleteDialog = true;
    }

    private void CancelDelete()
    {
        ShowDeleteDialog = false;
        StateHasChanged();
    }

    private void DeleteConfirmed()
    {
        if (Workflow is null || SelectedStep is null)
            return;

        var stepName = SelectedStep.Name;

        Workflow.DataSources.RemoveAll(s => s == SelectedStep);

        // ✅ reset selection
        SelectedStep = null;

        // ✅ re-order steps (very important)
        int order = 1;
        foreach (var step in Workflow.DataSources.OrderBy(x => x.Order))
        {
            step.Order = order++;
        }

        ShowDeleteDialog = false;

        Log($"Step '{stepName}' removed.");

        StateHasChanged();
    }

    private void Log(string message)
    {
        Logs.Add(
            $"[{DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss}] {message}");

        if (Logs.Count > 500)
            Logs.RemoveAt(0);

        StateHasChanged();
    }

    private string GetSetting(string key)
    {
        if (SelectedStep is null)
            return string.Empty;

        if (SelectedStep.Settings.TryGetValue(
            key,
            out var value))
        {
            return value?.ToString()
                ?? string.Empty;
        }

        return string.Empty;
    }

    private void SetSetting(
        string key,
        string? value)
    {
        if (SelectedStep is null)
            return;

        SelectedStep.Settings[key] = value;
    }

    private void SetUrl(ChangeEventArgs e)
        => SetSetting("url", e.Value?.ToString());

    private void SetMethod(ChangeEventArgs e)
        => SetSetting("method", e.Value?.ToString());

    private void SetPath(ChangeEventArgs e)
        => SetSetting("path", e.Value?.ToString());

    private void SetConnection(ChangeEventArgs e)
        => SetSetting("connection", e.Value?.ToString());

    private void SetQuery(ChangeEventArgs e)
        => SetSetting("query", e.Value?.ToString());

    private void SetEmailTo(ChangeEventArgs e)
        => SetSetting("to", e.Value?.ToString());

    private void SetEmailSubject(ChangeEventArgs e)
        => SetSetting("subject", e.Value?.ToString());

    private void SetEmailBody(ChangeEventArgs e)
        => SetSetting("body", e.Value?.ToString());

    private void SetSiteUrl(ChangeEventArgs e)
        => SetSetting("siteUrl", e.Value?.ToString());

    private void SetListName(ChangeEventArgs e)
        => SetSetting("listName", e.Value?.ToString());

    private async Task RefreshWorkflows()
    {
        WorkflowFiles = await WorkflowService.GetWorkflowsAsync();

        Log("Workflow list refreshed.");
    }

    private void ClearLogs()
    {
        Logs.Clear();

        StateHasChanged();
    }

    private void SetAiProvider(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        SelectedStep!.Settings["provider"] =
            e.Value?.ToString() ?? "AzureOpenAI";
    }

    private void SetAiModel(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        SelectedStep!.Settings["model"] =
            e.Value?.ToString() ?? string.Empty;
    }

    private void SetAiPrompt(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        SelectedStep!.Settings["prompt"] =
            e.Value?.ToString() ?? string.Empty;
    }

    private void SetFileOperation(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        SelectedStep!.Settings["operation"] =
            e.Value?.ToString() ?? string.Empty;
    }

    private void SetFileInput(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        SelectedStep!.Settings["input"] =
            e.Value?.ToString() ?? string.Empty;
    }

    private void SetDestination(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        SelectedStep!.Settings["destination"] =
            e.Value?.ToString() ?? string.Empty;
    }

    private void SetFileName(ChangeEventArgs e)
    {
        SelectedStep!.Settings["fileName"] =
            e.Value?.ToString() ?? string.Empty;
    }
}

@page "/workflow-runner"

@using MITANZ360Edu.Web.Models.Workflow
@using MITANZ360Edu.Web.Services.Workflow.Engine
@using MITANZ360Edu.Web.Services.Workflow.Repository
@using MITANZ360Edu.Web.Services.Workflow.Validation

@inject WorkflowExecutionService WorkflowService
@inject WorkflowValidator Validator

<PageTitle>Workflow Runner</PageTitle>

<h3>Workflow Runner</h3>

<div class="row">

    <div class="col-md-4">

        <label class="form-label">Workflow</label>

        <select class="form-select" @bind="SelectedWorkflow">

            <option value="">-- Select --</option>

            @foreach (var item in Workflows)
            {
                <option value="@item">@item</option>
            }

        </select>

        <button class="btn btn-primary mt-3 w-100"
                @onclick="RunWorkflow">
            Execute
        </button>

    </div>

    <div class="col-md-8">

        @if (Errors.Any())
        {
            <div class="alert alert-danger">

                <ul class="mb-0">

                    @foreach (var error in Errors)
                    {
                        <li>@error</li>
                    }

                </ul>

            </div>
        }

        @if (Result is not null)
        {
            <div class="card">

                <div class="card-header">
                    Workflow Result
                </div>

                <div class="card-body">

                    <pre>@System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(
                        Result.Variables,
                        new System.Text.Json.JsonSerializerOptions
                        {
                            WriteIndented = true
                        })</pre>

                </div>

            </div>
        }

    </div>

</div>

@code
{
    private List<string> Workflows = [];

    private string SelectedWorkflow = string.Empty;

    private WorkflowContext? Result;

    private List<string> Errors = [];

    protected override async Task OnInitializedAsync()
    {
        Workflows = await WorkflowService.GetWorkflowsAsync();
    }

    private async Task RunWorkflow()
    {
        Errors.Clear();
        Result = null;

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(SelectedWorkflow))
            return;

        var workflow = await WorkflowService.LoadAsync(SelectedWorkflow);

        if (workflow is null)
            return;

        Errors = Validator.Validate(workflow).ToList();

        if (Errors.Count > 0)
            return;

        Result = await WorkflowService.ExecuteAsync(workflow);
    }
}
